crew_f/grp.any.001.spoken: Anyone else's boots still wet from yesterday? Mine squelch when I think about them.

crew_f/grp.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.002.spoken: Stuff them with newspaper. Oh, wait. No newspaper. Stuff them with somebody's spare socks.

crew_f/grp.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.003.spoken: Line them up by the stove, all of them. We'll make a little boot parade.

crew_f/grp.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.004.spoken: The fire pile's burning faster on the windward side. We should feed the other end.

crew_f/grp.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.005.spoken: I'll take the other end. Somebody pass me the short lengths.

crew_f/grp.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.006.spoken: Feed both ends and it'll burn twice as fast. The cradle needs the room.

crew_f/grp.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.007.spoken: Are we nearly done? It's getting dim under the trees.

crew_f/grp.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.008.spoken: Last carry. Then we walk in together, at a sensible pace.

crew_f/grp.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.009.spoken: One more trunk would finish the lane. But I'll leave it for the morning.

crew_f/grp.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.010.spoken: A voice nobody can name, heard by somebody nobody can name. That's not news, that's weather.

crew_f/grp.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.011.spoken: Who's got a story? Not a scary one. A daft one.

crew_f/grp.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.012.spoken: I once lost a whole truck in a car park. Found it three hours later. Wrong car park.

crew_f/grp.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/grp.any.013.spoken: Daft story: a goat once refused to get off a delivery ramp. I waited it out. Took an hour.

crew_f/haul.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.001.spoken: Coming through with a log! Mind your heads.

crew_f/haul.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_f/haul.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.003.spoken: Grab the other end? This one's a two-person job.

crew_f/haul.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.004.spoken: Heavy one. Don't worry, I've got it.

crew_f/haul.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.005.spoken: Put another on top. I can take two of these.

crew_f/haul.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.006.spoken: Last carry, and then inside. Please.

crew_f/haul.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.007.spoken: Straight back for the next one. No point walking empty.

crew_f/haul.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.008.spoken: Deck on the left is leaning. Restack it before it slides.

crew_f/haul.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.009.spoken: Walk back with me? The haul feels shorter with someone to talk to.

crew_f/haul.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.010.spoken: Yard's full. No point stewing. Let's tidy the decks while the fire catches up.

crew_f/haul.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.011.spoken: Fire crackles. That's all that noise is.

crew_f/haul.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.012.spoken: Truck's handling well on the haul road. The ruts are drying out.

crew_f/haul.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.013.spoken: Waiting on the cradle, boss. Someone's unloading ahead of me.

crew_f/haul.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.014.spoken: Nothing to carry near me, boss. Is there a pile somewhere else?

crew_f/haul.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.015.spoken: Storm's picking up. Get this one in and we'll see.

crew_f/haul.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.016.spoken: Fire's struggling in the rain. Take the dry logs from the middle of the deck.

crew_f/haul.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.017.spoken: Watch the stump on your right. Ankle height, nasty.

crew_f/haul.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.018.spoken: Two-person carries are slow, but nobody's back gives out.

crew_f/haul.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.019.spoken: Fire pile's burned down a bit. Room for a few more.

crew_f/haul.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.020.spoken: Leave the rest on the deck. It'll keep till morning.

crew_f/haul.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.021.spoken: Same route, same log size, same sore shoulder.

crew_f/haul.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.022.spoken: Hardly anything left to haul from out here. Odd to see it so bare.

crew_f/haul.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.023.spoken: Sorry, boss. Something's lying across the route and I can't get past with this.

crew_f/haul.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.024.spoken: That's my deliveries done for now. Fire's got plenty.

crew_f/haul.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.025.spoken: Cradle's clear. Let's get another load in before the fire catches up.

crew_f/haul.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.026.spoken: Dry day. Bark's light and the road's firm. Good hauling.

crew_f/haul.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/haul.any.027.spoken: Load the handcart and push. Beats carrying them one at a time.

crew_f/haul.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_f/pair.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.001.spoken: Your end's dipping. Lift a bit or we'll both be wearing it.

crew_f/pair.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.002.spoken: My end's fine. It's your end telling stories.

crew_f/pair.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.003.spoken: So where are you from, then? Properly, not what's on the company form.

crew_f/pair.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.004.spoken: Small place. You'd drive through and never notice. That's the charm of it.

crew_f/pair.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.005.spoken: Is it me, or is the light going early tonight?

crew_f/pair.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.006.spoken: Same as yesterday. Keep walking and we'll be in with the others soon enough.

crew_f/pair.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.007.spoken: Swap ends? I've got more left in me than this log has.

crew_f/pair.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.008.spoken: Not a chance. I'm not handing you the bragging rights.

crew_f/pair.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.009.spoken: Somebody's left a glove on that stump back there. Not mine.

crew_f/pair.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.010.spoken: Not mine either. Hang it on the fence post. Someone'll claim it.

crew_f/pair.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.011.spoken: Brace your feet. Ruts ahead. I'll keep her slow.

crew_f/pair.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.012.spoken: Slow is good. Slow is my favourite speed.

crew_f/pair.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.013.spoken: Heard the latest story? Third time it's changed. By next week it'll be wearing a hat.

crew_f/pair.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.014.spoken: Stories grow out here. There's not much else to do after dark.

crew_f/pair.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/pair.any.015.spoken: Next one's ready. You notch, I'll clear the brush.

crew_f/pair.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_f/sea.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.003.spoken: Take a look offshore while there's still a gap in the fog.

crew_f/sea.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.004.spoken: Big ship out there. You can see it between the trees.

crew_f/sea.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.005.spoken: See the long dark line beyond the waves? That's a deck.

crew_f/sea.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.008.spoken: If you stand by me, you can see it over the yard fence.

crew_f/sea.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.012.spoken: Look where the water goes silver. It's just beyond that.

crew_f/sea.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.014.spoken: There's a square platform right at the back of it.

crew_f/sea.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.015.spoken: Wait for the next swell. The deck comes back into view.

crew_f/sea.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.016.spoken: I caught it in the corner of my eye while I was stacking.

crew_f/sea.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.018.spoken: Get a look before it goes behind the point.

crew_f/sea.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.019.spoken: That's a clean white wake for something moving that slowly.

crew_f/sea.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.020.spoken: I can see its windows flashing in the sun.

crew_f/sea.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.021.spoken: It was moving quicker a minute ago.

crew_f/sea.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.022.spoken: There's the ship again. It's taking its time past our stretch.

crew_f/sea.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.023.spoken: You've got time to see it. The wake's dropped right off.

crew_f/sea.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.027.spoken: If you missed it earlier, look now. It's barely moving.

crew_f/sea.any.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.032.spoken: No boat coming down from it that I can see.

crew_f/sea.any.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.033.spoken: It'll pass the opening in the trees in a second. Watch.

crew_f/sea.any.034.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.034.spoken: Look at the gap it's keeping from shore.

crew_f/sea.any.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.035.spoken: The bow's still pointed along the coast.

crew_f/sea.any.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.036.spoken: Might be waiting on something out there.

crew_f/sea.any.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.039.spoken: I didn't think I'd be able to hear it from this far out.

crew_f/sea.any.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.042.spoken: Hold up. There's a thump coming in over the trees.

crew_f/sea.any.045.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.045.spoken: Listen for the beat underneath the wind.

crew_f/sea.any.046.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.046.spoken: Sounds like a helicopter coming closer.

crew_f/sea.any.047.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.047.spoken: I heard it between cuts. It kept getting louder.

crew_f/sea.any.048.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.048.spoken: That noise is moving. Look up if you get a clear patch.

crew_f/sea.any.050.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.050.spoken: Hear it? There's a low beat behind the engine noise.

crew_f/sea.any.051.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.051.spoken: Whatever's overhead is drowning out the surf.

crew_f/sea.any.052.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.052.spoken: I can hear it through the cabin wall.

crew_f/sea.any.056.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.056.spoken: I lost the sound behind the ridge. Might come round again.

crew_f/sea.any.057.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.057.spoken: It's still there when the wind drops.

crew_f/sea.any.058.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.058.spoken: I've got a better listen here away from the pit.

crew_f/sea.any.060.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.060.spoken: It went quiet quick. Must be farther off now.

crew_f/sea.any.061.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.061.spoken: Up over the treeline. You've got a helicopter coming past.

crew_f/sea.any.062.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.062.spoken: There it goes over camp. Look up.

crew_f/sea.any.064.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.064.spoken: It's crossing the clearing. You've got a few seconds.

crew_f/sea.any.066.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.066.spoken: There it is, just above the ridge.

crew_f/sea.any.067.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.067.spoken: It turned after it passed the yard.

crew_f/sea.any.069.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.069.spoken: I saw it go over the far slope and turn back in.

crew_f/sea.any.072.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.072.spoken: It's holding out over the coast now.

crew_f/sea.any.073.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.073.spoken: You can see it between those two tops.

crew_f/sea.any.075.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.075.spoken: I saw the tail vanish behind the ridge. Keep watching that gap.

crew_f/sea.any.076.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.076.spoken: Looks like the next pass is taking it farther inland.

crew_f/sea.any.077.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.077.spoken: It went across the bay and curved back toward the island.

crew_f/sea.any.079.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.079.spoken: I saw it pass the dock. It kept right on going.

crew_f/sea.any.080.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.080.spoken: There it goes toward the water. You can see it against the haze.

crew_f/sea.any.082.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.082.spoken: Watch the back of the ship. The helicopter's coming down.

crew_f/sea.any.083.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.083.spoken: It went back to the same deck it came from.

crew_f/sea.any.085.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.085.spoken: It's over the ship now. Looks like they're bringing it in.

crew_f/sea.any.086.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.086.spoken: I could see the rotor clear as anything against the deck.

crew_f/sea.any.087.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.087.spoken: I watched the ship come round to the same stretch of water.

crew_f/sea.any.089.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.089.spoken: It made the whole round. I caught it on both sides of the island.

crew_f/sea.any.090.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.090.spoken: Same hull as the one I saw a few days ago.

crew_f/sea.any.091.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.091.spoken: Last time I watched it slow down at this same stretch.

crew_f/sea.any.092.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.092.spoken: The first time I only saw the ship. Today I saw what was on it.

crew_f/sea.any.094.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.094.spoken: I remember that big platform at the back. Saw it on the last pass too.

crew_f/sea.any.095.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.095.spoken: The ship's heading away now. Wake's pointing straight out.

crew_f/sea.any.096.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.096.spoken: I lost it after it turned seaward.

crew_f/sea.any.097.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.097.spoken: The rotor sound went with it after the helicopter came down.

crew_f/sea.any.098.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.098.spoken: Yesterday there was nothing on the horizon from this spot. I checked.

crew_f/sea.any.099.spoken: It's gone around the point again. I wonder how far out it goes after.

crew_f/sea.any.101.spoken: You saw the helicopter. Did you see where it came from?

crew_f/sea.any.107.spoken: I went out to look after you called. I only caught the wake.

crew_f/sea.any.108.spoken: I've got nothing better than a guess about what they're doing.

crew_f/sea.any.109.spoken: The way you describe it, I'd have sworn they were coming in.

crew_f/sea.any.112.spoken: One person sees a boat and by supper we've got an expedition.

crew_f/sea.any.115.spoken: I can't tell what anyone wants from a wake and a bit of noise.

crew_f/sea.any.119.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/sea.any.119.spoken: Next time, tell me before it gets behind the ridge.

crew_f/surv.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_f/surv.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.005.spoken: Wait. Let it move on first.

crew_f/surv.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.006.spoken: I'll take the heavy end of everything. You keep your eyes on the tree line.

crew_f/surv.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.007.spoken: It went quiet near the decks just before. Quiet is when I start worrying.

crew_f/surv.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.008.spoken: I used to have a word for all this. Nonsense. I've lost the word.

crew_f/surv.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.009.spoken: Talk to me. Quietly. Just so I know you're still there.

crew_f/surv.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.010.spoken: Truck's fuelled and the keys are in my pocket, boss. Last resort only.

crew_f/surv.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.011.spoken: Give me something to do, boss. Anything. Idle hands shake.

crew_f/surv.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.012.spoken: The company left right on schedule. Shame it was only their schedule.

crew_f/surv.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.013.spoken: Is that the ship? That's the ship.

crew_f/surv.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.014.spoken: One at a time on the gangway. Hold the rail.

crew_f/surv.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.015.spoken: I won't say their name yet. On the boat.

crew_f/surv.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.016.spoken: One of us walked off before all this. I hope they're hiding well.

crew_f/surv.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.017.spoken: There's so few of us now. Stay where I can see you.

crew_f/surv.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.018.spoken: Your watch. Wake me if anything changes. Anything at all.

crew_f/surv.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.019.spoken: Not everyone's getting on. I know. Keep walking anyway.

crew_f/surv.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.020.spoken: Go on, Biscuit. Up you go. We're right behind you.

crew_f/surv.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.021.spoken: I'm not leaving cover, boss. Not for anything.

crew_f/surv.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.022.spoken: Last night of it. Hold on till the light.

crew_f/surv.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.023.spoken: Can we stay inside today? Please? Whatever's been walking the road, I don't want to meet it.

crew_f/surv.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/surv.any.024.spoken: Eat, rest, keep the door shut. Boring keeps us alive.

crew_f/tool.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_f/tool.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.002.spoken: Too loud to talk. Wave if you need me.

crew_f/tool.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.003.spoken: Big axe makes short work of it.

crew_f/tool.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.004.spoken: Small axe. Patience, and a lot more swings.

crew_f/tool.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.005.spoken: No tool left on the rack. Someone needs to order more.

crew_f/tool.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.006.spoken: Sharpening while there's light. A dull axe is a dangerous axe.

crew_f/tool.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.007.spoken: Give me the heaviest axe there is. I'll keep it swinging all day.

crew_f/tool.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.008.spoken: Quick hone and back to it. Sharp edges, quicker trees.

crew_f/tool.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.009.spoken: That chain's throwing dust, not chips. It needs sharpening.

crew_f/tool.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.010.spoken: Let the saw do the work. Don't lean on it.

crew_f/tool.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.011.spoken: The saw makes me jump every time it starts. Sorry.

crew_f/tool.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.012.spoken: Swap stories while we hone the axes? Makes the time go quicker.

crew_f/tool.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.013.spoken: Can't hear a thing over this, so there's no point worrying about noises.

crew_f/tool.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.014.spoken: Tools strapped down in the truck bed. Nothing rattling loose.

crew_f/tool.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.015.spoken: Helmet on before you go under that crown.

crew_f/tool.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.016.spoken: Good tread on these boots. The mud's not winning today.

crew_f/tool.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.017.spoken: Sap's glued my gloves stiff. Still better than bare hands.

crew_f/tool.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.018.spoken: I need a tool, boss. The camper computer can order one from the supplier.

crew_f/tool.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.019.spoken: Getting the hang of this. Fewer swings than last week.

crew_f/tool.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.020.spoken: Parcel locker's full. New gear from the supplier, I hope.

crew_f/tool.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.021.spoken: Wet chain flinging bark everywhere. Keep your visor down.

crew_f/tool.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.022.spoken: Killing the saw. Dusk is coming and I want my ears back.

crew_f/tool.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.023.spoken: Ten days with the big axe. I'd never go back to the small one.

crew_f/tool.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.024.spoken: Dry wood bites clean. The edge is holding up today.

crew_f/tool.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.025.spoken: On the saw, boss. Can't hear you, but I can see you're there.

crew_f/tool.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.026.spoken: Wind's dropping twigs on my helmet. Glad I'm wearing it.

crew_f/tool.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.027.spoken: One axe on the rack has a cracked handle. I'm setting it aside.

crew_f/tool.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/tool.any.028.spoken: Go on, then. You start, I'll keep the angle.

crew_f/wage.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.001.spoken: Pay came through clean. One less thing to think about out here.

crew_f/wage.any.002.spoken: Owed since nightfall. Keep swinging, keep counting.

crew_f/wage.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.003.spoken: I'll work while I'm owed. Not forever. Today, though.

crew_f/wage.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.004.spoken: Paid in full and still lifting the big ones. Good week.

crew_f/wage.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.005.spoken: Sorry, I hate to ask. Are the wages coming soon?

crew_f/wage.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.006.spoken: I'll believe in back pay when it's in my hand and not a minute before.

crew_f/wage.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.007.spoken: Wages are in, so dinner's a proper sit-down. No excuses, no eating standing up.

crew_f/wage.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.008.spoken: Nobody's laughed at breakfast since the wages went late. Small thing. Still noticed it.

crew_f/wage.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.009.spoken: I'm owed, boss. I'm not panicking about it. I would like a date, though.

crew_f/wage.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.010.spoken: Paid and fuelled. The truck runs on diesel. I run on payday.

crew_f/wage.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.011.spoken: I'm telling you straight, boss. Another day unpaid and I'm leaving on the next boat.

crew_f/wage.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.012.spoken: Not many names left on the payroll. Every empty bunk is louder for it.

crew_f/wage.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.013.spoken: Their gloves are still on the rack. Somebody should use them. Feels odd to be the one.

crew_f/wage.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.014.spoken: Caught up at last. Thanks for sorting it, boss.

crew_f/wage.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_f/wage.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.016.spoken: Paid on time means I work on time. That's a fair trade.

crew_f/wage.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.017.spoken: Someone left. Now I keep wondering if I ought to.

crew_f/wage.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.018.spoken: Paid today. Ask me tomorrow whether it's turned into a habit.

crew_f/wage.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.019.spoken: Owed, this close to the end? That'll make for a tense boat ride, whichever way it goes.

crew_f/wage.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.020.spoken: Even cards are quiet tonight. Nobody bets when they're owed.

crew_f/wage.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.021.spoken: I'll carry anything you like. I won't carry a debt for long.

crew_f/wage.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.022.spoken: Rain on payday doesn't count. Rain on payday is just weather.

crew_f/wage.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wage.any.023.spoken: People are sleeping in later since the back pay came through. Have you noticed that, you?

crew_f/wx.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.001.spoken: Wet bark. Slow and steady on this one.

crew_f/wx.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.002.spoken: Gusts in the tops. Waiting for a lull.

crew_f/wx.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.003.spoken: Storm's too strong to fell in. Holding off.

crew_f/wx.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.004.spoken: Dry and bright. Good working weather.

crew_f/wx.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.005.spoken: Mud's sucking at my boots. Careful steps.

crew_f/wx.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.006.spoken: More sky than canopy out here now.

crew_f/wx.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.007.spoken: Not much forest left to clear. The island looks bigger without it.

crew_f/wx.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.008.spoken: Sun's low. Time to wrap up.

crew_f/wx.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.009.spoken: Roots everywhere under this growth. Watch your ankles.

crew_f/wx.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.010.spoken: Halfway cleared, everyone. The second half's never quicker, but at least we know the ground now.

crew_f/wx.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.011.spoken: Wind's shifted a few degrees. Checking the lean again before I commit.

crew_f/wx.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.012.spoken: Ground's drying faster where the canopy's gone. You can see the line between the two.

crew_f/wx.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.013.spoken: Getting dark. Can we start heading back? Just to be early.

crew_f/wx.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.014.spoken: I don't like how loud the storm gets in the trees. Can we go in?

crew_f/wx.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.015.spoken: Low gear, steady throttle. The route holds if you don't rush it.

crew_f/wx.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.016.spoken: Route's opened right up. Hardly a blind corner left.

crew_f/wx.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.017.spoken: Wet log, heavy log. I'll take it.

crew_f/wx.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.018.spoken: It's only weather. We wait it out, then we go again.

crew_f/wx.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.019.spoken: Rain's settled in, you. Good excuse for a long chat under the eaves.

crew_f/wx.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.020.spoken: Bit of rain never ruined a good day. Keep going.

crew_f/wx.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.021.spoken: Wind always sounds worse in a forest than it is. Old trees creak.

crew_f/wx.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.022.spoken: Storm's up, boss. I've stopped felling till it passes.

crew_f/wx.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_f/wx.any.023.spoken: Calm water today. You can see a long way out.

crew_m/boss.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/boss.any.001.spoken: Boss. What can I do for you?

crew_m/boss.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/boss.any.002.spoken: Heading to the next lane, boss. Nothing in my hands yet.

crew_m/boss.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/boss.any.003.spoken: Heading in, boss. The light's going.

crew_m/boss.any.004.spoken: Yard's full, boss. Nowhere to drop logs until someone feeds the fire.

crew_m/boss.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/boss.any.005.spoken: No axe on me, boss. I need one from the rack.

crew_m/boss.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/boss.any.006.spoken: Haven't seen anything strange myself, boss.

crew_m/boss.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/boss.any.007.spoken: I'm owed, boss. When will it be paid?
