crew_m/grp.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/grp.any.008.spoken: Last carry. Then we walk in together, at a sensible pace.

crew_m/grp.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/grp.any.009.spoken: One more trunk would finish the lane. But I'll leave it for the morning.

crew_m/grp.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/grp.any.010.spoken: A voice nobody can name, heard by somebody nobody can name. That's not news, that's weather.

crew_m/grp.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/grp.any.011.spoken: Who's got a story? Not a scary one. A daft one.

crew_m/grp.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/grp.any.012.spoken: I once lost a whole truck in a car park. Found it three hours later. Wrong car park.

crew_m/grp.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/grp.any.013.spoken: Daft story: a goat once refused to get off a delivery ramp. I waited it out. Took an hour.

crew_m/haul.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.001.spoken: Coming through with a log! Mind your heads.

crew_m/haul.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/haul.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.003.spoken: Grab the other end? This one's a two-person job.

crew_m/haul.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.004.spoken: Heavy one. Don't worry, I've got it.

crew_m/haul.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.005.spoken: Put another on top. I can take two of these.

crew_m/haul.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.006.spoken: Last carry, and then inside. Please.

crew_m/haul.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.007.spoken: Straight back for the next one. No point walking empty.

crew_m/haul.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.008.spoken: Deck on the left is leaning. Restack it before it slides.

crew_m/haul.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.009.spoken: Walk back with me? The haul feels shorter with someone to talk to.

crew_m/haul.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.010.spoken: Yard's full. No point stewing. Let's tidy the decks while the fire catches up.

crew_m/haul.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.011.spoken: Fire crackles. That's all that noise is.

crew_m/haul.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.012.spoken: Truck's handling well on the haul road. The ruts are drying out.

crew_m/haul.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.013.spoken: Waiting on the cradle, boss. Someone's unloading ahead of me.

crew_m/haul.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.014.spoken: Nothing to carry near me, boss. Is there a pile somewhere else?

crew_m/haul.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.015.spoken: Storm's picking up. Get this one in and we'll see.

crew_m/haul.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.016.spoken: Fire's struggling in the rain. Take the dry logs from the middle of the deck.

crew_m/haul.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.017.spoken: Watch the stump on your right. Ankle height, nasty.

crew_m/haul.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.018.spoken: Two-person carries are slow, but nobody's back gives out.

crew_m/haul.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.019.spoken: Fire pile's burned down a bit. Room for a few more.

crew_m/haul.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.020.spoken: Leave the rest on the deck. It'll keep till morning.

crew_m/haul.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.021.spoken: Same route, same log size, same sore shoulder.

crew_m/haul.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.022.spoken: Hardly anything left to haul from out here. Odd to see it so bare.

crew_m/haul.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.023.spoken: Sorry, boss. Something's lying across the route and I can't get past with this.

crew_m/haul.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.024.spoken: That's my deliveries done for now. Fire's got plenty.

crew_m/haul.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.025.spoken: Cradle's clear. Let's get another load in before the fire catches up.

crew_m/haul.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.026.spoken: Dry day. Bark's light and the road's firm. Good hauling.

crew_m/haul.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/haul.any.027.spoken: Load the handcart and push. Beats carrying them one at a time.

crew_m/haul.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/pair.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.001.spoken: Your end's dipping. Lift a bit or we'll both be wearing it.

crew_m/pair.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.002.spoken: My end's fine. It's your end telling stories.

crew_m/pair.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.003.spoken: So where are you from, then? Properly, not what's on the company form.

crew_m/pair.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.004.spoken: Small place. You'd drive through and never notice. That's the charm of it.

crew_m/pair.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.005.spoken: Is it me, or is the light going early tonight?

crew_m/pair.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.006.spoken: Same as yesterday. Keep walking and we'll be in with the others soon enough.

crew_m/pair.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.007.spoken: Swap ends? I've got more left in me than this log has.

crew_m/pair.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.008.spoken: Not a chance. I'm not handing you the bragging rights.

crew_m/pair.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.009.spoken: Somebody's left a glove on that stump back there. Not mine.

crew_m/pair.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.010.spoken: Not mine either. Hang it on the fence post. Someone'll claim it.

crew_m/pair.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.011.spoken: Brace your feet. Ruts ahead. I'll keep her slow.

crew_m/pair.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.012.spoken: Slow is good. Slow is my favourite speed.

crew_m/pair.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.013.spoken: Heard the latest story? Third time it's changed. By next week it'll be wearing a hat.

crew_m/pair.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.014.spoken: Stories grow out here. There's not much else to do after dark.

crew_m/pair.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/pair.any.015.spoken: Next one's ready. You notch, I'll clear the brush.

crew_m/pair.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/sea.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.003.spoken: Take a look offshore while there's still a gap in the fog.

crew_m/sea.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.004.spoken: Big ship out there. You can see it between the trees.

crew_m/sea.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.005.spoken: See the long dark line beyond the waves? That's a deck.

crew_m/sea.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.008.spoken: If you stand by me, you can see it over the yard fence.

crew_m/sea.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.012.spoken: Look where the water goes silver. It's just beyond that.

crew_m/sea.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.014.spoken: There's a square platform right at the back of it.

crew_m/sea.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.015.spoken: Wait for the next swell. The deck comes back into view.

crew_m/sea.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.016.spoken: I caught it in the corner of my eye while I was stacking.

crew_m/sea.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.018.spoken: Get a look before it goes behind the point.

crew_m/sea.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.019.spoken: That's a clean white wake for something moving that slowly.

crew_m/sea.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.020.spoken: I can see its windows flashing in the sun.

crew_m/sea.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.021.spoken: It was moving quicker a minute ago.

crew_m/sea.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.022.spoken: There's the ship again. It's taking its time past our stretch.

crew_m/sea.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.023.spoken: You've got time to see it. The wake's dropped right off.

crew_m/sea.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.027.spoken: If you missed it earlier, look now. It's barely moving.

crew_m/sea.any.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.032.spoken: No boat coming down from it that I can see.

crew_m/sea.any.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.033.spoken: It'll pass the opening in the trees in a second. Watch.

crew_m/sea.any.034.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.034.spoken: Look at the gap it's keeping from shore.

crew_m/sea.any.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.035.spoken: The bow's still pointed along the coast.

crew_m/sea.any.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.036.spoken: Might be waiting on something out there.

crew_m/sea.any.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.039.spoken: I didn't think I'd be able to hear it from this far out.

crew_m/sea.any.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.042.spoken: Hold up. There's a thump coming in over the trees.

crew_m/sea.any.045.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.045.spoken: Listen for the beat underneath the wind.

crew_m/sea.any.046.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.046.spoken: Sounds like a helicopter coming closer.

crew_m/sea.any.047.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.047.spoken: I heard it between cuts. It kept getting louder.

crew_m/sea.any.048.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.048.spoken: That noise is moving. Look up if you get a clear patch.

crew_m/sea.any.050.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.050.spoken: Hear it? There's a low beat behind the engine noise.

crew_m/sea.any.051.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.051.spoken: Whatever's overhead is drowning out the surf.

crew_m/sea.any.052.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.052.spoken: I can hear it through the cabin wall.

crew_m/sea.any.056.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.056.spoken: I lost the sound behind the ridge. Might come round again.

crew_m/sea.any.057.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.057.spoken: It's still there when the wind drops.

crew_m/sea.any.058.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.058.spoken: I've got a better listen here away from the pit.

crew_m/sea.any.060.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.060.spoken: It went quiet quick. Must be farther off now.

crew_m/sea.any.061.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.061.spoken: Up over the treeline. You've got a helicopter coming past.

crew_m/sea.any.062.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.062.spoken: There it goes over camp. Look up.

crew_m/sea.any.064.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.064.spoken: It's crossing the clearing. You've got a few seconds.

crew_m/sea.any.066.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.066.spoken: There it is, just above the ridge.

crew_m/sea.any.067.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.067.spoken: It turned after it passed the yard.

crew_m/sea.any.069.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.069.spoken: I saw it go over the far slope and turn back in.

crew_m/sea.any.072.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.072.spoken: It's holding out over the coast now.

crew_m/sea.any.073.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.073.spoken: You can see it between those two tops.

crew_m/sea.any.075.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.075.spoken: I saw the tail vanish behind the ridge. Keep watching that gap.

crew_m/sea.any.076.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.076.spoken: Looks like the next pass is taking it farther inland.

crew_m/sea.any.077.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.077.spoken: It went across the bay and curved back toward the island.

crew_m/sea.any.079.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.079.spoken: I saw it pass the dock. It kept right on going.

crew_m/sea.any.080.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.080.spoken: There it goes toward the water. You can see it against the haze.

crew_m/sea.any.082.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.082.spoken: Watch the back of the ship. The helicopter's coming down.

crew_m/sea.any.083.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.083.spoken: It went back to the same deck it came from.

crew_m/sea.any.085.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.085.spoken: It's over the ship now. Looks like they're bringing it in.

crew_m/sea.any.086.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.086.spoken: I could see the rotor clear as anything against the deck.

crew_m/sea.any.087.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.087.spoken: I watched the ship come round to the same stretch of water.

crew_m/sea.any.089.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.089.spoken: It made the whole round. I caught it on both sides of the island.

crew_m/sea.any.090.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.090.spoken: Same hull as the one I saw a few days ago.

crew_m/sea.any.091.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.091.spoken: Last time I watched it slow down at this same stretch.

crew_m/sea.any.092.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.092.spoken: The first time I only saw the ship. Today I saw what was on it.

crew_m/sea.any.094.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.094.spoken: I remember that big platform at the back. Saw it on the last pass too.

crew_m/sea.any.095.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.095.spoken: The ship's heading away now. Wake's pointing straight out.

crew_m/sea.any.096.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.096.spoken: I lost it after it turned seaward.

crew_m/sea.any.097.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.097.spoken: The rotor sound went with it after the helicopter came down.

crew_m/sea.any.098.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.098.spoken: Yesterday there was nothing on the horizon from this spot. I checked.

crew_m/sea.any.099.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.099.spoken: It's gone around the point again. I wonder how far out it goes after.

crew_m/sea.any.101.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.101.spoken: You saw the helicopter. Did you see where it came from?

crew_m/sea.any.107.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.107.spoken: I went out to look after you called. I only caught the wake.

crew_m/sea.any.108.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.108.spoken: I've got nothing better than a guess about what they're doing.

crew_m/sea.any.109.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.109.spoken: The way you describe it, I'd have sworn they were coming in.

crew_m/sea.any.112.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.112.spoken: One person sees a boat and by supper we've got an expedition.

crew_m/sea.any.115.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.115.spoken: I can't tell what anyone wants from a wake and a bit of noise.

crew_m/sea.any.119.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/sea.any.119.spoken: Next time, tell me before it gets behind the ridge.

crew_m/surv.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/surv.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/surv.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/surv.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/surv.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.005.spoken: Wait. Let it move on first.

crew_m/surv.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.006.spoken: I'll take the heavy end of everything. You keep your eyes on the tree line.

crew_m/surv.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.007.spoken: It went quiet near the decks just before. Quiet is when I start worrying.

crew_m/surv.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.008.spoken: I used to have a word for all this. Nonsense. I've lost the word.

crew_m/surv.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.009.spoken: Talk to me. Quietly. Just so I know you're still there.

crew_m/surv.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.010.spoken: Truck's fuelled and the keys are in my pocket, boss. Last resort only.

crew_m/surv.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.011.spoken: Give me something to do, boss. Anything. Idle hands shake.

crew_m/surv.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.012.spoken: The company left right on schedule. Shame it was only their schedule.

crew_m/surv.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.013.spoken: Is that the ship? That's the ship.

crew_m/surv.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.014.spoken: One at a time on the gangway. Hold the rail.

crew_m/surv.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.015.spoken: I won't say their name yet. On the boat.

crew_m/surv.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.016.spoken: One of us walked off before all this. I hope they're hiding well.

crew_m/surv.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.017.spoken: There's so few of us now. Stay where I can see you.

crew_m/surv.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.018.spoken: Your watch. Wake me if anything changes. Anything at all.

crew_m/surv.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.019.spoken: Not everyone's getting on. I know. Keep walking anyway.

crew_m/surv.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.020.spoken: Go on, Biscuit. Up you go. We're right behind you.

crew_m/surv.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.021.spoken: I'm not leaving cover, boss. Not for anything.

crew_m/surv.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.022.spoken: Last night of it. Hold on till the light.

crew_m/surv.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.023.spoken: Can we stay inside today? Please? Whatever's been walking the road, I don't want to meet it.

crew_m/surv.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/surv.any.024.spoken: Eat, rest, keep the door shut. Boring keeps us alive.

crew_m/tool.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/tool.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.002.spoken: Too loud to talk. Wave if you need me.

crew_m/tool.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.003.spoken: Big axe makes short work of it.

crew_m/tool.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.004.spoken: Small axe. Patience, and a lot more swings.

crew_m/tool.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.005.spoken: No tool left on the rack. Someone needs to order more.

crew_m/tool.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.006.spoken: Sharpening while there's light. A dull axe is a dangerous axe.

crew_m/tool.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.007.spoken: Give me the heaviest axe there is. I'll keep it swinging all day.

crew_m/tool.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.008.spoken: Quick hone and back to it. Sharp edges, quicker trees.

crew_m/tool.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.009.spoken: That chain's throwing dust, not chips. It needs sharpening.

crew_m/tool.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.010.spoken: Let the saw do the work. Don't lean on it.

crew_m/tool.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.011.spoken: The saw makes me jump every time it starts. Sorry.

crew_m/tool.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.012.spoken: Swap stories while we hone the axes? Makes the time go quicker.

crew_m/tool.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.013.spoken: Can't hear a thing over this, so there's no point worrying about noises.

crew_m/tool.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.014.spoken: Tools strapped down in the truck bed. Nothing rattling loose.

crew_m/tool.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.015.spoken: Helmet on before you go under that crown.

crew_m/tool.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.016.spoken: Good tread on these boots. The mud's not winning today.

crew_m/tool.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.017.spoken: Sap's glued my gloves stiff. Still better than bare hands.

crew_m/tool.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.018.spoken: I need a tool, boss. The camper computer can order one from the supplier.

crew_m/tool.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.019.spoken: Getting the hang of this. Fewer swings than last week.

crew_m/tool.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.020.spoken: Parcel locker's full. New gear from the supplier, I hope.

crew_m/tool.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.021.spoken: Wet chain flinging bark everywhere. Keep your visor down.

crew_m/tool.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.022.spoken: Killing the saw. Dusk is coming and I want my ears back.

crew_m/tool.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.023.spoken: Ten days with the big axe. I'd never go back to the small one.

crew_m/tool.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.024.spoken: Dry wood bites clean. The edge is holding up today.

crew_m/tool.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.025.spoken: On the saw, boss. Can't hear you, but I can see you're there.

crew_m/tool.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.026.spoken: Wind's dropping twigs on my helmet. Glad I'm wearing it.

crew_m/tool.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.027.spoken: One axe on the rack has a cracked handle. I'm setting it aside.

crew_m/tool.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/tool.any.028.spoken: Go on, then. You start, I'll keep the angle.

crew_m/wage.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.001.spoken: Pay came through clean. One less thing to think about out here.

crew_m/wage.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.002.spoken: Owed since nightfall. Keep swinging, keep counting.

crew_m/wage.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.003.spoken: I'll work while I'm owed. Not forever. Today, though.

crew_m/wage.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.004.spoken: Paid in full and still lifting the big ones. Good week.

crew_m/wage.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.005.spoken: Sorry, I hate to ask. Are the wages coming soon?

crew_m/wage.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.006.spoken: I'll believe in back pay when it's in my hand and not a minute before.

crew_m/wage.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.007.spoken: Wages are in, so dinner's a proper sit-down. No excuses, no eating standing up.

crew_m/wage.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.008.spoken: Nobody's laughed at breakfast since the wages went late. Small thing. Still noticed it.

crew_m/wage.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.009.spoken: I'm owed, boss. I'm not panicking about it. I would like a date, though.

crew_m/wage.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.010.spoken: Paid and fuelled. The truck runs on diesel. I run on payday.

crew_m/wage.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.011.spoken: I'm telling you straight, boss. Another day unpaid and I'm leaving on the next boat.

crew_m/wage.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.012.spoken: Not many names left on the payroll. Every empty bunk is louder for it.

crew_m/wage.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.013.spoken: Their gloves are still on the rack. Somebody should use them. Feels odd to be the one.

crew_m/wage.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.014.spoken: Caught up at last. Thanks for sorting it, boss.

crew_m/wage.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

crew_m/wage.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.016.spoken: Paid on time means I work on time. That's a fair trade.

crew_m/wage.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.017.spoken: Someone left. Now I keep wondering if I ought to.

crew_m/wage.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.018.spoken: Paid today. Ask me tomorrow whether it's turned into a habit.

crew_m/wage.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.019.spoken: Owed, this close to the end? That'll make for a tense boat ride, whichever way it goes.

crew_m/wage.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.020.spoken: Even cards are quiet tonight. Nobody bets when they're owed.

crew_m/wage.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.021.spoken: I'll carry anything you like. I won't carry a debt for long.

crew_m/wage.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.022.spoken: Rain on payday doesn't count. Rain on payday is just weather.

crew_m/wage.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wage.any.023.spoken: People are sleeping in later since the back pay came through. Have you noticed that, you?

crew_m/wx.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.001.spoken: Wet bark. Slow and steady on this one.

crew_m/wx.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.002.spoken: Gusts in the tops. Waiting for a lull.

crew_m/wx.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.003.spoken: Storm's too strong to fell in. Holding off.

crew_m/wx.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.004.spoken: Dry and bright. Good working weather.

crew_m/wx.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.005.spoken: Mud's sucking at my boots. Careful steps.

crew_m/wx.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.006.spoken: More sky than canopy out here now.

crew_m/wx.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.007.spoken: Not much forest left to clear. The island looks bigger without it.

crew_m/wx.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.008.spoken: Sun's low. Time to wrap up.

crew_m/wx.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.009.spoken: Roots everywhere under this growth. Watch your ankles.

crew_m/wx.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.010.spoken: Halfway cleared, everyone. The second half's never quicker, but at least we know the ground now.

crew_m/wx.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.011.spoken: Wind's shifted a few degrees. Checking the lean again before I commit.

crew_m/wx.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.012.spoken: Ground's drying faster where the canopy's gone. You can see the line between the two.

crew_m/wx.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.013.spoken: Getting dark. Can we start heading back? Just to be early.

crew_m/wx.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.014.spoken: I don't like how loud the storm gets in the trees. Can we go in?

crew_m/wx.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.015.spoken: Low gear, steady throttle. The route holds if you don't rush it.

crew_m/wx.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.016.spoken: Route's opened right up. Hardly a blind corner left.

crew_m/wx.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.017.spoken: Wet log, heavy log. I'll take it.

crew_m/wx.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.018.spoken: It's only weather. We wait it out, then we go again.

crew_m/wx.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.019.spoken: Rain's settled in, you. Good excuse for a long chat under the eaves.

crew_m/wx.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.020.spoken: Bit of rain never ruined a good day. Keep going.

crew_m/wx.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.021.spoken: Wind always sounds worse in a forest than it is. Old trees creak.

crew_m/wx.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.022.spoken: Storm's up, boss. I've stopped felling till it passes.

crew_m/wx.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
crew_m/wx.any.023.spoken: Calm water today. You can see a long way out.

dale/boss.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.001.spoken: Boss. What can I do for you?

dale/boss.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.002.spoken: Heading to the next lane, boss. Nothing in my hands yet.

dale/boss.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.003.spoken: Heading in, boss. The light's going.

dale/boss.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.004.spoken: Yard's full, boss. Nowhere to drop logs until someone feeds the fire.

dale/boss.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.005.spoken: No axe on me, boss. I need one from the rack.

dale/boss.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.006.spoken: Haven't seen anything strange myself, boss.

dale/boss.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.007.spoken: I'm owed, boss. When will it be paid?

dale/boss.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.008.spoken: All paid, boss. No complaints from me.

dale/boss.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/boss.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/boss.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.011.spoken: Not at dusk, boss. I'm heading in.

dale/boss.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.014.spoken: Carrying the heavy end. Somebody has to.

dale/boss.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.any.016.spoken: I've heard the stories, boss. Haven't seen a thing myself. People get bored out here.

dale/boss.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.dale.001.spoken: Mate! Boss! Come to help carry, or come to admire the carrying?

dale/boss.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.dale.002.spoken: Morning, mate. Had breakfast? I've had two. The second one was better.

dale/boss.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/boss.dale.003.spoken: Mate. Don't mind Biscuit. He's just checking your pockets for crusts.

dale/dusk.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.009.spoken: I'll take the back of the line. Somebody big should be at the back.

dale/dusk.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.011.spoken: Light's going. Tools away and get inside.

dale/dusk.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.012.spoken: Let's not hang about near the fence, you.

dale/dusk.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.013.spoken: I don't want to talk about it. I want to get inside.

dale/dusk.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.014.spoken: I'm not going back out tonight, boss. I'm sorry. Ask me again at first light.

dale/dusk.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.015.spoken: I saw something past the fence. I can't tell you what it was. I'm sure it was there.

dale/dusk.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.016.spoken: Only stories, boss. Nothing I've seen with my own eyes.

dale/dusk.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.017.spoken: Stick close, dog. We're both going in.

dale/dusk.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.018.spoken: Somebody check the door's latched. Then check it once more.

dale/dusk.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.019.spoken: Wind's making every branch sound like a footstep.

dale/dusk.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.020.spoken: Everybody here? Say your name if you're in.

dale/dusk.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.022.spoken: I don't believe in any of it. I'd still rather not walk past that spot again.

dale/dusk.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.any.023.spoken: Enough people have said it now, you. I can't keep waving it off.

dale/dusk.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.001.spoken: Dusk, mate. Kettle, cards, and whatever's in the pot. In that order.

dale/dusk.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.002.spoken: Someone heard a voice in the trees, did they? Somebody's radio, mate. Sound carries over water something wicked.

dale/dusk.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.003.spoken: Every cabin knocks at night, mate. Pipes cooling, boards shrinking. Ours just has more opinions than most.

dale/dusk.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.004.spoken: I'm not explaining this one, mate. I've tried. I keep coming up short, and I don't like it.

dale/dusk.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.005.spoken: Light past the fence last night, mate. Low down, like a torch held at the knee. Nobody had a torch out. I asked everyone.

dale/dusk.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.006.spoken: Come on, Biscuit. Supper's inside. Supper's always inside. That's the whole trick to dusk.

dale/dusk.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.007.spoken: Biscuit growled at the tree line last night. That dog doesn't growl at anything, mate. Not even me eating his share.

dale/dusk.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.008.spoken: Big logs today. Bigger dinner tonight. That's the arithmetic I understand.

dale/dusk.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.009.spoken: I'll walk in the middle tonight, mate, if it's all the same to you. Just for the view.

dale/dusk.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.010.spoken: Everyone in? I'll count again. Not because I'm worried. Because I'm thorough, that's all.

dale/dusk.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.011.spoken: Stick by me, you. Anything comes out of those trees, it'll want the big fella first. Plenty of me to go round.

dale/dusk.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.012.spoken: I've heard a story, mate. Stories are free. I'll believe it when it nicks my sandwich.

dale/dusk.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.013.spoken: Not tonight, mate. Sorry. Ask me in the morning and I'll carry anything you point at.

dale/dusk.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.014.spoken: Just give me a minute. I'm fine. Big lads are allowed a minute.

dale/dusk.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.015.spoken: Branch went right behind me on the walk in last night. Heavy snap, like something stood on it. Turned round, mate. Just the road.

dale/dusk.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.016.spoken: Everything sounds like footsteps in the rain. That's just rain. That's what rain does.

dale/dusk.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.017.spoken: Someone called my name from the trees, mate. Sounded like my mum. My mum's on the mainland. I didn't answer it.

dale/dusk.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.018.spoken: Door shut, lights off, and nobody goes out for a midnight snack. That includes me. Especially me.

dale/dusk.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.019.spoken: I worked docks at three in the morning, mate. Everything sounds like a person if you want it to.

dale/dusk.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.020.spoken: I'm not one for stories, mate, you know that. I saw something. I'd rather not say what till I've thought it through.

dale/dusk.dale.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/dusk.dale.021.spoken: Course you can, mate. All the way to the door. You can even carry the conversation.

dale/eth.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.001.spoken: Thanks, boss. Good to know someone's keeping count.

dale/eth.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.002.spoken: Moved up a level. Feels earned, for once.

dale/eth.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.003.spoken: Nowhere to set this down. Yard's full up.

dale/eth.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.004.spoken: Path's blocked ahead. Going round or waiting, one or the other.

dale/eth.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.005.spoken: This one needs two. Waiting for a spare pair of hands.

dale/eth.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.006.spoken: Nothing left on the rack I can use. Somebody bring one back.

dale/eth.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.007.spoken: No marked trees near me. Waiting on direction.

dale/eth.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.008.spoken: Bad grip, short drop. Lifting it again.

dale/eth.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.009.spoken: On it, boss. Next one's mine.

dale/eth.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.010.spoken: Good day, all. Same again tomorrow, and maybe the yard can keep up for once.

dale/eth.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.011.spoken: I'm only stood here because the yard's full, boss. Clear it and I'm straight back.

dale/eth.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.014.spoken: Give me the heavy end. That's what I'm here for.

dale/eth.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.018.spoken: Anyone who calls this lazy can come and look at the full cradle first.

dale/eth.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.any.022.spoken: Saw's pinched. Wedge it, ease it out, start again.

dale/eth.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.001.spoken: Cheers, mate. I'll take the thanks, but I'd take a second helping of dinner more.

dale/eth.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.002.spoken: Ah, it was nothing, mate. Well. It was a very heavy nothing.

dale/eth.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.003.spoken: Levelled up. Reckon that's worth an extra biscuit at tea. The food kind, not the dog.

dale/eth.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.004.spoken: Every log I've hauled lately has been cut to a sensible length. Somebody out there knows what they're doing.

dale/eth.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.005.spoken: Dropped that one short. My fault, mate. Picking it back up before anyone writes it down.

dale/eth.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.006.spoken: Second go. Me and this log have had words, and we've made up.

dale/eth.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.007.spoken: Can't set it down anywhere. Cradle's stuffed. Not my fault, not the log's fault. The fire's just slow.

dale/eth.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.008.spoken: Waiting on someone for the other end. This one's too long even for me, and I hate saying that.

dale/eth.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.009.spoken: Go on then, how many have you dropped today? Honest numbers.

dale/eth.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.010.spoken: Ah, but did you carry them? Didn't think so.

dale/eth.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.011.spoken: Two minutes, mate. My back's filed a complaint and I'm reading it through.

dale/eth.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.012.spoken: Delivered a good few, mate. Lost count after the one with the personality.

dale/eth.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.013.spoken: Nobody said lazy, mate. Though I did think it about myself for a second there.

dale/eth.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.014.spoken: Spent half the day holding logs nobody could take. Tomorrow I'm holding a sandwich instead.

dale/eth.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.015.spoken: No axe on the rack, mate. Can't fell a tree with a stern look. I've tried.

dale/eth.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.016.spoken: Wasn't me. I don't cut to marks, I cut to lunch.

dale/eth.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.017.spoken: Nothing marked for me. I'll stand here looking strong until somebody needs strong.

dale/eth.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.018.spoken: Mate, you did better than okay. Nobody had to shout at you once.

dale/eth.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.019.spoken: Me. Heaviest logs and the biggest appetite. Both should count.

dale/eth.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.020.spoken: Good carry earlier. Two people, one log, nobody swore. That's teamwork, that is.

dale/eth.dale.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.021.spoken: Tripped on a root and saved it with my knee. Log's fine. Knee's thinking about it.

dale/eth.dale.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/eth.dale.022.spoken: I stop for every meal and most snacks, so I reckon I'm doing fine.

dale/grp.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.any.001.spoken: Anyone else's boots still wet from yesterday? Mine squelch when I think about them.

dale/grp.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.any.002.spoken: Stuff them with newspaper. Oh, wait. No newspaper. Stuff them with somebody's spare socks.

dale/grp.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.any.005.spoken: I'll take the other end. Somebody pass me the short lengths.

dale/grp.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.any.010.spoken: A voice nobody can name, heard by somebody nobody can name. That's not news, that's weather.

dale/grp.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.any.012.spoken: I once lost a whole truck in a car park. Found it three hours later. Wrong car park.

dale/grp.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.001.spoken: Both, Joan. Eggs and porridge, and I slept like a man who'd earned it.

dale/grp.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.002.spoken: Then you got a free concert, mate. Most people pay for that.

dale/grp.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.003.spoken: Lunch report, everyone. Two sandwiches, an apple, and a biscuit Biscuit doesn't know about.

dale/grp.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.004.spoken: Loads, Joan. A great big load of them. Do I get a point?

dale/grp.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.005.spoken: Tight's my middle name, mate. Well, it's Albert. But tight's close.

dale/grp.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.006.spoken: Paid, paid, paid! Everyone hear that? That's the sound of a man who can afford snacks.

dale/grp.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.007.spoken: That's not boring, mate. That's the best use of money on this whole island.

dale/grp.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.008.spoken: Soft lanes, wet bark, slippery logs. Lovely. I'll be carrying them like bars of soap.

dale/grp.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.009.spoken: And the food in the blue tin is mine. That's a rule too, mate. Unofficially.

dale/grp.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.010.spoken: Mate, my first day I put my boots on the wrong feet. Walked half a mile like that. We all start somewhere.

dale/grp.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.011.spoken: As long as they don't cook. One bad cook per crew, and that job's taken.

dale/grp.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.012.spoken: Less shade for lunch, mates. Nobody ever thinks about the lunch shade.

dale/grp.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.013.spoken: Look at that. Stumps all the way down to the dock. We did that, mates. Mostly me.

dale/grp.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.014.spoken: Mate, if you fell it all today, I'm carrying it all tomorrow. My back would like a vote.

dale/grp.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.015.spoken: By the dock? That's water slapping the pilings, mate. Sounds like footsteps at night. Every dock does it.

dale/grp.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.016.spoken: Here's a good one. Apparently someone saw a light in the trees past the burn pit. A light. In the trees. Fireflies, mates.

dale/grp.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.017.spoken: A voice? Somebody's radio carrying over the water. Or Tomas talking in his sleep again.

dale/grp.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.018.spoken: Right, cards. Joan and me against Preeya and Tomas. Winners do the dishes. No, losers. Losers do the dishes.

dale/grp.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.019.spoken: If it's not mine, the machine's broken. I'll have a look at it after supper.

dale/grp.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.020.spoken: That's not jam, that's strategy, mate. He'll trade it back for a crust.

dale/grp.dale.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.021.spoken: Twenty trunks. That's twenty times I carry your ambition, Marta.

dale/grp.dale.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.022.spoken: I've got a stomach to feed, mate. The company can't pay a stomach in promises.

dale/grp.dale.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.023.spoken: Me. Every time. Do the bit with the barrel and the man in the bow tie.

dale/grp.dale.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
