dale/grp.dale.024.spoken: Captain Tomas, mates. Best seat on the island, and the snacks ride free.

dale/grp.dale.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.025.spoken: Wind's on my side, then. Every tree that falls toward the track is a shorter carry.

dale/grp.dale.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/grp.dale.026.spoken: Marta's never once called a day early. Not in all the years I've known her. Fine. In by dusk.

dale/haul.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.001.spoken: Coming through with a log! Mind your heads.

dale/haul.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/haul.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.003.spoken: Grab the other end? This one's a two-person job.

dale/haul.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.004.spoken: Heavy one. Don't worry, I've got it.

dale/haul.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.005.spoken: Put another on top. I can take two of these.

dale/haul.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.011.spoken: Fire crackles. That's all that noise is.

dale/haul.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.013.spoken: Waiting on the cradle, boss. Someone's unloading ahead of me.

dale/haul.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.014.spoken: Nothing to carry near me, boss. Is there a pile somewhere else?

dale/haul.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.015.spoken: Storm's picking up. Get this one in and we'll see.

dale/haul.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.016.spoken: Fire's struggling in the rain. Take the dry logs from the middle of the deck.

dale/haul.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.017.spoken: Watch the stump on your right. Ankle height, nasty.

dale/haul.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.018.spoken: Two-person carries are slow, but nobody's back gives out.

dale/haul.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.019.spoken: Fire pile's burned down a bit. Room for a few more.

dale/haul.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.020.spoken: Leave the rest on the deck. It'll keep till morning.

dale/haul.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.021.spoken: Same route, same log size, same sore shoulder.

dale/haul.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.022.spoken: Hardly anything left to haul from out here. Odd to see it so bare.

dale/haul.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.024.spoken: That's my deliveries done for now. Fire's got plenty.

dale/haul.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.026.spoken: Dry day. Bark's light and the road's firm. Good hauling.

dale/haul.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.any.027.spoken: Load the handcart and push. Beats carrying them one at a time.

dale/haul.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/haul.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.001.spoken: This one's got a personality. Mostly heavy.

dale/haul.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.002.spoken: I'll take the heavy one, mate. I always take the heavy one. Somebody write that down.

dale/haul.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.003.spoken: Good team carry earlier, mate. We should charge extra for synchronised walking.

dale/haul.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.004.spoken: Biscuit, you're walking right where my feet go. Crust for you if you shift.

dale/haul.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.005.spoken: Carrying, mate. Big ones to the cradle. The little ones I leave for the others.

dale/haul.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.006.spoken: Cradle's full, mate. I'm stood here holding a log like a very boring statue.

dale/haul.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.007.spoken: Neat deck, this. Layered up like a proper club sandwich.

dale/haul.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.008.spoken: Wet log, mate. Slippery as a fish and twice as rude.

dale/haul.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.009.spoken: Fire's got a good bed of coals going. Could cook a sausage on that.

dale/haul.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.010.spoken: Marta, how many have you carried? Go on. Then ask me how many I've carried.

dale/haul.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.011.spoken: Last log of the day. Then dinner. Then a second, smaller dinner.

dale/haul.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.012.spoken: Tomas, mate, lift with your legs, yeah? Your back's not a forklift.

dale/haul.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.013.spoken: Lost count of what I've delivered today. Big number. Very impressive. Trust me.

dale/haul.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.014.spoken: Company gets a hundred a tree, mate. I'd settle for a hot pie per trunk.

dale/haul.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.015.spoken: Fire's spitting at the rain. Can't say I blame it.

dale/haul.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.016.spoken: Route's clogged with sections, mate. Can't get round without climbing over.

dale/haul.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.017.spoken: Ten days of hauling. My shoulders have got their own postcode now.

dale/haul.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.018.spoken: Longer walk to the yard every day. Should've built the thing on wheels.

dale/haul.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.019.spoken: Hand me the next one, mate. This deck's nearly as tall as me.

dale/haul.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.020.spoken: This is my thinking face, Marta. I'm thinking about lunch.

dale/haul.dale.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/haul.dale.021.spoken: It landed exactly where I wanted, Joan. Eventually.

dale/pair.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.001.spoken: Your end's dipping. Lift a bit or we'll both be wearing it.

dale/pair.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.002.spoken: My end's fine. It's your end telling stories.

dale/pair.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.004.spoken: Small place. You'd drive through and never notice. That's the charm of it.

dale/pair.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.007.spoken: Swap ends? I've got more left in me than this log has.

dale/pair.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.008.spoken: Not a chance. I'm not handing you the bragging rights.

dale/pair.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.010.spoken: Not mine either. Hang it on the fence post. Someone'll claim it.

dale/pair.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.012.spoken: Slow is good. Slow is my favourite speed.

dale/pair.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.013.spoken: Heard the latest story? Third time it's changed. By next week it'll be wearing a hat.

dale/pair.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.any.014.spoken: Stories grow out here. There's not much else to do after dark.

dale/pair.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/pair.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.001.spoken: Mate, I carry everything you knock down. That's two counts in one. I win on arithmetic.

dale/pair.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.002.spoken: Stopped counting at lunch. Lunch was the high point. Everything since has just been wood.

dale/pair.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.003.spoken: Marta, this one's got a personality. Heavy, stubborn, won't sit right on the shoulder. Reminds me of someone.

dale/pair.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.004.spoken: Twenty years I've known her, and she still can't take a compliment.

dale/pair.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.005.spoken: Mate, I've sharpened your axe so often it's practically mine. Fine. Same bet.

dale/pair.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.006.spoken: Only if lunch counts as a work stoppage. I'm not losing to a sandwich again.

dale/pair.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.007.spoken: Twenty days, Marta, and you've not once let me win the count. Not once.

dale/pair.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.008.spoken: Please, Marta. Let me win. There, I asked. Now watch nothing change.

dale/pair.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.009.spoken: We could. Or we could eat. Only one of those keeps me alive, Marta.

dale/pair.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.010.spoken: Remember the mill job, the summer it never stopped raining? You swore never again. Look at you now.

dale/pair.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.011.spoken: Preeya, settle something. Heavy end first or light end first, through a gap like this?

dale/pair.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.012.spoken: I did. I just like hearing it said like a textbook.

dale/pair.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.013.spoken: That's not data, mate. That's love. Also, I drop things.

dale/pair.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.014.spoken: Preeya, you're the smartest person on this island. So what's for dinner?

dale/pair.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.015.spoken: There's a story going round again. I say it's a deer, or someone's radio. Back me up, Preeya.

dale/pair.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.016.spoken: Don't tell me the number. If you tell me, my back finds out.

dale/pair.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.017.spoken: Tomas, mate, you take the light end. I'll take the end with the opinions.

dale/pair.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.018.spoken: Mine. Mine always has opinions. Lift on three.

dale/pair.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.019.spoken: You drive like my nan carried soup, mate. Not a drop spilt.

dale/pair.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.020.spoken: Course, mate. I'll talk, you walk, and we're in before the soup's cold.

dale/pair.dale.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.021.spoken: Writing to Ana again? Tell her her brother's the best driver on the island.

dale/pair.dale.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.022.spoken: Accurate reporting. Your sister's going places.

dale/pair.dale.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.023.spoken: Not yet, mate. Plenty of day up there. I'll tell you when, and I won't forget.

dale/pair.dale.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.024.spoken: Twenty days in, Tomas, and you still apologise to the trucks.

dale/pair.dale.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.025.spoken: Biscuit's a critic, not a chef. It was stew. Ambitious stew.

dale/pair.dale.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.026.spoken: Cards tonight, Joan? I'm due a win. The universe owes me one.

dale/pair.dale.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.027.spoken: Nothing's settled while there's a deck in the drawer, Joan.

dale/pair.dale.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.028.spoken: Joan, guess what this log weighs. No, wrong. Heavier than that.

dale/pair.dale.029.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.029.spoken: Now you're speaking my language. Cheese, if there's any justice.

dale/pair.dale.030.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/pair.dale.030.spoken: Paid! Joan, I'm paid! Snacks are on me tonight, and I mean the good ones.

dale/sea.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.003.spoken: Take a look offshore while there's still a gap in the fog.

dale/sea.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.008.spoken: If you stand by me, you can see it over the yard fence.

dale/sea.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.012.spoken: Look where the water goes silver. It's just beyond that.

dale/sea.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.015.spoken: Wait for the next swell. The deck comes back into view.

dale/sea.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.016.spoken: I caught it in the corner of my eye while I was stacking.

dale/sea.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.018.spoken: Get a look before it goes behind the point.

dale/sea.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.020.spoken: I can see its windows flashing in the sun.

dale/sea.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.021.spoken: It was moving quicker a minute ago.

dale/sea.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.022.spoken: There's the ship again. It's taking its time past our stretch.

dale/sea.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.023.spoken: You've got time to see it. The wake's dropped right off.

dale/sea.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.027.spoken: If you missed it earlier, look now. It's barely moving.

dale/sea.any.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.032.spoken: No boat coming down from it that I can see.

dale/sea.any.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.033.spoken: It'll pass the opening in the trees in a second. Watch.

dale/sea.any.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.035.spoken: The bow's still pointed along the coast.

dale/sea.any.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.036.spoken: Might be waiting on something out there.

dale/sea.any.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.039.spoken: I didn't think I'd be able to hear it from this far out.

dale/sea.any.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.042.spoken: Hold up. There's a thump coming in over the trees.

dale/sea.any.046.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.046.spoken: Sounds like a helicopter coming closer.

dale/sea.any.047.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.047.spoken: I heard it between cuts. It kept getting louder.

dale/sea.any.048.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.048.spoken: That noise is moving. Look up if you get a clear patch.

dale/sea.any.050.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.050.spoken: Hear it? There's a low beat behind the engine noise.

dale/sea.any.051.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.051.spoken: Whatever's overhead is drowning out the surf.

dale/sea.any.052.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.052.spoken: I can hear it through the cabin wall.

dale/sea.any.056.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.056.spoken: I lost the sound behind the ridge. Might come round again.

dale/sea.any.057.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.057.spoken: It's still there when the wind drops.

dale/sea.any.058.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.058.spoken: I've got a better listen here away from the pit.

dale/sea.any.060.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.060.spoken: It went quiet quick. Must be farther off now.

dale/sea.any.061.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.061.spoken: Up over the treeline. You've got a helicopter coming past.

dale/sea.any.062.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.062.spoken: There it goes over camp. Look up.

dale/sea.any.064.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.064.spoken: It's crossing the clearing. You've got a few seconds.

dale/sea.any.066.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.066.spoken: There it is, just above the ridge.

dale/sea.any.067.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.067.spoken: It turned after it passed the yard.

dale/sea.any.069.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.069.spoken: I saw it go over the far slope and turn back in.

dale/sea.any.072.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.072.spoken: It's holding out over the coast now.

dale/sea.any.073.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.073.spoken: You can see it between those two tops.

dale/sea.any.075.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.075.spoken: I saw the tail vanish behind the ridge. Keep watching that gap.

dale/sea.any.076.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.076.spoken: Looks like the next pass is taking it farther inland.

dale/sea.any.077.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.077.spoken: It went across the bay and curved back toward the island.

dale/sea.any.079.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.079.spoken: I saw it pass the dock. It kept right on going.

dale/sea.any.080.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.080.spoken: There it goes toward the water. You can see it against the haze.

dale/sea.any.082.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.082.spoken: Watch the back of the ship. The helicopter's coming down.

dale/sea.any.083.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.083.spoken: It went back to the same deck it came from.

dale/sea.any.085.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.085.spoken: It's over the ship now. Looks like they're bringing it in.

dale/sea.any.087.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.087.spoken: I watched the ship come round to the same stretch of water.

dale/sea.any.089.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.089.spoken: It made the whole round. I caught it on both sides of the island.

dale/sea.any.090.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.090.spoken: Same hull as the one I saw a few days ago.

dale/sea.any.091.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.091.spoken: Last time I watched it slow down at this same stretch.

dale/sea.any.092.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.092.spoken: The first time I only saw the ship. Today I saw what was on it.

dale/sea.any.095.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.095.spoken: The ship's heading away now. Wake's pointing straight out.

dale/sea.any.096.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.096.spoken: I lost it after it turned seaward.

dale/sea.any.097.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.097.spoken: The rotor sound went with it after the helicopter came down.

dale/sea.any.098.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.098.spoken: Yesterday there was nothing on the horizon from this spot. I checked.

dale/sea.any.099.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.099.spoken: It's gone around the point again. I wonder how far out it goes after.

dale/sea.any.107.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.107.spoken: I went out to look after you called. I only caught the wake.

dale/sea.any.108.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.108.spoken: I've got nothing better than a guess about what they're doing.

dale/sea.any.109.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.109.spoken: The way you describe it, I'd have sworn they were coming in.

dale/sea.any.112.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.112.spoken: One person sees a boat and by supper we've got an expedition.

dale/sea.any.115.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.115.spoken: I can't tell what anyone wants from a wake and a bit of noise.

dale/sea.any.119.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.any.119.spoken: Next time, tell me before it gets behind the ridge.

dale/sea.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.dale.006.spoken: I thought that was a cloud bank until I saw the wake.

dale/sea.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.dale.009.spoken: That's farther out than it looks. The thing's enormous.

dale/sea.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.dale.013.spoken: That ship would dwarf anything I've seen come up to our dock.

dale/sea.dale.029.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.dale.029.spoken: Maybe the captain likes the view. I've seen better views.

dale/sea.dale.049.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.dale.049.spoken: For a second I thought something was loose on the truck.

dale/sea.dale.102.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.dale.102.spoken: I heard it, sure. I couldn't tell you what was painted on it.

dale/sea.dale.105.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/sea.dale.105.spoken: Maybe they're looking at the shoreline. People do that for work.

dale/surv.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/surv.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/surv.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/surv.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.006.spoken: I'll take the heavy end of everything. You keep your eyes on the tree line.

dale/surv.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.008.spoken: I used to have a word for all this. Nonsense. I've lost the word.

dale/surv.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.012.spoken: The company left right on schedule. Shame it was only their schedule.

dale/surv.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.013.spoken: Is that the ship? That's the ship.

dale/surv.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.014.spoken: One at a time on the gangway. Hold the rail.

dale/surv.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.015.spoken: I won't say their name yet. On the boat.

dale/surv.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.016.spoken: One of us walked off before all this. I hope they're hiding well.

dale/surv.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.017.spoken: There's so few of us now. Stay where I can see you.

dale/surv.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.018.spoken: Your watch. Wake me if anything changes. Anything at all.

dale/surv.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.019.spoken: Not everyone's getting on. I know. Keep walking anyway.

dale/surv.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.020.spoken: Go on, Biscuit. Up you go. We're right behind you.

dale/surv.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.021.spoken: I'm not leaving cover, boss. Not for anything.

dale/surv.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.any.022.spoken: Last night of it. Hold on till the light.

dale/surv.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.001.spoken: They've just gone, mate? No boat at all? I thought that was a story the old hands told to scare new lads.

dale/surv.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.002.spoken: Can't fit. Never mind. I'm fitting.

dale/surv.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.003.spoken: Quiet, mate. Big breath. Hold it.

dale/surv.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.004.spoken: Half a tin each, mate. I did the sums. Hardest sums I've done in my life, and I've done a lot of sums about food.

dale/surv.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.005.spoken: Left Biscuit a whole sausage in the dock alcove. Don't tell anyone. Don't tell me, either, or I'll want it back.

dale/surv.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.006.spoken: I'll take the late watch. Can't sleep hungry anyway, and we're all a bit hungry.

dale/surv.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.007.spoken: I keep saving them a seat, mate. Stop me if I do it again.

dale/surv.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.008.spoken: Wherever they wandered off to, I hope it's quiet there, and I hope they're still in it.

dale/surv.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.009.spoken: Big lad's still standing. Bit wobbly. Still standing.

dale/surv.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.010.spoken: I explained everything away for a month, mate. Deer, fridge, radio. I can't explain this one. So I've stopped trying.

dale/surv.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.011.spoken: They took the boat and left us the island. Generous of them. Very generous.

dale/surv.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.012.spoken: Two more dawns, mate. Then a fry-up. I'm going to think about that fry-up the whole way.

dale/surv.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.013.spoken: Ten years on docks and I've never been this glad to see a boat tie up.

dale/surv.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.014.spoken: There she is. Biscuit first, then me, then anyone who wants my seat can fight me for it.

dale/surv.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.015.spoken: If anyone gets hurt, mate, I'll carry them. That's my plan. That's the whole of my plan.

dale/surv.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.016.spoken: Not now, stomach. Please. Not now.

dale/surv.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.017.spoken: Sorry, mate. I'm not stepping off this porch today. I'll do anything that doesn't need me to.

dale/surv.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.018.spoken: Like a job. All right. I can do a job. Point me at the heavy bit.

dale/surv.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.019.spoken: It's not the dark, mate. It's when the dark goes quiet all at once. That's when I know.

dale/surv.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.020.spoken: We should all have been on this, mate. We aren't. I'll say it the once, and then I'll sit down.

dale/surv.dale.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/surv.dale.021.spoken: Slept? Mate, I lay very still with my eyes shut. That's the most I can claim.

dale/tool.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/tool.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.002.spoken: Too loud to talk. Wave if you need me.

dale/tool.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.003.spoken: Big axe makes short work of it.

dale/tool.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.004.spoken: Small axe. Patience, and a lot more swings.

dale/tool.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.005.spoken: No tool left on the rack. Someone needs to order more.

dale/tool.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.006.spoken: Sharpening while there's light. A dull axe is a dangerous axe.

dale/tool.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.007.spoken: Give me the heaviest axe there is. I'll keep it swinging all day.

dale/tool.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.013.spoken: Can't hear a thing over this, so there's no point worrying about noises.

dale/tool.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.015.spoken: Helmet on before you go under that crown.

dale/tool.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.016.spoken: Good tread on these boots. The mud's not winning today.

dale/tool.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.017.spoken: Sap's glued my gloves stiff. Still better than bare hands.

dale/tool.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.018.spoken: I need a tool, boss. The camper computer can order one from the supplier.

dale/tool.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.019.spoken: Getting the hang of this. Fewer swings than last week.

dale/tool.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.020.spoken: Parcel locker's full. New gear from the supplier, I hope.

dale/tool.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.021.spoken: Wet chain flinging bark everywhere. Keep your visor down.

dale/tool.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.022.spoken: Killing the saw. Dusk is coming and I want my ears back.

dale/tool.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.023.spoken: Ten days with the big axe. I'd never go back to the small one.

dale/tool.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.024.spoken: Dry wood bites clean. The edge is holding up today.

dale/tool.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.025.spoken: On the saw, boss. Can't hear you, but I can see you're there.

dale/tool.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.026.spoken: Wind's dropping twigs on my helmet. Glad I'm wearing it.

dale/tool.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.any.028.spoken: Go on, then. You start, I'll keep the angle.

dale/tool.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.001.spoken: Big axe, big man. Nature's way, mate.

dale/tool.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.002.spoken: This little axe is like eating soup with a teaspoon, mate.

dale/tool.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.003.spoken: Saw's going. Can't hear a word anyone says. Bliss.

dale/tool.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.004.spoken: Saw's doing the hard bit, mate. I'm just the bloke holding the pointy end away from me.

dale/tool.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.005.spoken: No axe on the rack, mate. I'll carry, but I can't cut with my sunny smile.

dale/tool.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.006.spoken: New gloves, mate. My hands haven't been this pampered since, well, never.

dale/tool.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.007.spoken: Marta's got that big axe sharp enough to slice bread. I'd know, I've thought about it.

dale/tool.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.008.spoken: Handle's worn smooth where my hand goes. We're getting to know each other.

dale/tool.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.009.spoken: Parcel locker's got something in it, mate. Hope it's biscuits. The human kind.

dale/tool.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.010.spoken: Can the camper computer order a pie, mate? Asking for a friend. The friend is me.

dale/tool.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.011.spoken: Helmet's a bit snug. My head's bigger than the company planned for.

dale/tool.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.012.spoken: Chainsaw in the rain. Loud, wet, and smells like a fuel can's packed lunch.

dale/tool.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.013.spoken: Big axe through a root. Like cutting a crusty loaf, that.

dale/tool.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.014.spoken: Swear I'm getting better at this, mate. Two swings fewer a tree, near enough.

dale/tool.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.015.spoken: Boots are earning their keep today, mate. Mud to the ankles and my socks still dry.

dale/tool.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.016.spoken: Biscuit, back off from the saw. You're not a log, even if you're shaped like one.

dale/tool.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.017.spoken: Swap you axes, mate? Yours looks lighter. Mine looks like a responsibility.

dale/tool.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.018.spoken: Tool rack's sorted, mate. Hung everything back up. Biscuit helped by sitting on the gloves.

dale/tool.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.019.spoken: No tool today. Just these arms. They'll do.

dale/tool.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/tool.dale.020.spoken: Ears? I thought the ringing was just me being happy.

dale/wage.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.001.spoken: Pay came through clean. One less thing to think about out here.

dale/wage.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.002.spoken: Owed since nightfall. Keep swinging, keep counting.

dale/wage.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.004.spoken: Paid in full and still lifting the big ones. Good week.

dale/wage.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.006.spoken: I'll believe in back pay when it's in my hand and not a minute before.

dale/wage.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.011.spoken: I'm telling you straight, boss. Another day unpaid and I'm leaving on the next boat.

dale/wage.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.012.spoken: Not many names left on the payroll. Every empty bunk is louder for it.

dale/wage.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.013.spoken: Their gloves are still on the rack. Somebody should use them. Feels odd to be the one.

dale/wage.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.014.spoken: Caught up at last. Thanks for sorting it, boss.

dale/wage.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

dale/wage.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.018.spoken: Paid today. Ask me tomorrow whether it's turned into a habit.

dale/wage.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.019.spoken: Owed, this close to the end? That'll make for a tense boat ride, whichever way it goes.

dale/wage.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.021.spoken: I'll carry anything you like. I won't carry a debt for long.

dale/wage.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.any.022.spoken: Rain on payday doesn't count. Rain on payday is just weather.

dale/wage.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.001.spoken: Paid, mate. Means nothing out here, does it? Still feels like a steak dinner.

dale/wage.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.002.spoken: First thing off the boat, a proper fry-up. Second thing, another fry-up. After that I'll start thinking about savings, mate. Probably.

dale/wage.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.003.spoken: Most of mine goes to my mum. She keeps it in a biscuit tin. Doesn't trust banks. Can't say I blame her.

dale/wage.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.004.spoken: There it is, back pay! Biscuit, we're rich. Well, I'm rich. You get the crusts, same as always.

dale/wage.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.005.spoken: Company gets a hundred a tree, mate. Every log on my shoulder was part of somebody's hundred. Just thinking out loud. Slowly.

dale/wage.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.006.spoken: Heavy log, light pocket. That's the wrong way round, that is.

dale/wage.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.007.spoken: I'm not one to fuss, mate, but I'm owed. I've been planning meals around money I haven't got.

dale/wage.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.008.spoken: I like you, mate, I do. But one more night unpaid and I'm on that boat. I'll even carry my own bag down.

dale/wage.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.009.spoken: Not a cent, mate. Checked twice. Checked a third time out of pure hope.

dale/wage.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.010.spoken: Owed wages and an empty stomach. Funny how they make the same noise.

dale/wage.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.011.spoken: All square, mate. Never shorted me once. That keeps a man lifting.

dale/wage.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.012.spoken: Not many of us on the haul now. Every log feels like it's missing a mate on the other end.

dale/wage.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.013.spoken: Carrying for two since that last one left, mate. Back's fine. Heart's a bit sore, if I'm honest.

dale/wage.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.014.spoken: Still made up the empty bunk this morning. Habit. Nobody's coming back to it.

dale/wage.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.015.spoken: Funny thing, getting paid. You stop worrying about money and start missing home instead. Not sure that's an improvement, mate.

dale/wage.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.016.spoken: Sorry, Biscuit. Smaller crusts until the boss pays up. We're in it together, you and me.

dale/wage.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.017.spoken: Thirty days at three hundred. Nine thousand, if I don't get daft with it. I'm going to get a little bit daft with it.

dale/wage.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.018.spoken: Mate, I've carried everything you asked me to. You can carry this one. Pay me what I'm owed.

dale/wage.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.019.spoken: Cheers for squaring up, mate. Knew you would. Mostly knew. Knew enough.

dale/wage.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.020.spoken: Paid again, everyone! Tonight I'm cooking to celebrate. Somebody warn the kitchen.

dale/wage.dale.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wage.dale.021.spoken: Like a log, mate. A paid log. Best kind there is.

dale/wx.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.001.spoken: Wet bark. Slow and steady on this one.

dale/wx.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.002.spoken: Gusts in the tops. Waiting for a lull.

dale/wx.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.003.spoken: Storm's too strong to fell in. Holding off.

dale/wx.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.004.spoken: Dry and bright. Good working weather.

dale/wx.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.005.spoken: Mud's sucking at my boots. Careful steps.

dale/wx.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.006.spoken: More sky than canopy out here now.

dale/wx.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.007.spoken: Not much forest left to clear. The island looks bigger without it.

dale/wx.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.008.spoken: Sun's low. Time to wrap up.

dale/wx.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.009.spoken: Roots everywhere under this growth. Watch your ankles.

dale/wx.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.010.spoken: Halfway cleared, everyone. The second half's never quicker, but at least we know the ground now.

dale/wx.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.017.spoken: Wet log, heavy log. I'll take it.

dale/wx.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.021.spoken: Wind always sounds worse in a forest than it is. Old trees creak.

dale/wx.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.022.spoken: Storm's up, boss. I've stopped felling till it passes.

dale/wx.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.any.023.spoken: Calm water today. You can see a long way out.

dale/wx.dale.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.001.spoken: Wet log. Twice the weight, half the grip, and it's still got an attitude.

dale/wx.dale.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.002.spoken: Wind's trying to take my hat. It can have it if it carries a log as well.

dale/wx.dale.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.003.spoken: Dry day. Logs are lighter. Well, they're not, but they feel it.

dale/wx.dale.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.004.spoken: Listen to that on the roof. Proper weather for a second breakfast.

dale/wx.dale.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.005.spoken: Mud's got my boot. Hang on. Right. Me and the boot are reunited.

dale/wx.dale.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.006.spoken: Downhill with a log is easy. Uphill with a log is a personality test.

dale/wx.dale.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.007.spoken: River's running fast after all this. Wouldn't fancy a swim. Biscuit would, mind.

dale/wx.dale.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.008.spoken: Brambles had my sleeve. They can keep it. I've got another shirt at camp, I think.

dale/wx.dale.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.009.spoken: Fair few gaps out there already. Island's starting to look like it had a haircut.

dale/wx.dale.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.010.spoken: Half the trees gone, mates. Half! Somebody should make a cake.

dale/wx.dale.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.011.spoken: You can see the sea from here now. Makes the walk back feel shorter, somehow.

dale/wx.dale.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.012.spoken: Stumps everywhere. It's like a very slow game of hopscotch with a log on.

dale/wx.dale.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.013.spoken: Getting dark, mate. Dinner's waiting, and so's the dog.

dale/wx.dale.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.014.spoken: Birds cleared off this side ages ago. Can't blame them. It's all chainsaws and me singing.

dale/wx.dale.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.015.spoken: Neither am I, not until I've had a cup of tea.

dale/wx.dale.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.016.spoken: Push you? Mate, I'll carry the truck if it comes to it.

dale/wx.dale.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.017.spoken: Sounds like rain coming to me. And rain sounds like soup weather.

dale/wx.dale.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.018.spoken: Wet one, mate. Good day for being a duck. Or a cook.

dale/wx.dale.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.019.spoken: Sun on the water. If it weren't for the logs, I'd call this a holiday.

dale/wx.dale.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
dale/wx.dale.020.spoken: Your knee said that yesterday, mate. Your knee's a pessimist.

joan/boss.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.001.spoken: Boss. What can I do for you?

joan/boss.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.002.spoken: Heading to the next lane, boss. Nothing in my hands yet.

joan/boss.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.003.spoken: Heading in, boss. The light's going.

joan/boss.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.004.spoken: Yard's full, boss. Nowhere to drop logs until someone feeds the fire.

joan/boss.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.005.spoken: No axe on me, boss. I need one from the rack.

joan/boss.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.006.spoken: Haven't seen anything strange myself, boss.

joan/boss.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.007.spoken: I'm owed, boss. When will it be paid?

joan/boss.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.008.spoken: All paid, boss. No complaints from me.

joan/boss.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/boss.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/boss.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.011.spoken: Not at dusk, boss. I'm heading in.

joan/boss.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.015.spoken: Crew's in decent spirits, boss. Mostly. Supper helps.

joan/boss.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.any.016.spoken: I've heard the stories, boss. Haven't seen a thing myself. People get bored out here.

joan/boss.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.001.spoken: Boss-love! How did you sleep? Honestly, now.

joan/boss.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.002.spoken: Evening, boss-love. Supper's on in a bit, and you're eating with us.

joan/boss.joan.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.003.spoken: Boss-love, you look like a wrung-out tea towel. Sit down for a minute.

joan/boss.joan.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.004.spoken: Morning, boss-love. Lovely weather for ducks and loggers.

joan/boss.joan.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.005.spoken: Felling, boss-love. I have a word with each one first. Makes it less rude.

joan/boss.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.006.spoken: Cutting it into lengths. Like slicing a loaf, only the loaf fights back.

joan/boss.joan.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.007.spoken: Stump work. Marta inspects them like a health inspector, so it's getting done right.

joan/boss.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.008.spoken: Carrying, love. If I drop it, it's the log's fault.

joan/boss.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.009.spoken: Stacking and minding the fire. Same as running a bar. Keep it moving, keep it warm.

joan/boss.joan.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.010.spoken: Nothing on, boss-love. I could be peeling potatoes. Or felling. Your call.

joan/boss.joan.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.011.spoken: Riding in luxury, love. Feet up, bumps included, no tips expected.

joan/boss.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.012.spoken: The yard's full, boss-love. Not a gap anywhere. Shift some to the fire pile or put someone on stacking and we're back in business.

joan/boss.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.013.spoken: Can't get through, love. Somebody's in my lane. Send me another way and I'll go.

joan/boss.joan.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.014.spoken: I've nothing to do, boss-love, and idle hands make gossip. Point me somewhere.

joan/boss.joan.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.015.spoken: No axe, love. I'm not felling with a wooden spoon. One off the rack, please.

joan/boss.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.016.spoken: I'm waiting for a partner on this carry. Send someone with a good back and a better sense of humour.

joan/boss.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.017.spoken: I wasn't going to say. I saw something by the trees, boss-love. It was watching. And I don't believe in anything, so that's what's bothering me.

joan/boss.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.018.spoken: I heard it myself, love. Something moving outside while we were all indoors. I counted heads. We were all indoors.

joan/boss.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.019.spoken: Someone's been telling tales. I didn't see a thing, and I'd take it with a good pinch of salt.

joan/boss.joan.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.020.spoken: Strange? Someone's been reading forums, boss-love. I've seen nothing.

joan/boss.joan.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.021.spoken: I've heard the story. I ran a bar for twenty years, love. Every story grows a foot after the second pint.
