joan/boss.joan.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.022.spoken: We're owed, boss-love. I'll not make a fuss. I'm just a bit worried, is all.

joan/boss.joan.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.023.spoken: Still owed. I've gone quiet about it, love, and you know that isn't like me.

joan/boss.joan.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.024.spoken: Paid, boss-love. Lovely. That's morale sorted for a night.

joan/boss.joan.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.025.spoken: All square. I can stop adding up my savings in my head now.

joan/boss.joan.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.026.spoken: Oh, give over, boss-love. Thank you, though.

joan/boss.joan.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.027.spoken: That's nice to hear, love. I'll tell the others you've got manners.

joan/boss.joan.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.028.spoken: Thank you, sunshine. There'll be a little extra in your bowl at supper.

joan/boss.joan.029.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.029.spoken: Thanks, boss-love. Mind you say it to Marta too. She thinks nobody notices.

joan/boss.joan.030.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.030.spoken: Did I ever tell you about the night the cellar flooded? Three barrels floating and a man in a bow tie.

joan/boss.joan.031.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.031.spoken: How's everyone sleeping, boss-love? Tomas talks in his. Dale snores in his. I keep notes.

joan/boss.joan.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.032.spoken: The company once sent a memo about morale. I used it to light the stove.

joan/boss.joan.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.033.spoken: There's a new name at the top of the arcade board. I'll give you a clue, love. It isn't Dale.

joan/boss.joan.034.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.034.spoken: Right you are, boss-love. Off I go.

joan/boss.joan.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.035.spoken: I'll do it, love. I'll complain the whole time, but I'll do it.

joan/boss.joan.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.036.spoken: Fine by me. Just don't make me miss supper.

joan/boss.joan.037.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.037.spoken: On it, sunshine. Back before the kettle boils.

joan/boss.joan.038.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.038.spoken: Not today, boss-love. Ask me nicely tomorrow.

joan/boss.joan.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.039.spoken: It's dusk, love. Nobody's going out. Everyone in, you included.

joan/boss.joan.040.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.040.spoken: No. I hardly ever say no to you, boss-love. I'm saying it now.

joan/boss.joan.041.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.041.spoken: Pay the crew and we'll talk, boss-love. Until then I'm on strike. Very politely.

joan/boss.joan.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.042.spoken: Boss-love, somebody's pride's a bit dented over the count today. Have a kind word ready.

joan/boss.joan.043.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.043.spoken: Yard's chock-full, love. Can I have someone on the fire pile?

joan/boss.joan.044.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.044.spoken: I've spent half the day waiting on the yard, boss-love. Not complaining. All right, complaining a bit.

joan/boss.joan.045.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/boss.joan.045.spoken: Supper's ready, boss-love. Come and eat before Dale finds it.

joan/camp.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/camp.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.002.spoken: Short break. Water and a bit of shade.

joan/camp.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.003.spoken: Hello, Biscuit. No, I haven't got anything. Honest.

joan/camp.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.004.spoken: Lights out soon. Big day tomorrow.

joan/camp.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.005.spoken: Kettle's just boiled if anyone wants one.

joan/camp.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.006.spoken: Who's on dishes tonight? Not me. I did them yesterday.

joan/camp.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/camp.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.008.spoken: Somebody's socks are drying on the heater again.

joan/camp.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.009.spoken: Has anyone beaten the top score on the arcade yet?

joan/camp.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.010.spoken: Come on, cards. Everyone in. Nobody's tired, they're just pretending.

joan/camp.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.011.spoken: Biscuit! Come here, you. Who's fed you today? Everyone? Of course they have.

joan/camp.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.017.spoken: That top arcade score? I'd bet someone found a glitch.

joan/camp.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.019.spoken: Whoever's rustling that crisp packet, please be done with it.

joan/camp.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.020.spoken: Evening, boss. Dinner's on in the cabin.

joan/camp.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.021.spoken: Rain on the cabin roof. Not the worst sound to rest to.

joan/camp.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.any.022.spoken: Another letter for the boat pile. It's getting thick.

joan/camp.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.001.spoken: Morning, you. How'd you sleep? Honestly, mind, not the polite version.

joan/camp.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.002.spoken: Dinner's up! Stew, bread, and a bit of something green so nobody gets scurvy.

joan/camp.joan.003.spoken: Cards, sunshine? Loser does the dishes, and I never lose.

joan/camp.joan.004.spoken: High-score board's been updated. I'm still on top. Some of you need to practise.

joan/camp.joan.005.spoken: Right, who was snoring last night? Own up, or I'm sending Biscuit in to investigate.

joan/camp.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.006.spoken: Biscuit, love, you've had dinner. I watched you have dinner. Twice.

joan/camp.joan.007.spoken: Laundry rota's on the fridge. If your name's next to towels, it's your turn, whoever you are.

joan/camp.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.008.spoken: Who used the big pan and put it back wet? I'm not angry. I'm just going to find out.

joan/camp.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.009.spoken: Writing my sister a letter she'll get in a month. She'll think I've gone soft. Maybe I have.

joan/camp.joan.010.spoken: It's a living tradition, love. Eat up.

joan/camp.joan.011.spoken: Stew, love. It's always stew. You ask every single night.

joan/camp.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.012.spoken: Somebody panic. Last time your eggs bounced.

joan/camp.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.013.spoken: Tell her you've got a whole cabin of aunties and uncles now, sunshine. And one dog.

joan/camp.joan.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.014.spoken: One hand, she says. Last time it was seven, and you won five of them.

joan/camp.joan.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.015.spoken: Evening, boss-love. There's a plate going spare in the cabin. Don't let Dale see you take it.

joan/camp.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.016.spoken: Tea break, loves. Sit down before you fall down.

joan/camp.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.017.spoken: Bathroom's free. Mind the step, and the spider. The spider's called Gerald. Be nice to Gerald.

joan/camp.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.018.spoken: Lucky, he says. I've got last night's scores written down, sunshine.

joan/camp.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.019.spoken: I ran a bar for twelve years, you. Same as this, really. Too many tired people, not enough chairs, and somebody always wants the last biscuit. The food kind. I don't let them near the dog.

joan/camp.joan.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.020.spoken: When it comes, love. Keep writing. She'll have a lovely big stack to read.

joan/camp.joan.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/camp.joan.021.spoken: Nobody, love, and nobody will while I've got breath in me.

joan/cut.any.001.spoken: Tree coming down! Clear the lane!

joan/cut.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/cut.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.003.spoken: Next trunk's ready to section when you are.

joan/cut.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/cut.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.010.spoken: Good rhythm today. We should work the same lane more often.

joan/cut.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.011.spoken: Not every creak is a warning. Old wood creaks when you cut it.

joan/cut.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.012.spoken: Bark's slippery. Mind the blade on the wet side.

joan/cut.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.013.spoken: Too gusty to drop anything. I'll section what's already down.

joan/cut.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.014.spoken: Nothing marked near me, boss. Point me at a tree and I'll drop it.

joan/cut.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.015.spoken: Can't cut with bare hands, boss. I need something off the tool rack first.

joan/cut.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.016.spoken: Lane's occupied. I'll hold off until they're out of the fall zone.

joan/cut.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.018.spoken: Mud all round the stump. Roots are greasy today.

joan/cut.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.019.spoken: The line's moving. You can see daylight through the first stands now.

joan/cut.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.020.spoken: Short, even lengths. Easier on whoever's carrying.

joan/cut.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.021.spoken: Dusk. Finish the cut and leave the rest for morning.

joan/cut.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.024.spoken: Saw's running. If you need me, shout, then shout louder.

joan/cut.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.026.spoken: Late in the contract and the trunks don't get any lighter.

joan/cut.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.any.028.spoken: Coming. Mark where you want the first cut.

joan/cut.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.001.spoken: Down she goes. Like last orders on a busy night.

joan/cut.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.002.spoken: Pass me the far end, love. I'll make it into something a person can lift.

joan/cut.joan.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.003.spoken: Fall line clear, sunshine? I'd hate to flatten anyone before lunch.

joan/cut.joan.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.004.spoken: Cutting, boss-love. Steady, not glamorous. Like most good shifts.

joan/cut.joan.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.005.spoken: Company pays by the tree, boss-love. I told the trees. They weren't impressed.

joan/cut.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.006.spoken: Marta, you've not stopped since sunrise. Do you have an off switch?

joan/cut.joan.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.007.spoken: Stubborn stump. Reminds me of a regular I had. Wouldn't leave either.

joan/cut.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.008.spoken: Wet sections, wet gloves, wet me. Glamorous life, this.

joan/cut.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.009.spoken: Light's going, love. Let's tidy this one up and call it a day.

joan/cut.joan.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.010.spoken: That's me on the board for today. Someone owes me a cup of tea.

joan/cut.joan.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.011.spoken: Yard's chock-a-block, boss-love. We're cutting faster than that fire can eat.

joan/cut.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.012.spoken: Tomas dropped that last one clean as anything. Did you see his face after?

joan/cut.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.013.spoken: Knotty bit in the middle. I'll cut either side and let it be the fire's problem.

joan/cut.joan.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.014.spoken: Wind's having opinions about this tree. Let's wait till it's finished talking.

joan/cut.joan.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.015.spoken: Ten days in. My hands have finally stopped asking what I've done to them.

joan/cut.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.016.spoken: How'd you sleep, love? You're cutting like someone who didn't.

joan/cut.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.017.spoken: Hardly any forest left. I'll miss the shade, if nothing else.

joan/cut.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.018.spoken: Report, boss-love: trees down, sections cut, nobody hurt. Best kind of report there is.

joan/cut.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/cut.joan.019.spoken: Big axe on a stump. Like buttering toast with a cleaver. Works, though.

joan/dusk.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.003.spoken: A rumour's just a story with somebody nervous doing the publicity.

joan/dusk.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.004.spoken: Every knock has a cause. Usually a loose board and a cold night.

joan/dusk.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.007.spoken: Who's walking with me? Nobody walks in alone tonight.

joan/dusk.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.011.spoken: Light's going. Tools away and get inside.

joan/dusk.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.012.spoken: Let's not hang about near the fence, you.

joan/dusk.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.013.spoken: I don't want to talk about it. I want to get inside.

joan/dusk.any.014.spoken: I'm not going back out tonight, boss. I'm sorry. Ask me again at first light.

joan/dusk.any.015.spoken: I saw something past the fence. I can't tell you what it was. I'm sure it was there.

joan/dusk.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.016.spoken: Only stories, boss. Nothing I've seen with my own eyes.

joan/dusk.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.017.spoken: Stick close, dog. We're both going in.

joan/dusk.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.018.spoken: Somebody check the door's latched. Then check it once more.

joan/dusk.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.019.spoken: Wind's making every branch sound like a footstep.

joan/dusk.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.020.spoken: Everybody here? Say your name if you're in.

joan/dusk.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.022.spoken: I don't believe in any of it. I'd still rather not walk past that spot again.

joan/dusk.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.any.023.spoken: Enough people have said it now, you. I can't keep waving it off.

joan/dusk.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.001.spoken: Right, loves, in we go. Kettle's mine, the cards are somebody else's problem.

joan/dusk.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.002.spoken: Someone's been reading forums, sunshine. There's nothing out there but trees and a lot of imagination.

joan/dusk.joan.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.003.spoken: I'm only passing it on, love. Someone says there was knocking after dark. I don't believe it. I'm passing it on anyway.

joan/dusk.joan.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.004.spoken: I'll tell you it's nothing, love, and I'll mean it. I just won't promise. I don't promise about things I can't see.

joan/dusk.joan.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.005.spoken: Who's sleeping light tonight? Hands up. Right. Same as me, then.

joan/dusk.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.006.spoken: I didn't believe a word of it, boss-love. Then I saw it myself. Now I'm the one people look at, and I don't like it.

joan/dusk.joan.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.007.spoken: Someone was at the fence last night, love. Just standing, arms at its sides. I thought it was one of us. We were all inside.

joan/dusk.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.008.spoken: Count off, loves. Nobody eats till I've got every one of you.

joan/dusk.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.009.spoken: Come here, sunshine, walk with me. We'll talk about anything you like except the trees.

joan/dusk.joan.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.010.spoken: I'm not scared. I'm just walking a bit faster. There's a difference. A small one.

joan/dusk.joan.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.011.spoken: In you go, Biscuit. You first, then the rest of us. Seniority.

joan/dusk.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.012.spoken: No, boss-love. Not this time. I'll do anything you like at sunrise. Not now.

joan/dusk.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.013.spoken: I'll sit here a bit. Don't fuss, love. Just sit with me.

joan/dusk.joan.014.spoken: Strange? Boss-love, I ran a bar. I've seen strange. This is a dark island with tall trees.

joan/dusk.joan.015.spoken: Someone was on the porch last night, love. Slow steps, three of them, then nothing. I counted the bunks after. Everyone was in them.

joan/dusk.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.016.spoken: A regular at my bar swore there was a woman in the cellar every closing time. It was the mop. Stories grow in the dark, love.

joan/dusk.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.017.spoken: Door's locked, lamps are on outside, and that's all any of us can do. Sleep, loves. I'll be up a while.

joan/dusk.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.018.spoken: I don't want to believe it, love. But I heard it from someone who doesn't tell stories, and that's the trouble.

joan/dusk.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.019.spoken: How are you holding up, you? Honestly, now. I'm not asking to be polite.

joan/dusk.joan.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.020.spoken: Or somebody's tummy, sunshine. I've heard yours after dinner. Could frighten a forest.

joan/dusk.joan.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/dusk.joan.021.spoken: Second-hand, love. Third, maybe. That's exactly my point. I don't believe a word of it.

joan/eth.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.001.spoken: Thanks, boss. Good to know someone's keeping count.

joan/eth.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.002.spoken: Moved up a level. Feels earned, for once.

joan/eth.any.003.spoken: Nowhere to set this down. Yard's full up.

joan/eth.any.004.spoken: Path's blocked ahead. Going round or waiting, one or the other.
