joan/eth.any.005.spoken: This one needs two. Waiting for a spare pair of hands.

joan/eth.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.006.spoken: Nothing left on the rack I can use. Somebody bring one back.

joan/eth.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.007.spoken: No marked trees near me. Waiting on direction.

joan/eth.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.008.spoken: Bad grip, short drop. Lifting it again.

joan/eth.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.009.spoken: On it, boss. Next one's mine.

joan/eth.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.010.spoken: Good day, all. Same again tomorrow, and maybe the yard can keep up for once.

joan/eth.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.011.spoken: I'm only stood here because the yard's full, boss. Clear it and I'm straight back.

joan/eth.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.017.spoken: Good work today, everyone. Somebody should say it out loud, so I will.

joan/eth.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.018.spoken: Anyone who calls this lazy can come and look at the full cradle first.

joan/eth.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.any.022.spoken: Saw's pinched. Wedge it, ease it out, start again.

joan/eth.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.001.spoken: Oh, boss-love, you'll make me blush. Bring that energy to dinner, it's stew.

joan/eth.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.002.spoken: Thank you, boss-love. Tell the others as well, would you? Marta won't admit she likes it, but she does.

joan/eth.joan.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.003.spoken: Levelled up, apparently. At my age. I'll have the lot of them calling me ma'am.

joan/eth.joan.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.004.spoken: Somebody's been working like a clock all afternoon. I'll be saying so at dinner whether they like it or not.

joan/eth.joan.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.005.spoken: Do you ever actually stop, you, or does somebody wind you up each morning?

joan/eth.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.006.spoken: Cradle's full, sunshine. That's the fire being slow, not anyone being idle.

joan/eth.joan.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.007.spoken: Before anyone says lazy, the route's blocked. I've been watching it for a good while.

joan/eth.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.008.spoken: Kettle break. Five minutes. Doctor's orders, and I'm the doctor.

joan/eth.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.009.spoken: Well, that notch is a crime. We'll call it a practice one and do it properly.

joan/eth.joan.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.010.spoken: Second try's the real one. First try was for the audience.

joan/eth.joan.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.011.spoken: I'm waiting on a carry partner, boss-love. Can't haul a trunk on good intentions.

joan/eth.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.012.spoken: Long day of standing about. Not our fault, mind. That yard needs a second fire or a miracle.

joan/eth.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.013.spoken: No saw on the rack, boss-love. I'll put the kettle on while somebody finds one.

joan/eth.joan.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/eth.joan.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.015.spoken: You did grand, sunshine. Better than grand. Now go and eat something.

joan/eth.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.016.spoken: Say it to their face at dinner, love. It's worth twice as much there.

joan/eth.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.017.spoken: Nothing to do. Dangerous words in a camp with a cook in it.

joan/eth.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.018.spoken: Right, who's had the best day? I'm handing out an imaginary medal at dinner.

joan/eth.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.019.spoken: My mum used to say a job half done is a meal half cooked. Terrible cook, my mum. Not wrong, though.

joan/eth.joan.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/eth.joan.020.spoken: You and your stumps, love. Next you'll be reading them like tea leaves.

joan/grp.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.any.001.spoken: Anyone else's boots still wet from yesterday? Mine squelch when I think about them.

joan/grp.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.any.002.spoken: Stuff them with newspaper. Oh, wait. No newspaper. Stuff them with somebody's spare socks.

joan/grp.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.any.003.spoken: Line them up by the stove, all of them. We'll make a little boot parade.

joan/grp.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.any.005.spoken: I'll take the other end. Somebody pass me the short lengths.

joan/grp.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.any.010.spoken: A voice nobody can name, heard by somebody nobody can name. That's not news, that's weather.

joan/grp.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.any.011.spoken: Who's got a story? Not a scary one. A daft one.

joan/grp.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.any.012.spoken: I once lost a whole truck in a car park. Found it three hours later. Wrong car park.

joan/grp.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.001.spoken: Right, everyone. Porridge or eggs, and how did we all sleep? Hands up for both questions.

joan/grp.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.002.spoken: That dog knows, love. That dog always knows. He can smell a crust through a tin.

joan/grp.joan.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.003.spoken: Quiz night, my loves. First question: how many trees did this crew fell today? Marta, you're not allowed to answer.

joan/grp.joan.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.004.spoken: That's why nobody lets you play, love. Fine. Next question. Who left the kettle empty?

joan/grp.joan.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.005.spoken: We're quick, love. Ten more minutes and I'll walk you in myself.

joan/grp.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.006.spoken: We heard, sunshine. Half the island heard. Biscuit's already waiting by the locker.

joan/grp.joan.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.007.spoken: Everyone take dry socks off the rack before you go. I'm not nursing anyone's feet tonight.

joan/grp.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.008.spoken: And supper's at dusk, everyone helps clear up, and nobody touches my arcade score.

joan/grp.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.009.spoken: It isn't, love. The blue tin's for everyone. I'm the cook, so I make the rules about tins.

joan/grp.joan.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.010.spoken: Hear that, sunshine? That's practically a medal from Marta.

joan/grp.joan.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.011.spoken: That empty bunk's bothering me, and I don't bother easy. Whoever the company sends next, I hope they play cards.

joan/grp.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.012.spoken: Odd, isn't it. Like a pub after closing. Too much room, and all the chairs up on the tables.

joan/grp.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.013.spoken: Why not ask the boss, love? That's what they're paid for. Allegedly.

joan/grp.joan.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.014.spoken: Somebody's been reading forums, love. Who told you? I'll have a quiet word.

joan/grp.joan.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.015.spoken: Leave it, sunshine. Tomas is right. If there's telling to do, it waits for daylight.

joan/grp.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.016.spoken: I'll say it so nobody whispers it. I've been told someone heard a voice in the trees. I'm not saying I believe it.

joan/grp.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.017.spoken: That's my point exactly, love. By the time it reached me it had grown a beard.

joan/grp.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.018.spoken: Losers do the dishes, love, and you've had your hands in that sink most nights this month.

joan/grp.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.019.spoken: New name at the top of the arcade board, my loves. Want to guess whose it is?

joan/grp.joan.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.020.spoken: Okay? Sunshine, it's the best news all week. I'm going to frame it.

joan/grp.joan.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.021.spoken: That dog eats better than half this crew. Mostly off Dale's plate.

joan/grp.joan.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.022.spoken: Go on, love. I'll not say much myself. I'm busy adding up what I've got put by.

joan/grp.joan.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.023.spoken: Nobody's going out in that. Kettle's on. Who wants to hear about the night the bar cellar flooded?

joan/grp.joan.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.024.spoken: Look at him, all confident behind the wheel. Where's this lad at dusk?

joan/grp.joan.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.025.spoken: Count us twice if it helps, sunshine. I'll count you.

joan/grp.joan.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/grp.joan.026.spoken: If Marta's saying it, I'm listening. I don't need the why, love.

joan/haul.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.001.spoken: Coming through with a log! Mind your heads.

joan/haul.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/haul.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.003.spoken: Grab the other end? This one's a two-person job.

joan/haul.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.009.spoken: Walk back with me? The haul feels shorter with someone to talk to.

joan/haul.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.011.spoken: Fire crackles. That's all that noise is.

joan/haul.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.013.spoken: Waiting on the cradle, boss. Someone's unloading ahead of me.

joan/haul.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.014.spoken: Nothing to carry near me, boss. Is there a pile somewhere else?

joan/haul.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.015.spoken: Storm's picking up. Get this one in and we'll see.

joan/haul.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.016.spoken: Fire's struggling in the rain. Take the dry logs from the middle of the deck.

joan/haul.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.017.spoken: Watch the stump on your right. Ankle height, nasty.

joan/haul.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.018.spoken: Two-person carries are slow, but nobody's back gives out.

joan/haul.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.019.spoken: Fire pile's burned down a bit. Room for a few more.

joan/haul.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.020.spoken: Leave the rest on the deck. It'll keep till morning.

joan/haul.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.021.spoken: Same route, same log size, same sore shoulder.

joan/haul.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.022.spoken: Hardly anything left to haul from out here. Odd to see it so bare.

joan/haul.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.024.spoken: That's my deliveries done for now. Fire's got plenty.

joan/haul.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.026.spoken: Dry day. Bark's light and the road's firm. Good hauling.

joan/haul.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.any.027.spoken: Load the handcart and push. Beats carrying them one at a time.

joan/haul.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/haul.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.001.spoken: Fire's going lovely. Could roast a chicken in there, if anyone had a chicken.

joan/haul.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.002.spoken: Mind your end, love. I'm not carrying you and the log.

joan/haul.joan.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.003.spoken: Tending the fire, boss-love. Slow burn. Like a good stew.

joan/haul.joan.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.004.spoken: Yard's stuffed, boss-love. Fire's eating as fast as it can, and you can't hurry a fire.

joan/haul.joan.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.005.spoken: That team carry earlier, love. We walked in step like a pair of old dancers.

joan/haul.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.006.spoken: Rain on the logs, rain on me. Somebody owes me a dry jumper.

joan/haul.joan.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.007.spoken: Dale, love, toss another one that hard and the whole deck goes over.

joan/haul.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.008.spoken: Banking the fire for the night. Let it sulk till morning.

joan/haul.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.009.spoken: I bet the company wants a photo of every deck, boss-love. They're that sort.

joan/haul.joan.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.010.spoken: How'd you sleep, sunshine? You're carrying like you had a nap on the way.

joan/haul.joan.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.011.spoken: Big ones to the bottom, love. It's a log deck, not a house of cards.

joan/haul.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.012.spoken: Did you see Preeya stack that deck? Straight as a ruler. Showing off, that is.

joan/haul.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.013.spoken: Back and forth, back and forth. Used to do this with crates of bottles.

joan/haul.joan.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.014.spoken: Report, boss-love: I've had logs on the cradle all day, the fire's fed, and nobody's crying.

joan/haul.joan.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.015.spoken: Route's jammed with sections, love. Like a cellar on delivery day.

joan/haul.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.016.spoken: Wind's throwing smoke straight at me. Of course it is.

joan/haul.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.017.spoken: Biscuit's following that log like it owes him money. Dale's been feeding him again.

joan/haul.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.018.spoken: That fire's been going since day one. Half the island's been through it now.

joan/haul.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.019.spoken: Nearly the end of the contract and I've still got a barmaid's arms. Strong ones, mind.

joan/haul.joan.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.020.spoken: If it's on the fire, love, it's not cluttering my deck. In it goes.

joan/haul.joan.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/haul.joan.021.spoken: Course it is, sunshine. Drop it on the deck and walk in with me.

joan/pair.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.001.spoken: Your end's dipping. Lift a bit or we'll both be wearing it.

joan/pair.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.002.spoken: My end's fine. It's your end telling stories.

joan/pair.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.003.spoken: So where are you from, then? Properly, not what's on the company form.

joan/pair.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.004.spoken: Small place. You'd drive through and never notice. That's the charm of it.

joan/pair.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.008.spoken: Not a chance. I'm not handing you the bragging rights.

joan/pair.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.010.spoken: Not mine either. Hang it on the fence post. Someone'll claim it.

joan/pair.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.012.spoken: Slow is good. Slow is my favourite speed.

joan/pair.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.013.spoken: Heard the latest story? Third time it's changed. By next week it'll be wearing a hat.

joan/pair.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.any.014.spoken: Stories grow out here. There's not much else to do after dark.

joan/pair.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/pair.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.001.spoken: Sit down, Marta, love. The trees will still be there in ten minutes. I know, that's the problem.

joan/pair.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.002.spoken: And ten minutes is a cup of tea. Sit. I'll hold your axe hostage if I have to.

joan/pair.joan.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.003.spoken: Somebody has to, love. You only ever talk to them with a blade.

joan/pair.joan.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.004.spoken: I timed you at supper, Marta. You sat still four whole minutes. A personal best.

joan/pair.joan.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.005.spoken: How did you sleep, Marta? And don't tell me you dreamt about hinge wood.

joan/pair.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.006.spoken: When I ran the bar, I counted the till twice before I let myself worry. I'm on my second count.

joan/pair.joan.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.007.spoken: Dale, love, what was that you cooked last night? Biscuit walked away from it.

joan/pair.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.008.spoken: It was brave, sunshine. I'll give it brave.

joan/pair.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.009.spoken: The universe doesn't owe you, love. I do, and I'm not paying up.

joan/pair.joan.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.010.spoken: You've been due every night for a week and a half, sunshine. I keep a ledger.

joan/pair.joan.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.011.spoken: The card tally on the wall's looking very one-sided, Dale. I'd call it settled.

joan/pair.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.012.spoken: I wasn't going to guess, love. I was going to ask what's for lunch.

joan/pair.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.013.spoken: With what you lose at cards, love, you're really buying them for me.

joan/pair.joan.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.014.spoken: Preeya, love, rate this one for me. Someone's got a new story about the woods after dark. Evidence or nonsense?

joan/pair.joan.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.015.spoken: That's why I love you. You turn nonsense into paperwork.

joan/pair.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.016.spoken: The mystery's love, sunshine. You can't put that in a notebook.

joan/pair.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.017.spoken: Did you sleep, Preeya? I saw that little torch on over your notebook again.

joan/pair.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.018.spoken: A bar manager always rounds up, love. It's good for morale.

joan/pair.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.019.spoken: Then we stack the other side and blame the wind. Morale and physics, love.

joan/pair.joan.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.020.spoken: Tomas, sunshine, you're on my team at the arcade tonight. No, you don't get a vote.

joan/pair.joan.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.021.spoken: That's why you're on my team, love. I'm good enough for two.

joan/pair.joan.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.022.spoken: Like a log, love. Fitting, for the job. And you?

joan/pair.joan.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.023.spoken: Eat something before we go in, Tomas. You've got a face like a wet Tuesday.

joan/pair.joan.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.024.spoken: Never apologise for a high score, sunshine. Apologise for that haircut.

joan/pair.joan.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/pair.joan.025.spoken: Go on, Tomas, tell me about the gears again. I find it soothing.

joan/sea.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.003.spoken: Take a look offshore while there's still a gap in the fog.

joan/sea.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.004.spoken: Big ship out there. You can see it between the trees.

joan/sea.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.008.spoken: If you stand by me, you can see it over the yard fence.

joan/sea.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.012.spoken: Look where the water goes silver. It's just beyond that.

joan/sea.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.015.spoken: Wait for the next swell. The deck comes back into view.

joan/sea.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.016.spoken: I caught it in the corner of my eye while I was stacking.

joan/sea.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.018.spoken: Get a look before it goes behind the point.

joan/sea.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.020.spoken: I can see its windows flashing in the sun.

joan/sea.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.021.spoken: It was moving quicker a minute ago.

joan/sea.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.022.spoken: There's the ship again. It's taking its time past our stretch.

joan/sea.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.023.spoken: You've got time to see it. The wake's dropped right off.

joan/sea.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.027.spoken: If you missed it earlier, look now. It's barely moving.

joan/sea.any.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.032.spoken: No boat coming down from it that I can see.

joan/sea.any.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.033.spoken: It'll pass the opening in the trees in a second. Watch.

joan/sea.any.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.035.spoken: The bow's still pointed along the coast.

joan/sea.any.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.036.spoken: Might be waiting on something out there.

joan/sea.any.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.039.spoken: I didn't think I'd be able to hear it from this far out.

joan/sea.any.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.042.spoken: Hold up. There's a thump coming in over the trees.

joan/sea.any.046.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.046.spoken: Sounds like a helicopter coming closer.

joan/sea.any.047.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.047.spoken: I heard it between cuts. It kept getting louder.

joan/sea.any.048.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.048.spoken: That noise is moving. Look up if you get a clear patch.

joan/sea.any.050.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.050.spoken: Hear it? There's a low beat behind the engine noise.

joan/sea.any.051.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.051.spoken: Whatever's overhead is drowning out the surf.

joan/sea.any.052.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.052.spoken: I can hear it through the cabin wall.

joan/sea.any.056.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.056.spoken: I lost the sound behind the ridge. Might come round again.

joan/sea.any.057.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.057.spoken: It's still there when the wind drops.

joan/sea.any.058.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.058.spoken: I've got a better listen here away from the pit.

joan/sea.any.060.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.060.spoken: It went quiet quick. Must be farther off now.

joan/sea.any.061.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.061.spoken: Up over the treeline. You've got a helicopter coming past.

joan/sea.any.062.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.062.spoken: There it goes over camp. Look up.

joan/sea.any.064.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.064.spoken: It's crossing the clearing. You've got a few seconds.

joan/sea.any.066.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.066.spoken: There it is, just above the ridge.

joan/sea.any.067.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.067.spoken: It turned after it passed the yard.

joan/sea.any.069.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.069.spoken: I saw it go over the far slope and turn back in.

joan/sea.any.072.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.072.spoken: It's holding out over the coast now.

joan/sea.any.073.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.073.spoken: You can see it between those two tops.

joan/sea.any.075.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.075.spoken: I saw the tail vanish behind the ridge. Keep watching that gap.

joan/sea.any.076.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.076.spoken: Looks like the next pass is taking it farther inland.

joan/sea.any.077.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.077.spoken: It went across the bay and curved back toward the island.

joan/sea.any.079.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.079.spoken: I saw it pass the dock. It kept right on going.

joan/sea.any.080.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.080.spoken: There it goes toward the water. You can see it against the haze.

joan/sea.any.082.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.082.spoken: Watch the back of the ship. The helicopter's coming down.

joan/sea.any.083.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.083.spoken: It went back to the same deck it came from.

joan/sea.any.085.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.085.spoken: It's over the ship now. Looks like they're bringing it in.

joan/sea.any.087.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.087.spoken: I watched the ship come round to the same stretch of water.

joan/sea.any.089.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.089.spoken: It made the whole round. I caught it on both sides of the island.

joan/sea.any.090.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.090.spoken: Same hull as the one I saw a few days ago.

joan/sea.any.091.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.091.spoken: Last time I watched it slow down at this same stretch.

joan/sea.any.092.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.092.spoken: The first time I only saw the ship. Today I saw what was on it.

joan/sea.any.095.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.095.spoken: The ship's heading away now. Wake's pointing straight out.

joan/sea.any.096.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.096.spoken: I lost it after it turned seaward.

joan/sea.any.097.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.097.spoken: The rotor sound went with it after the helicopter came down.

joan/sea.any.098.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.098.spoken: Yesterday there was nothing on the horizon from this spot. I checked.

joan/sea.any.099.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.099.spoken: It's gone around the point again. I wonder how far out it goes after.

joan/sea.any.101.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.101.spoken: You saw the helicopter. Did you see where it came from?

joan/sea.any.107.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.107.spoken: I went out to look after you called. I only caught the wake.

joan/sea.any.108.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.108.spoken: I've got nothing better than a guess about what they're doing.

joan/sea.any.109.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.109.spoken: The way you describe it, I'd have sworn they were coming in.

joan/sea.any.112.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.112.spoken: One person sees a boat and by supper we've got an expedition.

joan/sea.any.115.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.115.spoken: I can't tell what anyone wants from a wake and a bit of noise.

joan/sea.any.119.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.any.119.spoken: Next time, tell me before it gets behind the ridge.

joan/sea.joan.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.025.spoken: Still out there. I thought it'd have gone by now.

joan/sea.joan.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.028.spoken: Whole lot of ocean out there and it chooses this bit to slow down.

joan/sea.joan.037.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.037.spoken: Wish I knew what counted as normal ship speed.

joan/sea.joan.038.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.038.spoken: If it's checking the coast, it's getting a long look at this yard.

joan/sea.joan.070.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.070.spoken: It came across the whole stand we cleared yesterday.

joan/sea.joan.104.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.104.spoken: How far out was it when you saw it slow down?

joan/sea.joan.114.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.114.spoken: They had a view of every stump we left.

joan/sea.joan.116.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.116.spoken: You can call it routine. I'd still like to know whose routine.

joan/sea.joan.120.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/sea.joan.120.spoken: Funny how quiet the yard felt after it went.

joan/surv.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/surv.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/surv.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/surv.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.008.spoken: I used to have a word for all this. Nonsense. I've lost the word.

joan/surv.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.009.spoken: Talk to me. Quietly. Just so I know you're still there.

joan/surv.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.012.spoken: The company left right on schedule. Shame it was only their schedule.

joan/surv.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.013.spoken: Is that the ship? That's the ship.

joan/surv.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.014.spoken: One at a time on the gangway. Hold the rail.

joan/surv.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.015.spoken: I won't say their name yet. On the boat.

joan/surv.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.016.spoken: One of us walked off before all this. I hope they're hiding well.

joan/surv.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.017.spoken: There's so few of us now. Stay where I can see you.

joan/surv.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.018.spoken: Your watch. Wake me if anything changes. Anything at all.

joan/surv.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.019.spoken: Not everyone's getting on. I know. Keep walking anyway.

joan/surv.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.020.spoken: Go on, Biscuit. Up you go. We're right behind you.

joan/surv.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.021.spoken: I'm not leaving cover, boss. Not for anything.

joan/surv.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.any.022.spoken: Last night of it. Hold on till the light.

joan/surv.joan.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.001.spoken: Well, loves. That's the company. I always said they'd run up the tab and walk out the back door.

joan/surv.joan.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/surv.joan.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.003.spoken: Quiet as a cellar. Quiet as a cellar.

joan/surv.joan.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.004.spoken: I can make three tins feed four if nobody's fussy. And nobody's allowed to be fussy, loves.

joan/surv.joan.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.005.spoken: Sleep, love. I'll sit up. I'm too old to sleep through this anyway.

joan/surv.joan.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.006.spoken: How did you sleep, you? Don't lie to me. Nobody did.

joan/surv.joan.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.007.spoken: We'll raise a glass for them on the boat, loves. Just the one. Then we get on.

joan/surv.joan.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.008.spoken: I hope the one who walked out is tucked up somewhere, love. I'd forgive them a lot for being alive.

joan/surv.joan.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.009.spoken: Still here, loves. Count yourselves. Still here.

joan/surv.joan.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.010.spoken: Biscuit's under the dock with his water bowl and his own little roof. Spoiled rotten, that dog. Good.

joan/surv.joan.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.011.spoken: Don't you blame yourself, boss-love. Blame the people who had the boat.

joan/surv.joan.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.012.spoken: I used to say it was all forums and ghost stories, love. I've stopped saying that.

joan/surv.joan.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.013.spoken: Two more nights, loves. I've lived through worse weeks behind a bar. Not many, mind.

joan/surv.joan.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.014.spoken: Up you go, sunshine. Don't look back at the trees. Look at the boat.

joan/surv.joan.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.015.spoken: Thank you for getting us this far, boss-love. Now get on that ship before I carry you on.

joan/surv.joan.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.016.spoken: Not out there, boss-love. Ask me to cook, ask me to keep watch. Not that.

joan/surv.joan.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.017.spoken: Give me a second, love. I'm listening, not talking. Just for a second.

joan/surv.joan.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.018.spoken: House rules, loves: nobody goes alone, nobody goes far, and everybody eats something.

joan/surv.joan.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.019.spoken: And I'll handle the kitchen, so at least the food won't kill anyone.

joan/surv.joan.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/surv.joan.020.spoken: Leave a space at the rail for them, love. Just stand next to it. That's enough.

joan/tool.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

joan/tool.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
joan/tool.any.002.spoken: Too loud to talk. Wave if you need me.

joan/tool.joan.020.spoken: You'd manage, love. I've seen what you do with a teaspoon and a jar of jam.

marta/boss.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.any.007.spoken: I'm owed, boss. When will it be paid?

marta/boss.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.any.008.spoken: All paid, boss. No complaints from me.

marta/boss.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/boss.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/boss.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.any.011.spoken: Not at dusk, boss. I'm heading in.

marta/boss.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.any.015.spoken: Crew's in decent spirits, boss. Mostly. Supper helps.

marta/boss.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/boss.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.001.spoken: Boss. Morning's half gone already. What do you need?

marta/boss.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.002.spoken: Chief. Come to watch an expert, or come to hand out orders?

marta/boss.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.003.spoken: Boss. Make it quick. The light's going and I want everyone in.

marta/boss.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.004.spoken: Twenty-odd days and you still turn up when I'm mid-cut. Go on, then.

marta/boss.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.005.spoken: Felling. Notch is in, back cut next. Stand clear of the lean, boss.

marta/boss.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.006.spoken: Bucking it into carry lengths. Square ends, so the stack sits flat.

marta/boss.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.007.spoken: Taking the stump down flat. Nobody trips on one of my stumps.

marta/boss.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.008.spoken: Carrying. I'd rather be felling, but somebody has to feed the cradle.

marta/boss.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.009.spoken: Stacking the decks. Tight rows. A loose stack wastes the fire.

marta/boss.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.010.spoken: Nothing in my hands, boss, and I don't like it. Give me a lane and I'll fill it.

marta/boss.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.011.spoken: Riding out to the next lane. Saves the legs for the cutting.

marta/boss.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.012.spoken: Yard's full, boss. Cradle's stacked and the decks too. Move logs to the fire or put someone on the yard, or I stop dropping trees.

marta/boss.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.013.spoken: Somebody's working my lane. I don't drop trees on people. Clear it or send me to the next one.

marta/boss.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.014.spoken: No trunk marked anywhere near me. Point me at a lane and I'm gone.

marta/boss.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.015.spoken: No axe, boss. Can't fell with my bare hands. Get me one off the rack.

marta/boss.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.016.spoken: Waiting on a second pair of hands for this trunk. Send me someone and it moves.

marta/boss.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.017.spoken: I saw something past the lanes. It wasn't wind and it wasn't a deer. It stopped when I stopped. Everyone in by dusk.

marta/boss.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.018.spoken: I heard it moving after everything else had gone quiet. That's all. Get the others in. Now, boss.

marta/boss.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.019.spoken: There's a story going round. I didn't see anything myself. Wind in the tops, most likely.

marta/boss.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.020.spoken: Strange? Only the company's idea of a schedule. I haven't seen anything out there.

marta/boss.marta.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.021.spoken: Animals in the brush and wind in the crowns. That's all I've got for you, boss.

marta/boss.marta.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.022.spoken: I'm owed, boss. I don't work for free. When does it land?

marta/boss.marta.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.023.spoken: Owed at nightfall and still owed today. That's not a pattern I like, boss. Pay me or tell me straight.

marta/boss.marta.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.024.spoken: Paid up. Good. Nothing to talk about, then.

marta/boss.marta.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.025.spoken: Pay's landed on time every round. I notice that, boss. Keep it that way.

marta/boss.marta.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.026.spoken: It's the job, boss. But I heard you. Thanks.

marta/boss.marta.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.027.spoken: Don't make a habit of it, chief. I'll go soft.

marta/boss.marta.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.028.spoken: Clean stumps don't happen by accident. Glad somebody looked.

marta/boss.marta.029.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.029.spoken: Twenty years on contracts and most bosses never said it once. Thank you. Now let me get on.

marta/boss.marta.030.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.030.spoken: Wood doesn't cut itself, boss. That's the whole philosophy. There isn't a second page.

marta/boss.marta.031.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.031.spoken: I sharpen before supper. Sharp axe, short day. Blunt axe, long night.

marta/boss.marta.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.032.spoken: We're past the slow part. The crew knows its lanes now. Days go quicker from here.

marta/boss.marta.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.033.spoken: More stumps than trees now, boss. I've been counting. Don't ask me to stop.

marta/boss.marta.034.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.034.spoken: Understood, boss. That lane's mine, then. I'll start at the far end.

marta/boss.marta.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.035.spoken: Fine. That lane, then. Give me an hour.

marta/boss.marta.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.036.spoken: Right. I'll do it, and I'll do it clean.

marta/boss.marta.037.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.037.spoken: I'll do it. I don't agree with it, but I'll do it.

marta/boss.marta.038.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.038.spoken: No, boss. Not today. Ask me tomorrow.

marta/boss.marta.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.039.spoken: Light's gone, boss. Nobody cuts now. We go in.

marta/boss.marta.040.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.040.spoken: No. Not at this hour. Not after what I saw. Everyone inside, you included.

marta/boss.marta.041.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.041.spoken: Pay what's owed and I'll pick the axe back up. Until then, no.

marta/boss.marta.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.042.spoken: Yard's choking, boss. Somebody on the fire pile or we all stand around.

marta/boss.marta.043.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.043.spoken: Trunk's down, boss. Ready for carrying as soon as I've bucked it.

marta/boss.marta.044.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.044.spoken: I need an axe, boss. My hands are free, and that's the problem.

marta/boss.marta.045.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/boss.marta.045.spoken: Dale's sulking over the count. Leave him be. He'll come round by supper.

marta/camp.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/camp.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.002.spoken: Short break. Water and a bit of shade.

marta/camp.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.003.spoken: Hello, Biscuit. No, I haven't got anything. Honest.

marta/camp.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.004.spoken: Lights out soon. Big day tomorrow.

marta/camp.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.005.spoken: Kettle's just boiled if anyone wants one.

marta/camp.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.006.spoken: Who's on dishes tonight? Not me. I did them yesterday.

marta/camp.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/camp.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.008.spoken: Somebody's socks are drying on the heater again.

marta/camp.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.009.spoken: Has anyone beaten the top score on the arcade yet?

marta/camp.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.010.spoken: Come on, cards. Everyone in. Nobody's tired, they're just pretending.

marta/camp.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.011.spoken: Biscuit! Come here, you. Who's fed you today? Everyone? Of course they have.

marta/camp.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.013.spoken: Sharpening tonight so I'm straight out in the morning.

marta/camp.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.019.spoken: Whoever's rustling that crisp packet, please be done with it.

marta/camp.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.020.spoken: Evening, boss. Dinner's on in the cabin.

marta/camp.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.021.spoken: Rain on the cabin roof. Not the worst sound to rest to.

marta/camp.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.any.022.spoken: Another letter for the boat pile. It's getting thick.

marta/camp.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.001.spoken: Boots off, gloves on the rail. Same order every night. It's how you find them in the morning.

marta/camp.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.002.spoken: Dinner, sharpen, bed. In that order. Don't let anyone talk you into cards first.

marta/camp.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.003.spoken: Biscuit. Sit. Good. No, that's mine. Go and find Dale.

marta/camp.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.004.spoken: Somebody left a mug in the sink with the teabag still in it. I'm counting mugs now.

marta/camp.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.005.spoken: Joan's put my name on the high-score board. I've never touched the machine. I'm not starting now.

marta/camp.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.006.spoken: Shirts on the line before dark, or they'll smell of smoke all week.

marta/camp.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.007.spoken: Cards tonight? One hand. Then I'm asleep, I mean it.

marta/camp.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.008.spoken: Ten-minute lunch. Sandwich, water, sharpen. The next tree won't wait.

marta/camp.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.009.spoken: Top bunk's mine. Has been since the first night. I like being able to see the whole room.

marta/camp.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.010.spoken: Dale. It's always Dale. Earplugs are in the drawer by the sink.

marta/camp.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.011.spoken: I write the day's count in the back of my diary. That's my letter home, near enough.

marta/camp.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.012.spoken: Kettle's on. Don't touch the big pan. Joan's got plans for it.

marta/camp.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.013.spoken: Tell her you're doing fine. You are. Tell her that bit twice.

marta/camp.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.014.spoken: You've already eaten, Dale. I watched you.

marta/camp.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.015.spoken: Who let the dog on the bunk? Off. Off. Fine. Five minutes, and I'm counting.

marta/camp.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
