marta/camp.marta.016.spoken: Everyone in? I'm counting heads before I sit down.

marta/camp.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.017.spoken: Evening, chief. Kettle's on in the cabin if you want one. Don't tell Joan I offered.

marta/camp.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.018.spoken: Fine. Same as always. Why, what did Dale do?

marta/camp.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/camp.marta.019.spoken: Shower gives you two minutes of hot water. I take one. The rest of you can fight over the other.

marta/cut.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.001.spoken: Tree coming down! Clear the lane!

marta/cut.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/cut.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.003.spoken: Next trunk's ready to section when you are.

marta/cut.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.004.spoken: Stump's done. Moving on to the next.

marta/cut.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.005.spoken: One more before the break. There's always room for one more.

marta/cut.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.010.spoken: Good rhythm today. We should work the same lane more often.

marta/cut.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.012.spoken: Bark's slippery. Mind the blade on the wet side.

marta/cut.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.013.spoken: Too gusty to drop anything. I'll section what's already down.

marta/cut.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.014.spoken: Nothing marked near me, boss. Point me at a tree and I'll drop it.

marta/cut.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.015.spoken: Can't cut with bare hands, boss. I need something off the tool rack first.

marta/cut.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.016.spoken: Lane's occupied. I'll hold off until they're out of the fall zone.

marta/cut.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.018.spoken: Mud all round the stump. Roots are greasy today.

marta/cut.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.019.spoken: The line's moving. You can see daylight through the first stands now.

marta/cut.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.020.spoken: Short, even lengths. Easier on whoever's carrying.

marta/cut.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.021.spoken: Dusk. Finish the cut and leave the rest for morning.

marta/cut.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.023.spoken: Felled, sectioned and ready to haul, boss. Point me at the next.

marta/cut.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.024.spoken: Saw's running. If you need me, shout, then shout louder.

marta/cut.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.026.spoken: Late in the contract and the trunks don't get any lighter.

marta/cut.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.any.028.spoken: Coming. Mark where you want the first cut.

marta/cut.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.001.spoken: Hinge is set. Back cut now. Stay out of the lane.

marta/cut.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.002.spoken: Down. That's the day's count up by one. Next one.

marta/cut.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.003.spoken: Trunk's limbed. You take the top end, I'll section the butt.

marta/cut.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.004.spoken: Clean stump. Flat enough to set a mug on.

marta/cut.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.005.spoken: Wood doesn't cut itself. Small axe, small bites, same tree on the ground.

marta/cut.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.006.spoken: Lane clear behind you? I'm about to drop this one.

marta/cut.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.007.spoken: Felling, boss. Notch is in, hinge is even. She'll go where I put her.

marta/cut.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.008.spoken: Yard's full, chief. I can drop trees all day, but the cradle can't take another log.

marta/cut.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.009.spoken: Wet bark. Watch your footing on the trunk, it's like soap.

marta/cut.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.010.spoken: Last one before dark. Nobody starts another after this.

marta/cut.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.011.spoken: Forty percent down, give or take. I've been counting stumps on the walk out.

marta/cut.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.012.spoken: Rotten heart on this stump. Comes apart in handfuls. Easy money.

marta/cut.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.013.spoken: Dale, short sections on this one. No showing off with the long ones.

marta/cut.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.014.spoken: Big axe on a trunk this thick. Three swings to the hinge, then I'm counting.

marta/cut.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.015.spoken: Report, boss: I've dropped my share today and the next one's already notched.

marta/cut.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.016.spoken: Wind's pushing the crown. I'll wait for a lull before the back cut.

marta/cut.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.017.spoken: Waiting on the lane. Someone's bucking right where this one wants to land.

marta/cut.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.018.spoken: Preeya's notches are getting cleaner. Don't anyone tell her I said so.

marta/cut.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.019.spoken: Pinched the cut. Wedge it, don't wrestle it.

marta/cut.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.020.spoken: You've out-talked me. The count says otherwise.

marta/cut.marta.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/cut.marta.021.spoken: Somewhere. Never found it. Next one, Joan.

marta/dusk.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.007.spoken: Who's walking with me? Nobody walks in alone tonight.

marta/dusk.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.008.spoken: One more cut and... no. Dusk is dusk. Tools down.

marta/dusk.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.011.spoken: Light's going. Tools away and get inside.

marta/dusk.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.012.spoken: Let's not hang about near the fence, you.

marta/dusk.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.013.spoken: I don't want to talk about it. I want to get inside.

marta/dusk.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.014.spoken: I'm not going back out tonight, boss. I'm sorry. Ask me again at first light.

marta/dusk.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.015.spoken: I saw something past the fence. I can't tell you what it was. I'm sure it was there.

marta/dusk.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.016.spoken: Only stories, boss. Nothing I've seen with my own eyes.

marta/dusk.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.017.spoken: Stick close, dog. We're both going in.

marta/dusk.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.018.spoken: Somebody check the door's latched. Then check it once more.

marta/dusk.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.019.spoken: Wind's making every branch sound like a footstep.

marta/dusk.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.020.spoken: Everybody here? Say your name if you're in.

marta/dusk.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.any.023.spoken: Enough people have said it now, you. I can't keep waving it off.

marta/dusk.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.001.spoken: Tools on the rack, then inside. That's the order. Every evening, same order.

marta/dusk.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.002.spoken: Sound off as you come through the entrance. I'm counting, and I want the number to match the morning.

marta/dusk.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.003.spoken: Good count today. Not good enough to stay out for. Nothing is.

marta/dusk.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.004.spoken: I'm not discussing it. Everyone inside by dusk. That's all I'm saying, and I'm only saying it once.

marta/dusk.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.005.spoken: Past the far deck, last night. Something upright, still as a post. There's no post there. I checked this morning.

marta/dusk.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.006.spoken: Wind in the tops, you. That's what it always is. Somebody tells a story and the wind grows a face.

marta/dusk.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.007.spoken: Don't like this light. Every trunk at the tree line looks like it's leaning toward us.

marta/dusk.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.008.spoken: Boss. I'm calling everyone in early tonight. You can dock me for it. I'm doing it anyway.

marta/dusk.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.009.spoken: No, boss. Not after dusk. I'll cut double tomorrow, but I'm not walking back out there now.

marta/dusk.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.010.spoken: you, stop staring at the trees and walk. Staring never got anyone home faster.

marta/dusk.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.011.spoken: Fence is up and the lamps are lit. That's what we've got. Stay in the light and get to bed.

marta/dusk.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.012.spoken: Three knocks on the back wall, last night, evenly spaced. I didn't open it. I won't. Neither will any of you.

marta/dusk.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/dusk.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.014.spoken: The dog wouldn't come off the porch last night, you. Wouldn't look at the trees, either. Make of that what you like.

marta/dusk.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.015.spoken: I'll sharpen everything on the rack tonight. Keeps the hands busy.

marta/dusk.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.016.spoken: Somebody heard a noise in a forest. That's not news. That's a forest.

marta/dusk.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.017.spoken: Wind's got the tops going. That's the noise. That's all that noise is.

marta/dusk.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.018.spoken: Twenty years, you, and I've never once regretted being indoors before dark.

marta/dusk.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.019.spoken: I saw what I saw, boss. I'm not adding anything to it. Everyone in by dusk and you'll hear no more from me.

marta/dusk.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/dusk.marta.020.spoken: Strange? I've heard stories, boss. I've cut in worse places than this and come home every time.

marta/eth.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.001.spoken: Thanks, boss. Good to know someone's keeping count.

marta/eth.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.002.spoken: Moved up a level. Feels earned, for once.

marta/eth.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.003.spoken: Nowhere to set this down. Yard's full up.

marta/eth.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.004.spoken: Path's blocked ahead. Going round or waiting, one or the other.

marta/eth.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.005.spoken: This one needs two. Waiting for a spare pair of hands.

marta/eth.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.006.spoken: Nothing left on the rack I can use. Somebody bring one back.

marta/eth.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.007.spoken: No marked trees near me. Waiting on direction.

marta/eth.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.008.spoken: Bad grip, short drop. Lifting it again.

marta/eth.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.009.spoken: On it, boss. Next one's mine.

marta/eth.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.010.spoken: Good day, all. Same again tomorrow, and maybe the yard can keep up for once.

marta/eth.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.011.spoken: I'm only stood here because the yard's full, boss. Clear it and I'm straight back.

marta/eth.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.012.spoken: Short break, then straight back out. No sense wasting the light.

marta/eth.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.013.spoken: Good pace today. Couple more before dusk if the yard keeps up.

marta/eth.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.017.spoken: Good work today, everyone. Somebody should say it out loud, so I will.

marta/eth.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.any.022.spoken: Saw's pinched. Wedge it, ease it out, start again.

marta/eth.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.001.spoken: Just doing the job, boss. Though I'll take it. Wood doesn't cut itself, but it's nice when someone notices.

marta/eth.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.002.spoken: Appreciated, chief. Don't make a habit of it or I'll start expecting it.

marta/eth.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.003.spoken: New level. Twenty years in and they still find things to grade me on. Fine. I'll take it.

marta/eth.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.004.spoken: Somebody's been cutting to the marks all day without one wonky stump. I noticed. That's all.

marta/eth.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.005.spoken: Cradle's the bottleneck. I can fell faster than that fire can eat.

marta/eth.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.006.spoken: Waiting on a second pair of hands. Minutes add up. So does my temper.

marta/eth.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.007.spoken: Notch came out shallow. My mistake. Recutting it before anyone sees.

marta/eth.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.008.spoken: Pinched the bar. Should've wedged first. Twenty years and I still need telling.

marta/eth.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.009.spoken: Trees are coming down clean today, boss. Faster still if the yard keeps up.

marta/eth.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.010.spoken: Five minutes. Water, sharpen, then the next one.

marta/eth.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.011.spoken: Nobody's slacking. The route's blocked. Say it how it is.

marta/eth.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.012.spoken: Lost too much of today waiting on the yard. Tomorrow I count the minutes, and the boss gets the number.

marta/eth.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.013.spoken: Yard's full, boss. Cradle's stacked and the fire's slow. The cutting isn't the problem.

marta/eth.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.014.spoken: Rack's empty, boss. Give me a tool and I'll give you a tree.

marta/eth.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.015.spoken: More than you, Dale, and every stump flat enough to set a cup on.

marta/eth.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.016.spoken: I stop when the day stops. That's the deal I made with the day.

marta/eth.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.017.spoken: It counts. You fix it anyway, and you remember it next time.

marta/eth.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.018.spoken: You did fine. Better than fine. Stop asking, you'll wear it out.

marta/eth.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.019.spoken: Give it to whoever kept the yard moving. That's the real work today.

marta/eth.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.020.spoken: Flush stump. Nobody'll ever look at it twice, and that's how you know it's right.

marta/eth.marta.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.021.spoken: Sit down while you can, you. When that yard clears, it'll all come at once.

marta/eth.marta.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/eth.marta.022.spoken: That's practice. Took me years to get them like that. Whoever it is, they're quicker than I was.

marta/grp.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.any.001.spoken: Anyone else's boots still wet from yesterday? Mine squelch when I think about them.

marta/grp.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.any.002.spoken: Stuff them with newspaper. Oh, wait. No newspaper. Stuff them with somebody's spare socks.

marta/grp.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.any.003.spoken: Line them up by the stove, all of them. We'll make a little boot parade.

marta/grp.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.any.005.spoken: I'll take the other end. Somebody pass me the short lengths.

marta/grp.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.any.006.spoken: Feed both ends and it'll burn twice as fast. The cradle needs the room.

marta/grp.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.any.009.spoken: One more trunk would finish the lane. But I'll leave it for the morning.

marta/grp.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.any.011.spoken: Who's got a story? Not a scary one. A daft one.

marta/grp.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.any.012.spoken: I once lost a whole truck in a car park. Found it three hours later. Wrong car park.

marta/grp.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.001.spoken: Porridge. Quick. The first trunk's waiting and it won't fell itself.

marta/grp.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.002.spoken: Eat faster, all of you. Twelve minutes and we're back on the lane.

marta/grp.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.003.spoken: Eight. Fine. I'll spend them sharpening.

marta/grp.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.004.spoken: He doesn't. And I know the real number, so you'd better have it right, Joan.

marta/grp.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.005.spoken: Decks are filling and the fire's slow. We stack tight tonight or we lose half a morning tomorrow.

marta/grp.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.006.spoken: Do it Preeya's way. She's right, and I want us all in before dark.

marta/grp.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.007.spoken: Good. That one's earned. Tomorrow we start earning the next.

marta/grp.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.008.spoken: Then we cut high this morning and come down once it drains.

marta/grp.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.009.spoken: Ground rules, for anyone new or anyone who's forgotten. One feller per lane. Shout before it goes. The cradle isn't a bench.

marta/grp.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.010.spoken: You racked it upside down once and never again. That's all anyone needs from a new hand.

marta/grp.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.011.spoken: I hope they can fell. We're a pair of hands short, and the count shows it.

marta/grp.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.012.spoken: More than half gone. The second half always feels slower. It isn't. Keep going.

marta/grp.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.013.spoken: Mostly the axes. Then me. Then you, Dale, hauling it all off. Fair's fair.

marta/grp.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.014.spoken: Everyone to the north lanes today. Fell the lot, haul it tomorrow. Faster that way.

marta/grp.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.015.spoken: Split it, then. Two fell, the rest haul. But I'm on the axe.

marta/grp.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.016.spoken: Your back's had a vote every day this month, Dale. It always votes for lunch.

marta/grp.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.017.spoken: The boss has enough on. We sort our own lanes. Always have.

marta/grp.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.018.spoken: Sun off the water, or a lantern someone forgot. Don't start the night on a story.

marta/grp.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.019.spoken: Don't laugh at that one, Dale. Just get inside before the light goes.

marta/grp.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.020.spoken: Whoever it is had energy left over after the day's cut. I'll find them more work.

marta/grp.marta.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.021.spoken: Get it off him before it's chewed. Gloves aren't free. Neither's jam.

marta/grp.marta.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.022.spoken: Count starts now. I want twenty trunks at the cradle by dusk, and I want the stumps clean.

marta/grp.marta.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.023.spoken: Company's late with the pay. I'm telling the boss so tomorrow. Plainly.

marta/grp.marta.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.024.spoken: Slow's fine. Stuck isn't. You know the difference better than I do.

marta/grp.marta.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.025.spoken: I count every evening too. Keep walking. I'll do it again at the gate.

marta/grp.marta.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.026.spoken: Then we re-mark them. Ten minutes now saves a trunk across the lane later.

marta/grp.marta.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/grp.marta.027.spoken: Everyone in by dusk from now on. No stragglers, no last trunk. I'm not discussing why.

marta/haul.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.001.spoken: Coming through with a log! Mind your heads.

marta/haul.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/haul.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.003.spoken: Grab the other end? This one's a two-person job.

marta/haul.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.007.spoken: Straight back for the next one. No point walking empty.

marta/haul.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.009.spoken: Walk back with me? The haul feels shorter with someone to talk to.

marta/haul.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.013.spoken: Waiting on the cradle, boss. Someone's unloading ahead of me.

marta/haul.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.014.spoken: Nothing to carry near me, boss. Is there a pile somewhere else?

marta/haul.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.015.spoken: Storm's picking up. Get this one in and we'll see.

marta/haul.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.016.spoken: Fire's struggling in the rain. Take the dry logs from the middle of the deck.

marta/haul.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.017.spoken: Watch the stump on your right. Ankle height, nasty.

marta/haul.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.018.spoken: Two-person carries are slow, but nobody's back gives out.

marta/haul.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.019.spoken: Fire pile's burned down a bit. Room for a few more.

marta/haul.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.020.spoken: Leave the rest on the deck. It'll keep till morning.

marta/haul.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.021.spoken: Same route, same log size, same sore shoulder.

marta/haul.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.022.spoken: Hardly anything left to haul from out here. Odd to see it so bare.

marta/haul.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.024.spoken: That's my deliveries done for now. Fire's got plenty.

marta/haul.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.025.spoken: Cradle's clear. Let's get another load in before the fire catches up.

marta/haul.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.026.spoken: Dry day. Bark's light and the road's firm. Good hauling.

marta/haul.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.any.027.spoken: Load the handcart and push. Beats carrying them one at a time.

marta/haul.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/haul.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.001.spoken: Log on the shoulder. Twelve more and this lane's clear.

marta/haul.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.002.spoken: Cradle's emptied. Decks are filling nicely. Keep them coming.

marta/haul.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.003.spoken: That team carry earlier was the cleanest one yet. Same again.

marta/haul.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.004.spoken: Cradle's full and the decks are stacked to the top, boss. The fire's the bottleneck, not the crew.

marta/haul.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.005.spoken: Hauling, boss. Route's clear, logs are moving. That's all I ask of a day.

marta/haul.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.006.spoken: Stack them butt to butt. Tidy deck, quick fire.

marta/haul.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.007.spoken: Dale, you've got the heavy end. Don't make that face.

marta/haul.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.008.spoken: Mud on the haul road. Short steps, people.

marta/haul.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.009.spoken: Last load's in. Fire's banked. Everyone inside before dark.

marta/haul.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.010.spoken: Report, boss: I've been delivering all day. Lost count past twenty, which annoys me more than the walking.

marta/haul.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.011.spoken: Route's blocked by a fallen crown. Clear it, or we all walk the long way round.

marta/haul.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.012.spoken: Swap shoulders at the stump. You'll thank me tomorrow.

marta/haul.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.013.spoken: Fire pile's hungry. Feed it the dry ones first.

marta/haul.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.014.spoken: Lost half the morning waiting on that yard. Making it up now.

marta/haul.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.015.spoken: Half the island's gone, and the walk to the yard gets longer every day.

marta/haul.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.016.spoken: Wind's on the fire. Keep the decks clear of the sparks.

marta/haul.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.017.spoken: Tomas is hauling faster than last week. Someone tell him before he apologises for it.

marta/haul.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.018.spoken: Day twenty-something. I could walk this haul road with my eyes shut.

marta/haul.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.019.spoken: Fire burns slow, boss. Like a budget. You can't rush either one.

marta/haul.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.020.spoken: Handcart's free. Load it to the rail, no higher, and push.

marta/haul.marta.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/haul.marta.021.spoken: No. I'll count them myself and tell you which number is higher.

marta/pair.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.001.spoken: Your end's dipping. Lift a bit or we'll both be wearing it.

marta/pair.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.002.spoken: My end's fine. It's your end telling stories.

marta/pair.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.003.spoken: So where are you from, then? Properly, not what's on the company form.

marta/pair.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.004.spoken: Small place. You'd drive through and never notice. That's the charm of it.

marta/pair.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.008.spoken: Not a chance. I'm not handing you the bragging rights.

marta/pair.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.010.spoken: Not mine either. Hang it on the fence post. Someone'll claim it.

marta/pair.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.012.spoken: Slow is good. Slow is my favourite speed.

marta/pair.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.014.spoken: Stories grow out here. There's not much else to do after dark.

marta/pair.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.any.015.spoken: Next one's ready. You notch, I'll clear the brush.

marta/pair.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/pair.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.001.spoken: Your count today, Dale. Out with it. Mine's scratched on the axe handle.

marta/pair.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.002.spoken: Carrying isn't felling. Wood doesn't cut itself, and it doesn't count itself either.

marta/pair.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.003.spoken: If it's like me, it'll reach the cradle before you do.

marta/pair.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.004.spoken: Same bet as last week, Dale? Lowest count sharpens both axes before breakfast.

marta/pair.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.005.spoken: Lunch is twenty minutes. Yours was forty. I timed it.

marta/pair.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.006.spoken: Twenty days and you've not once asked nicely.

marta/pair.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.007.spoken: Two more before the light goes, Dale. We've got the time if we don't dawdle.

marta/pair.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.008.spoken: Ten minutes. Eat walking. I'm counting.

marta/pair.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.009.spoken: Some of us don't learn, Dale. Some of us just buy better boots. Pass the bread.

marta/pair.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.010.spoken: Preeya, read this lean for me. Where does it want to go?

marta/pair.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.011.spoken: Good eye. Thicker hinge on the right, then. Watch it go.

marta/pair.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.012.spoken: You're rushing the back cut. Level first. Speed comes later, on its own.

marta/pair.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.013.spoken: Twenty years of ugly stumps first. Yours are better than mine were at your age.

marta/pair.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.014.spoken: Rules are for before you know when to break them. Write that down as well.

marta/pair.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.015.spoken: You've been calling the lean before I do lately. When did that start?

marta/pair.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.016.spoken: That's the right instinct. Most people brag after the first one.

marta/pair.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.017.spoken: Long way costs us minutes on every trip. I'll take wet boots.

marta/pair.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.018.spoken: Long enough for three more trunks. Ask me again after the second.

marta/pair.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.019.spoken: Tomas, your notch is fine. Stop checking it. Cut.

marta/pair.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.020.spoken: I said it once. Don't make me sorry I did.

marta/pair.marta.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.021.spoken: You drive better than you cut, Tomas. That's a compliment. Take it.

marta/pair.marta.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.022.spoken: You stayed out through the last carry today, Tomas. That was good work.

marta/pair.marta.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.023.spoken: Be as nervous as you like. Just keep showing up like that.

marta/pair.marta.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.024.spoken: We're not heading in yet, Tomas. The light's fine. You keep looking at the sky.

marta/pair.marta.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.025.spoken: That's exactly the problem. Ten minutes is a whole trunk.

marta/pair.marta.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.026.spoken: Joan, you're chatting to that tree again.

marta/pair.marta.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.027.spoken: Three and a half. I was counting too.

marta/pair.marta.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.028.spoken: Hinge wood. Clean, even hinge wood. Best night I've had in ages.

marta/pair.marta.029.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/pair.marta.029.spoken: Pay's late, Joan. You've gone quiet on me.

marta/sea.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.003.spoken: Take a look offshore while there's still a gap in the fog.

marta/sea.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.004.spoken: Big ship out there. You can see it between the trees.

marta/sea.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.008.spoken: If you stand by me, you can see it over the yard fence.

marta/sea.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.012.spoken: Look where the water goes silver. It's just beyond that.

marta/sea.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.015.spoken: Wait for the next swell. The deck comes back into view.

marta/sea.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.016.spoken: I caught it in the corner of my eye while I was stacking.

marta/sea.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.018.spoken: Get a look before it goes behind the point.

marta/sea.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.020.spoken: I can see its windows flashing in the sun.

marta/sea.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.021.spoken: It was moving quicker a minute ago.

marta/sea.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.022.spoken: There's the ship again. It's taking its time past our stretch.

marta/sea.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.023.spoken: You've got time to see it. The wake's dropped right off.

marta/sea.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.027.spoken: If you missed it earlier, look now. It's barely moving.

marta/sea.any.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.032.spoken: No boat coming down from it that I can see.

marta/sea.any.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.033.spoken: It'll pass the opening in the trees in a second. Watch.

marta/sea.any.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.035.spoken: The bow's still pointed along the coast.

marta/sea.any.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.036.spoken: Might be waiting on something out there.

marta/sea.any.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.039.spoken: I didn't think I'd be able to hear it from this far out.

marta/sea.any.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.042.spoken: Hold up. There's a thump coming in over the trees.

marta/sea.any.046.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.046.spoken: Sounds like a helicopter coming closer.

marta/sea.any.047.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.047.spoken: I heard it between cuts. It kept getting louder.

marta/sea.any.048.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.048.spoken: That noise is moving. Look up if you get a clear patch.

marta/sea.any.050.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.050.spoken: Hear it? There's a low beat behind the engine noise.

marta/sea.any.051.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.051.spoken: Whatever's overhead is drowning out the surf.

marta/sea.any.052.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.052.spoken: I can hear it through the cabin wall.

marta/sea.any.056.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.056.spoken: I lost the sound behind the ridge. Might come round again.

marta/sea.any.057.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.057.spoken: It's still there when the wind drops.

marta/sea.any.058.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.058.spoken: I've got a better listen here away from the pit.

marta/sea.any.060.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.060.spoken: It went quiet quick. Must be farther off now.

marta/sea.any.061.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.061.spoken: Up over the treeline. You've got a helicopter coming past.

marta/sea.any.062.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.062.spoken: There it goes over camp. Look up.

marta/sea.any.064.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.064.spoken: It's crossing the clearing. You've got a few seconds.

marta/sea.any.066.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.066.spoken: There it is, just above the ridge.

marta/sea.any.067.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.067.spoken: It turned after it passed the yard.

marta/sea.any.069.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.069.spoken: I saw it go over the far slope and turn back in.

marta/sea.any.072.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.072.spoken: It's holding out over the coast now.

marta/sea.any.073.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.073.spoken: You can see it between those two tops.

marta/sea.any.075.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.075.spoken: I saw the tail vanish behind the ridge. Keep watching that gap.

marta/sea.any.076.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.076.spoken: Looks like the next pass is taking it farther inland.

marta/sea.any.077.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.077.spoken: It went across the bay and curved back toward the island.

marta/sea.any.079.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.079.spoken: I saw it pass the dock. It kept right on going.

marta/sea.any.080.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.080.spoken: There it goes toward the water. You can see it against the haze.

marta/sea.any.082.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.082.spoken: Watch the back of the ship. The helicopter's coming down.

marta/sea.any.083.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.083.spoken: It went back to the same deck it came from.

marta/sea.any.085.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.085.spoken: It's over the ship now. Looks like they're bringing it in.

marta/sea.any.087.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.087.spoken: I watched the ship come round to the same stretch of water.

marta/sea.any.089.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.089.spoken: It made the whole round. I caught it on both sides of the island.

marta/sea.any.090.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.090.spoken: Same hull as the one I saw a few days ago.

marta/sea.any.091.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.091.spoken: Last time I watched it slow down at this same stretch.

marta/sea.any.092.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.092.spoken: The first time I only saw the ship. Today I saw what was on it.

marta/sea.any.095.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.095.spoken: The ship's heading away now. Wake's pointing straight out.

marta/sea.any.096.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.096.spoken: I lost it after it turned seaward.

marta/sea.any.097.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.097.spoken: The rotor sound went with it after the helicopter came down.

marta/sea.any.098.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.098.spoken: Yesterday there was nothing on the horizon from this spot. I checked.

marta/sea.any.099.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.099.spoken: It's gone around the point again. I wonder how far out it goes after.

marta/sea.any.101.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.101.spoken: You saw the helicopter. Did you see where it came from?

marta/sea.any.107.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.107.spoken: I went out to look after you called. I only caught the wake.

marta/sea.any.108.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.108.spoken: I've got nothing better than a guess about what they're doing.

marta/sea.any.109.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.109.spoken: The way you describe it, I'd have sworn they were coming in.

marta/sea.any.119.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.any.119.spoken: Next time, tell me before it gets behind the ridge.

marta/sea.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.001.spoken: Boss. Past the surf. Look at the size of that hull.

marta/sea.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.007.spoken: There's a ship broadside to us. Look up from the logs.

marta/sea.marta.030.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.030.spoken: You could finish that stack before it gets past the point.

marta/sea.marta.040.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.040.spoken: It's picking up again. That's the last clear look from here.

marta/sea.marta.041.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.041.spoken: Kill the saw when you can. Hear that chopping sound?

marta/sea.marta.053.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.053.spoken: Wait until this load's down. Then have a listen.

marta/sea.marta.068.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.068.spoken: It's making another sweep. Watch the open sky.

marta/sea.marta.100.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.100.spoken: Next time we hear a rotor, somebody check the water.

marta/sea.marta.117.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/sea.marta.117.spoken: Maybe we're the only interesting thing on this coast.

marta/surv.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/surv.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/surv.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/surv.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.009.spoken: Talk to me. Quietly. Just so I know you're still there.

marta/surv.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.011.spoken: Give me something to do, boss. Anything. Idle hands shake.

marta/surv.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.012.spoken: The company left right on schedule. Shame it was only their schedule.

marta/surv.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.013.spoken: Is that the ship? That's the ship.

marta/surv.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.014.spoken: One at a time on the gangway. Hold the rail.

marta/surv.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.015.spoken: I won't say their name yet. On the boat.

marta/surv.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.016.spoken: One of us walked off before all this. I hope they're hiding well.

marta/surv.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.017.spoken: There's so few of us now. Stay where I can see you.

marta/surv.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.018.spoken: Your watch. Wake me if anything changes. Anything at all.

marta/surv.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.019.spoken: Not everyone's getting on. I know. Keep walking anyway.

marta/surv.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.020.spoken: Go on, Biscuit. Up you go. We're right behind you.

marta/surv.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.021.spoken: I'm not leaving cover, boss. Not for anything.

marta/surv.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.any.022.spoken: Last night of it. Hold on till the light.

marta/surv.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.001.spoken: Company's gone. No boat, no hires, no word. Right. Then we count what we've got.

marta/surv.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/surv.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.003.spoken: Count to a hundred. Then count again.

marta/surv.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.004.spoken: Here's the plan, boss. Nobody alone, nobody on the road, nobody out after dusk. That's the whole plan, and it's enough.

marta/surv.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.005.spoken: Two meals a day till the ship. I've counted the tins. It works if nobody gets clever with the cupboard.

marta/surv.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.006.spoken: Half of you sleep, half of you watch. I'm first watch. Don't argue. I wasn't going to sleep anyway.

marta/surv.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.007.spoken: I'll grieve on the boat. Till then, we keep moving.

marta/surv.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.008.spoken: Whoever walked off is still somewhere on this island, you. I hope they found a hole and stayed in it.

marta/surv.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.009.spoken: Five days. I've done five-day jobs in worse weather. Not with this. Still. Five days.

marta/surv.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.010.spoken: The dog's in the alcove under the dock. Leave him there, you. He's better off out of sight than following us about.

marta/surv.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.011.spoken: Day thirty-three. Three more dawns. I'm counting them like trees. One at a time, clean.

marta/surv.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.012.spoken: Walk, don't run. Running is how people end up in the water off the gangway.

marta/surv.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.013.spoken: Counting heads at the dock. I'm not leaving without a number I can live with.

marta/surv.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.014.spoken: They knew the deadline, boss. They knew what they were leaving us with. Don't you dare apologise on their behalf.

marta/surv.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.015.spoken: Hands are steady. Hands are steady. Fine. Next thing.
