marta/surv.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.016.spoken: Not out there, boss. Not while it's walking the road. Give me any job you like inside the fence.

marta/surv.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.017.spoken: Last day. Nobody gets brave today. Brave can wait till we're on the boat.

marta/surv.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.018.spoken: Right. Nobody panics, everybody listens. Five days, and a ship at the end of them. We work the problem like a job.

marta/surv.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/surv.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.020.spoken: We made it to the boat, boss. Most days I didn't think we would. Now get on it.

marta/surv.marta.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/surv.marta.021.spoken: Angry's fine. Angry keeps you awake. Just don't let it make you loud.

marta/tool.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/tool.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.002.spoken: Too loud to talk. Wave if you need me.

marta/tool.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.003.spoken: Big axe makes short work of it.

marta/tool.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.004.spoken: Small axe. Patience, and a lot more swings.

marta/tool.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.005.spoken: No tool left on the rack. Someone needs to order more.

marta/tool.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.006.spoken: Sharpening while there's light. A dull axe is a dangerous axe.

marta/tool.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.008.spoken: Quick hone and back to it. Sharp edges, quicker trees.

marta/tool.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.012.spoken: Swap stories while we hone the axes? Makes the time go quicker.

marta/tool.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.015.spoken: Helmet on before you go under that crown.

marta/tool.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.016.spoken: Good tread on these boots. The mud's not winning today.

marta/tool.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.017.spoken: Sap's glued my gloves stiff. Still better than bare hands.

marta/tool.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.018.spoken: I need a tool, boss. The camper computer can order one from the supplier.

marta/tool.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.019.spoken: Getting the hang of this. Fewer swings than last week.

marta/tool.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.020.spoken: Parcel locker's full. New gear from the supplier, I hope.

marta/tool.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.021.spoken: Wet chain flinging bark everywhere. Keep your visor down.

marta/tool.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.022.spoken: Killing the saw. Dusk is coming and I want my ears back.

marta/tool.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.023.spoken: Ten days with the big axe. I'd never go back to the small one.

marta/tool.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.024.spoken: Dry wood bites clean. The edge is holding up today.

marta/tool.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.025.spoken: On the saw, boss. Can't hear you, but I can see you're there.

marta/tool.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.026.spoken: Wind's dropping twigs on my helmet. Glad I'm wearing it.

marta/tool.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.any.028.spoken: Go on, then. You start, I'll keep the angle.

marta/tool.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.001.spoken: Edge is going dull. Ten more swings, then I sharpen.

marta/tool.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.002.spoken: Large axe. Half the swings of the small one. Worth every gram of it.

marta/tool.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.003.spoken: Running the saw, boss. Don't bother talking to me till it's off.

marta/tool.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.004.spoken: Hand signals while the saw's going. Thumb up means I'm done.

marta/tool.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.005.spoken: File, two strokes per tooth. Same count every time.

marta/tool.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.006.spoken: Rack's empty, chief. Order another axe on the camper computer, or I'm cutting with my teeth.

marta/tool.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.007.spoken: Preeya, your edge is rolled. Look, there, along the bevel.

marta/tool.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.008.spoken: Wet handle. Choke up and keep your grip dry.

marta/tool.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.009.spoken: Decent gloves. Blisters stopped on day three. I'm grateful, and I don't say that often.

marta/tool.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.010.spoken: Report, boss: the big axe is near doubling my count. Best money the company's spent out here.

marta/tool.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.011.spoken: Tomas's swing is tighter than last week. Less wasted wood in his chips.

marta/tool.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.012.spoken: Chain's stretched. Tension it now or throw it later.

marta/tool.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.013.spoken: Best tool on this island, boss? A sharp edge and somebody who keeps it that way.

marta/tool.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.014.spoken: Twenty years in and still getting faster. Don't tell the young ones.

marta/tool.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.015.spoken: Helmet on, you. Branches don't give warnings.

marta/tool.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.016.spoken: Saw doesn't mind the rain. I do.

marta/tool.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.017.spoken: Good boots. Wet slope and not one slip. Money well spent.

marta/tool.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.018.spoken: Small axe today, boss. Slower, but it never runs out of fuel.

marta/tool.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.019.spoken: Wiping the blade before we go in. Rust works overtime.

marta/tool.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/tool.marta.020.spoken: Choke off once it coughs. Pull hard, not long. There you go.

marta/wage.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.001.spoken: Pay came through clean. One less thing to think about out here.

marta/wage.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.002.spoken: Owed since nightfall. Keep swinging, keep counting.

marta/wage.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.003.spoken: I'll work while I'm owed. Not forever. Today, though.

marta/wage.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.007.spoken: Wages are in, so dinner's a proper sit-down. No excuses, no eating standing up.

marta/wage.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.011.spoken: I'm telling you straight, boss. Another day unpaid and I'm leaving on the next boat.

marta/wage.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.012.spoken: Not many names left on the payroll. Every empty bunk is louder for it.

marta/wage.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.013.spoken: Their gloves are still on the rack. Somebody should use them. Feels odd to be the one.

marta/wage.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.014.spoken: Caught up at last. Thanks for sorting it, boss.

marta/wage.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

marta/wage.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.016.spoken: Paid on time means I work on time. That's a fair trade.

marta/wage.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.019.spoken: Owed, this close to the end? That'll make for a tense boat ride, whichever way it goes.

marta/wage.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.020.spoken: Even cards are quiet tonight. Nobody bets when they're owed.

marta/wage.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.any.022.spoken: Rain on payday doesn't count. Rain on payday is just weather.

marta/wage.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.001.spoken: Three hundred a day. That's three trees to the company. I'll have mine down before the coffee's cold.

marta/wage.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.002.spoken: Twenty years and I still write every payday in the back of my diary. You count what you're owed, or nobody does.

marta/wage.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.003.spoken: This lot's going on a new roof. The old one leaks right over the stove, and I'm done cooking around a bucket.

marta/wage.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.004.spoken: Company pays by the tree, we get paid by the day. Somebody did that sum very carefully, and it wasn't us.

marta/wage.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.005.spoken: We're square, boss. I noticed. Late is late, but square is square, and I'll take square.

marta/wage.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.006.spoken: Back pay's landed. Right. Let's earn the next lot before anyone forgets how.

marta/wage.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.007.spoken: Cutting on credit today. The hinge wood doesn't care. I do.

marta/wage.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.008.spoken: Straight answer, boss. I'm owed, and I've been owed since nightfall. When does it land?

marta/wage.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.009.spoken: Fair warning, boss. If I'm still owed tomorrow night, I'm packing for the boat. Nothing personal. My rent isn't personal either.

marta/wage.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.010.spoken: Every tree I drop today, I'm adding up what it's worth and what I've seen of it. Second column's empty.

marta/wage.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.011.spoken: you, have you been paid since nightfall? No? Then it isn't just me.

marta/wage.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.012.spoken: This few hands won't clear the island by day thirty. Not unless the trees start felling themselves.

marta/wage.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.013.spoken: Fewer of us means a smaller wage bill, boss, I know. It also means fewer stumps. Don't save the money and lose the contract.

marta/wage.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.014.spoken: Empty lane next to mine now. I'll work it as well. I'm only counting it, not complaining about it.

marta/wage.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.015.spoken: We're a pair of hands short, you. Pick up the slack where you can and don't make a speech about it.

marta/wage.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.016.spoken: Pay's fine, chief. On time, every bit of it. Keep it that way and I'll keep the stumps clean.

marta/wage.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.017.spoken: I'll sleep on it once. If it's still not there by morning, I stop sleeping on it.

marta/wage.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.018.spoken: Mainland money vanishes because there's everything to spend it on. Island money piles up because there's nothing. Enjoy it while it lasts.

marta/wage.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.019.spoken: I've been stiffed by contractors before, boss. I know how it starts. It starts exactly like this.

marta/wage.marta.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.020.spoken: I know you're good for it, boss. I'd still rather have it in my hand than in your word.

marta/wage.marta.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wage.marta.021.spoken: Cook what you like. I'm eating whatever's fastest and getting back to the next one.

marta/wx.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.001.spoken: Wet bark. Slow and steady on this one.

marta/wx.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.002.spoken: Gusts in the tops. Waiting for a lull.

marta/wx.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.003.spoken: Storm's too strong to fell in. Holding off.

marta/wx.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.004.spoken: Dry and bright. Good working weather.

marta/wx.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.005.spoken: Mud's sucking at my boots. Careful steps.

marta/wx.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.006.spoken: More sky than canopy out here now.

marta/wx.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.007.spoken: Not much forest left to clear. The island looks bigger without it.

marta/wx.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.008.spoken: Sun's low. Time to wrap up.

marta/wx.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.009.spoken: Roots everywhere under this growth. Watch your ankles.

marta/wx.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.010.spoken: Halfway cleared, everyone. The second half's never quicker, but at least we know the ground now.

marta/wx.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.019.spoken: Rain's settled in, you. Good excuse for a long chat under the eaves.

marta/wx.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.020.spoken: Bit of rain never ruined a good day. Keep going.

marta/wx.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.022.spoken: Storm's up, boss. I've stopped felling till it passes.

marta/wx.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.any.023.spoken: Calm water today. You can see a long way out.

marta/wx.marta.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.001.spoken: Rain on the bark. Grip's worse, hinge is the same. Mind your feet.

marta/wx.marta.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.002.spoken: Wind's pushing the tops. Wait for the lull, then cut.

marta/wx.marta.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.003.spoken: Storm's up. Nobody fells in this. I'm not arguing about it.

marta/wx.marta.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.004.spoken: Dry ground and no rain coming. Days like this, you count high.

marta/wx.marta.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.005.spoken: Past a quarter of the island now. I've been counting. It's going.

marta/wx.marta.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.006.spoken: Half the island's down. Halfway's where crews get sloppy. Not us.

marta/wx.marta.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.007.spoken: Three quarters done. The last of it's always on the worst ground. Remember that.

marta/wx.marta.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.008.spoken: Stumps out to the next rise now. Every one of mine you could set a cup on.

marta/wx.marta.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.009.spoken: On a slope the tree wants downhill. Let it, or plan for a fight.

marta/wx.marta.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.010.spoken: Mud's taking boots. Short steps. Nobody runs with a log in this.

marta/wx.marta.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.011.spoken: Undergrowth's thick here. Clear yourself a way out before you cut. Always an escape route.

marta/wx.marta.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.012.spoken: Light's going. Last one, then in. Everyone.

marta/wx.marta.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.013.spoken: Rain's set in. Bark's slick, but the work isn't going anywhere.

marta/wx.marta.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.014.spoken: Then we change the order and take the ones leaning with it. Good eye.

marta/wx.marta.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.015.spoken: You can see water from here now. Couldn't when we started.

marta/wx.marta.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.016.spoken: Lovely. Now look at all the stumps in front of it. Also lovely.

marta/wx.marta.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.017.spoken: Birds have moved off this end. Too much noise. They'll find somewhere quieter.

marta/wx.marta.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.018.spoken: Wind's up, boss. I'm picking trees that lean with it. The rest can wait.

marta/wx.marta.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
marta/wx.marta.019.spoken: Nine in ten down. Near enough I could count what's left from the yard.

priya/boss.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.001.spoken: Boss. What can I do for you?

priya/boss.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.002.spoken: Heading to the next lane, boss. Nothing in my hands yet.

priya/boss.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.003.spoken: Heading in, boss. The light's going.

priya/boss.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.004.spoken: Yard's full, boss. Nowhere to drop logs until someone feeds the fire.

priya/boss.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.005.spoken: No axe on me, boss. I need one from the rack.

priya/boss.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.006.spoken: Haven't seen anything strange myself, boss.

priya/boss.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.007.spoken: I'm owed, boss. When will it be paid?

priya/boss.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.008.spoken: All paid, boss. No complaints from me.

priya/boss.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/boss.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/boss.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.011.spoken: Not at dusk, boss. I'm heading in.

priya/boss.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.any.018.spoken: Boss, the one I dropped is lying clean across the lane. Ready for bucking.

priya/boss.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.001.spoken: Hello, boss. Is it something specific? I'm halfway through a note.

priya/boss.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.002.spoken: Morning, boss. Mind the wind today. It's shifting, so the fall lines will too.

priya/boss.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.003.spoken: Boss. We're losing light under the canopy. What do you need?

priya/boss.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.004.spoken: Good timing, boss. I was going to ask you about the next lane.

priya/boss.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.005.spoken: Felling. The lean's slight, back and to the left. I've cut the notch to match it.

priya/boss.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.006.spoken: Bucking. I'm cutting between the knots so the lengths stack evenly.

priya/boss.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.007.spoken: Taking down the stump. Marta's standard is flat enough to set a cup on.

priya/boss.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.008.spoken: Carrying to the cradle. I'm watching the footing. The bark's slick where the sap's run.

priya/boss.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.009.spoken: Stacking. Heavy lengths on the bottom tier, so the deck doesn't shift.

priya/boss.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.010.spoken: Nothing assigned right now, boss. Is there a lane you'd like me in?

priya/boss.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.011.spoken: Riding to the next site. I'm watching the treeline as we go. Old habit from surveying.

priya/boss.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.012.spoken: The cradle and decks are full, boss. The fire's burning slower than we deliver. Someone on the yard, or logs moved to the fire, would clear it.

priya/boss.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.013.spoken: My route's blocked. Someone's working in the lane I need. Could you point me at the next one over?

priya/boss.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.014.spoken: There's no marked tree within reach of me. If you mark the next one, I'll start straight away.

priya/boss.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.015.spoken: I don't have an axe, boss. The rack's the place to check. I can't do anything useful until I've got one.

priya/boss.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.016.spoken: I'm waiting for a carry partner. This trunk is too long for one person. Could you send someone?

priya/boss.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.017.spoken: I heard something to one side of me, maybe forty metres off, keeping pace. It stopped when I stopped. It wasn't wind.

priya/boss.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.018.spoken: I saw movement between the trunks. Upright, not an animal's gait, and no sound on the brush. I wrote down the time.

priya/boss.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.019.spoken: Someone told me a story about it. I haven't seen anything myself, so I can't confirm or deny it.

priya/boss.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.020.spoken: Nothing I'd put in the notebook as strange. If that changes, you'll hear it from me first.

priya/boss.priya.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.021.spoken: I keep hearing the same claim from different people. That doesn't make it true. It does make me pay attention.

priya/boss.priya.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.022.spoken: I'm owed wages, boss. Do you know the date it will be paid?

priya/boss.priya.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.023.spoken: I was owed at nightfall as well. I'd like a date I can write down, please.

priya/boss.priya.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.024.spoken: All paid, boss. Three hundred a day, and it matches my notebook.

priya/boss.priya.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.025.spoken: Nothing owed. Thank you for keeping it regular. It's one less thing to track.

priya/boss.priya.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.026.spoken: Thank you. That's useful to know. I wasn't sure anyone had noticed.

priya/boss.priya.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.027.spoken: That's kind, boss. The leans were easy to read, honestly.

priya/boss.priya.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.028.spoken: Thanks, boss. A good part of it is Marta's teaching.

priya/boss.priya.029.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.029.spoken: Thank you. I've been working on my back cuts. It's good to know it shows.

priya/boss.priya.030.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.030.spoken: You can tell the wind direction by which side of the bark is wettest. Useful on a day like this.

priya/boss.priya.031.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.031.spoken: I keep a list of every bird I've heard on the island. It's short. Shorter than I'd expect.

priya/boss.priya.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.032.spoken: I left surveying because I wanted to touch the trees, not just measure them. Now I do both.

priya/boss.priya.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.033.spoken: Biscuit's put on weight since we arrived. I have a theory, boss, and its name is Dale.

priya/boss.priya.034.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/boss.priya.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.035.spoken: Right. I'll check the lean first, then start.

priya/boss.priya.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/boss.priya.036.spoken: Okay. Which side do you want them to fall? I'll make it happen.

priya/boss.priya.037.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/camp.any.008.spoken: Somebody's socks are drying on the heater again.

priya/camp.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/camp.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.any.015.spoken: Long day. Sleep now, think about it tomorrow.

priya/camp.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.any.016.spoken: The cabin clock runs five minutes fast. Someone set it that way on purpose, I reckon.

priya/camp.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.any.019.spoken: Whoever's rustling that crisp packet, please be done with it.

priya/camp.any.020.spoken: Evening, boss. Dinner's on in the cabin.

priya/camp.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.any.021.spoken: Rain on the cabin roof. Not the worst sound to rest to.

priya/camp.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.any.022.spoken: Another letter for the boat pile. It's getting thick.

priya/camp.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.001.spoken: Notebook time. Today's trees, today's weather. It's oddly calming.

priya/camp.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.002.spoken: Joan holds three places on the high-score board and I hold one. I'm working on the ratio.

priya/camp.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.003.spoken: Dale holds his cards closer when he's got a good hand. I've stopped telling him.

priya/camp.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.004.spoken: Biscuit always sits next to whoever eats slowest. It's a strategy. A good one.

priya/camp.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.005.spoken: Is tonight's stew a new stew, or yesterday's stew continuing?

priya/camp.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.006.spoken: Laundry's dry on the line. It smells of woodsmoke, but it's dry.

priya/camp.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.007.spoken: The bathroom tap drips about once a second. I'll replace the washer tomorrow.

priya/camp.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.008.spoken: Measurably, it's Dale. Though Marta counts in her sleep.

priya/camp.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.009.spoken: I've been watching the patterns on the second machine. I'd take that bet.

priya/camp.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.010.spoken: Evening, boss. The cabin kettle's getting slower every day. I think it's scale. I've been timing it.

priya/camp.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.011.spoken: I write my mother a page a day. She'll get them all at once when the boat comes. She'll love that.

priya/camp.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.012.spoken: Quick break. Tea, ten minutes, and nobody ask what's in the notebook.

priya/camp.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.013.spoken: Seven hours, roughly. The bunk below mine creaked twice.

priya/camp.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.014.spoken: The kitchen shelf's labelled now. Please put the salt back where it says salt.

priya/camp.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.015.spoken: It's colder by the window. I've moved my sleeping bag to the other end. Small improvement.

priya/camp.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.016.spoken: The end of the contract, as far as I know. I'm crossing the days off, if you want to check.

priya/camp.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.017.spoken: Eggs need about three minutes less than you give them. Just as a data point.

priya/camp.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.018.spoken: The left arcade machine has a sticky jump button. That might explain the board.

priya/camp.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/camp.priya.019.spoken: Biscuit's been walking the fence line again. Mostly for dropped crusts, as far as I can tell.

priya/cut.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.001.spoken: Tree coming down! Clear the lane!

priya/cut.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/cut.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.003.spoken: Next trunk's ready to section when you are.

priya/cut.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.004.spoken: Stump's done. Moving on to the next.

priya/cut.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.007.spoken: Dead branch up top. Watch it doesn't drop when the trunk moves.

priya/cut.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.008.spoken: No rush. Get the hinge right and the rest follows.

priya/cut.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.012.spoken: Bark's slippery. Mind the blade on the wet side.

priya/cut.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.013.spoken: Too gusty to drop anything. I'll section what's already down.

priya/cut.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.014.spoken: Nothing marked near me, boss. Point me at a tree and I'll drop it.

priya/cut.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.015.spoken: Can't cut with bare hands, boss. I need something off the tool rack first.

priya/cut.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.016.spoken: Lane's occupied. I'll hold off until they're out of the fall zone.

priya/cut.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.018.spoken: Mud all round the stump. Roots are greasy today.

priya/cut.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.019.spoken: The line's moving. You can see daylight through the first stands now.

priya/cut.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.020.spoken: Short, even lengths. Easier on whoever's carrying.

priya/cut.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.021.spoken: Dusk. Finish the cut and leave the rest for morning.

priya/cut.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.022.spoken: Fresh scrape marks on that root. Something's been digging here recently.

priya/cut.any.024.spoken: Saw's running. If you need me, shout, then shout louder.

priya/cut.any.026.spoken: Late in the contract and the trunks don't get any lighter.

priya/cut.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.027.spoken: Gust coming through. Pull the saw out, wait, start again.

priya/cut.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.any.028.spoken: Coming. Mark where you want the first cut.

priya/cut.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.001.spoken: Lean is about ten degrees east. Notch goes on that side.

priya/cut.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/cut.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.004.spoken: Stump is level. I checked it with the axe handle, which counts as a tool.

priya/cut.priya.005.spoken: Report, boss: everything I felled today went down in the planned direction. One needed a wedge.

priya/cut.priya.006.spoken: Sectioning the trunk, boss. Even lengths, so they stack flat on the decks.

priya/cut.priya.007.spoken: The wind has gone round to the north. Should we check the fall directions again?

priya/cut.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.008.spoken: Marta's hinge on that last one was two fingers thick, exactly. I'm copying it.

priya/cut.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.009.spoken: This section will roll downhill when it comes free. Could you stand uphill, please?

priya/cut.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.010.spoken: Rain makes the bark slick and the cut cleaner. I'll take that trade.

priya/cut.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.011.spoken: Three main roots. The downhill one gets cut last.

priya/cut.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.012.spoken: I'm waiting, boss. My fall zone overlaps where someone is bucking. Two minutes, perhaps.

priya/cut.priya.013.spoken: A quarter of the island is cleared. The wind reaches the cutting line differently now. Have you felt it?

priya/cut.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.014.spoken: Back cut level with the notch. Hinge holding. Good.

priya/cut.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.015.spoken: Too loud for questions while the saw runs. I'll write them down for later.

priya/cut.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.016.spoken: Light's going. I can't judge the lean properly in this. I'd rather stop.

priya/cut.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.017.spoken: Dry wood splinters at the hinge. Leave it slightly thicker today.

priya/cut.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.018.spoken: Something moved in the uphill trees when that one landed. Thirty metres off. Birds, most likely.
