priya/cut.priya.019.spoken: You can read drought years in the rings, boss. This tree lived through three of them.

priya/cut.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.020.spoken: Clear. I checked the lean twice. It wants to go left anyway.

priya/cut.priya.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/cut.priya.021.spoken: Five hours. I counted. The cabin roof drips on the left side.

priya/dusk.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.005.spoken: There was a fresh broken branch by the camp entrance this morning. High up. Whatever did it had weight and reach.

priya/dusk.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.006.spoken: Stay in the light, keep the door shut, sleep. That's the part we control.

priya/dusk.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.011.spoken: Light's going. Tools away and get inside.

priya/dusk.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.012.spoken: Let's not hang about near the fence, you.

priya/dusk.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.013.spoken: I don't want to talk about it. I want to get inside.

priya/dusk.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.014.spoken: I'm not going back out tonight, boss. I'm sorry. Ask me again at first light.

priya/dusk.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.015.spoken: I saw something past the fence. I can't tell you what it was. I'm sure it was there.

priya/dusk.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.016.spoken: Only stories, boss. Nothing I've seen with my own eyes.

priya/dusk.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.017.spoken: Stick close, dog. We're both going in.

priya/dusk.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.018.spoken: Somebody check the door's latched. Then check it once more.

priya/dusk.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.019.spoken: Wind's making every branch sound like a footstep.

priya/dusk.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.020.spoken: Everybody here? Say your name if you're in.

priya/dusk.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.021.spoken: It came from the north side, low down, twice. That's all I can honestly tell you, boss.

priya/dusk.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.any.023.spoken: Enough people have said it now, you. I can't keep waving it off.

priya/dusk.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.001.spoken: Wind's backed round to the west, you. It'll be cold by full dark. Worth getting the stove going early.

priya/dusk.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.002.spoken: About forty metres past the fence, north-east. A shape at roughly head height, for three or four seconds. Not a deer. Deer don't stand that still.

priya/dusk.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.003.spoken: I've written down what I heard: two knocks on the north wall, then one nearer the door. I don't know what made them.

priya/dusk.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.004.spoken: I've been told about it, boss. I haven't seen anything myself. I'd rather not guess.

priya/dusk.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.005.spoken: Who told you, you? I'd like to know how many people it passed through before it got to us.

priya/dusk.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.006.spoken: I count heads at the camp entrance every evening. It isn't fear. It's a habit I'd like us all to keep.

priya/dusk.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.007.spoken: Most sounds after dusk are trees cooling and the fire settling, you. Most. If I hear one that isn't, I'll tell you.

priya/dusk.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.008.spoken: Last night Biscuit's ears went flat toward the tree line and stayed that way for about a minute. I noted the time.

priya/dusk.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.009.spoken: One fence panel was bowed inward this morning, boss. Not cut. Pushed from outside, at about chest height. I can't say by what.

priya/dusk.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.010.spoken: There was a light on the road after dusk. Steady, so not a fire. And it didn't bob the way it would if someone carried it.

priya/dusk.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.011.spoken: I'd like to be inside before the light goes. Nothing specific. I just can't see well enough to say what anything is.

priya/dusk.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.012.spoken: Give me a moment, you. I'll be clear-headed shortly. I want to write it down before I start remembering it wrong.

priya/dusk.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.013.spoken: I'm declining, boss. Visibility is too poor past dusk, and I don't trust what I'd be looking at.

priya/dusk.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.014.spoken: Was it seen, heard, or told? Those are three very different things, and only one of them goes in my notebook.

priya/dusk.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.015.spoken: Heading in, boss. Whatever's still out in the forest can wait until there's light to see it by.

priya/dusk.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.016.spoken: Near the tree line I heard something like a name. I couldn't tell whose. Honestly, I couldn't tell if it was a voice.

priya/dusk.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.017.spoken: Forests are noisy at dusk, you. Mostly birds settling and bark contracting. I've catalogued quite a few.

priya/dusk.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.018.spoken: If you hear something tonight, note the time and the direction. Don't go and look. Looking is how people end up outside.

priya/dusk.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.019.spoken: Storms make everything sound closer than it is. Remember that tonight, before anyone decides what they heard.

priya/dusk.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.020.spoken: I've stopped saying it was nothing. I don't know what it was. That isn't the same as nothing.

priya/dusk.priya.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/dusk.priya.021.spoken: Possibly. Though the only radio I know of on this island is the one in the utility room. I'm only noting it.

priya/eth.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.001.spoken: Thanks, boss. Good to know someone's keeping count.

priya/eth.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.002.spoken: Moved up a level. Feels earned, for once.

priya/eth.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.003.spoken: Nowhere to set this down. Yard's full up.

priya/eth.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.004.spoken: Path's blocked ahead. Going round or waiting, one or the other.

priya/eth.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.005.spoken: This one needs two. Waiting for a spare pair of hands.

priya/eth.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.006.spoken: Nothing left on the rack I can use. Somebody bring one back.

priya/eth.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.007.spoken: No marked trees near me. Waiting on direction.

priya/eth.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.008.spoken: Bad grip, short drop. Lifting it again.

priya/eth.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.009.spoken: On it, boss. Next one's mine.

priya/eth.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.010.spoken: Good day, all. Same again tomorrow, and maybe the yard can keep up for once.

priya/eth.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.011.spoken: I'm only stood here because the yard's full, boss. Clear it and I'm straight back.

priya/eth.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.016.spoken: Mistakes happen. Clean it up and keep going. No point stewing on it.

priya/eth.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.019.spoken: The cradle hasn't changed in a while. Same logs, same places. That's our hold-up.

priya/eth.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.021.spoken: Someone's notches have tidied up lately. You can see it in the stumps.

priya/eth.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.022.spoken: Saw's pinched. Wedge it, ease it out, start again.

priya/eth.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.any.023.spoken: Thanks, boss. It helps to hear it on a day with this much waiting in it.

priya/eth.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.001.spoken: Thank you, boss. I'll write that down. Mostly so I can find it on a bad day.

priya/eth.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.002.spoken: That's kind. For the record, I checked the hinge on my last one twice. It held exactly where I wanted.

priya/eth.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.003.spoken: New level. I'll put the date in the notebook. Small things add up if you write them down.

priya/eth.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.004.spoken: Have you seen the stumps along the last lane? Someone's getting them nearly flush now.

priya/eth.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.005.spoken: Face cut's a few degrees off. Easy to fix. Recutting it before the back cut.

priya/eth.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.006.spoken: Bar's pinched. I misread the compression on top. Wedge in, then try again.

priya/eth.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.007.spoken: The cradle's full and the decks are high, boss. More felling right now just moves the queue into the forest.

priya/eth.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.008.spoken: Route's blocked. That's the delay, and I'm writing it down so nobody blames the wrong thing.

priya/eth.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.009.spoken: Waiting on a second carrier. That's a staffing gap, not a work-rate problem.

priya/eth.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.010.spoken: Agreed. Nobody's slow. The path is the hold-up, and you can see it from here.

priya/eth.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.011.spoken: Five-minute break. Water first. My handwriting gets worse when I'm thirsty.

priya/eth.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.012.spoken: Mine came down clean today, boss. No hang-ups, and the lane behind me is clear for hauling.

priya/eth.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.013.spoken: Was it the stumps by the lane? I've been trying to copy yours.

priya/eth.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.014.spoken: Question. Does it count as a mistake if you fix it before anyone sees?

priya/eth.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.015.spoken: A lot of waiting today, most of it at the yard. That's a pattern, not bad luck. I'll mention it.

priya/eth.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.016.spoken: No task for me. I'll check the marks on the next row while I wait. Something useful.

priya/eth.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.017.spoken: Nothing on the rack that suits this trunk. I'd rather wait than fell with the wrong tool.

priya/eth.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.018.spoken: I reached a new level, boss. I suspect the notebook deserves partial credit.

priya/eth.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.019.spoken: I keep a tally, but I'm not telling you. You'd turn it into a contest.

priya/eth.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.020.spoken: It'll clear in a rush, yes. The fire is eating, just slowly.

priya/eth.priya.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.021.spoken: Honestly? Whoever had the fewest hang-ups. I could check, if anyone wants numbers.

priya/eth.priya.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/eth.priya.022.spoken: Every ninety minutes, exactly. It's in the notebook.

priya/grp.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.any.001.spoken: Anyone else's boots still wet from yesterday? Mine squelch when I think about them.

priya/grp.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.any.002.spoken: Stuff them with newspaper. Oh, wait. No newspaper. Stuff them with somebody's spare socks.

priya/grp.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.any.004.spoken: The fire pile's burning faster on the windward side. We should feed the other end.

priya/grp.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.any.005.spoken: I'll take the other end. Somebody pass me the short lengths.

priya/grp.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.any.008.spoken: Last carry. Then we walk in together, at a sensible pace.

priya/grp.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.any.012.spoken: I once lost a whole truck in a car park. Found it three hours later. Wrong car park.

priya/grp.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.001.spoken: You snored from about two until four, Dale. I know because I was awake for most of it.

priya/grp.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.002.spoken: The break's twenty minutes on the sheet, Marta. I checked. We've got eight more.

priya/grp.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.003.spoken: I'd have to check the yard tally, so I'll pass. I don't guess on quiz nights.

priya/grp.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.004.spoken: If the short lengths go on the top deck, the long ones fit underneath. I measured both.

priya/grp.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.005.spoken: Rain's coming from the west, steady, not gusting. The low lanes will be soft by midday.

priya/grp.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.006.spoken: And check the lean before you notch, not after. That's the one people learn the hard way.

priya/grp.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.007.spoken: People leave contracts early all the time, Tomas. They had their reasons. It doesn't have to mean anything more.

priya/grp.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.008.spoken: You can see the shore from the middle ridge now. When we landed it was solid canopy.

priya/grp.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.009.spoken: I'd want the numbers before I crowned anyone. But the stumps do look good from up here.

priya/grp.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.010.spoken: If we fell everything first, the yard sits empty today and overflows tomorrow. I'd split the crew.

priya/grp.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.011.spoken: Who said it, and when? If they can give me a time and where they stood, I'll write it down. If not, it's a story.

priya/grp.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.012.spoken: Did they say what colour, and how high? Fireflies don't hold still at head height.

priya/grp.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.013.spoken: Told by whom? A rumour passed through two people loses the useful parts first.

priya/grp.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.014.spoken: I'll play, but I'm keeping track of which cards are gone. That isn't cheating. It's attention.

priya/grp.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.015.spoken: You're not bad, Tomas. You fold too early. Hold on one round longer.

priya/grp.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.016.spoken: Biscuit's carrying a glove. I think it's yours, Dale. There's jam on the thumb.

priya/grp.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.017.spoken: Twenty is doable if the yard keeps up. That's the part that usually gives first.

priya/grp.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.018.spoken: Take dates with you. When we were last paid, how many days are owed. The boss will take numbers better than temper.

priya/grp.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.019.spoken: The gusts are coming every forty seconds or so. I checked the window frames. They're holding.

priya/grp.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.020.spoken: I counted at the last fence post. Everyone who left the lanes with us is walking with us.

priya/grp.priya.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.021.spoken: Wind's swung round to the north since lunch. The leans we marked this morning won't all hold.

priya/grp.priya.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/grp.priya.022.spoken: Agreed. And we walk in pairs. If you'd tell me what you saw later, Marta, I'd write it down.

priya/haul.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.001.spoken: Coming through with a log! Mind your heads.

priya/haul.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/haul.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.003.spoken: Grab the other end? This one's a two-person job.

priya/haul.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.008.spoken: Deck on the left is leaning. Restack it before it slides.

priya/haul.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.010.spoken: Yard's full. No point stewing. Let's tidy the decks while the fire catches up.

priya/haul.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.013.spoken: Waiting on the cradle, boss. Someone's unloading ahead of me.

priya/haul.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.014.spoken: Nothing to carry near me, boss. Is there a pile somewhere else?

priya/haul.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.015.spoken: Storm's picking up. Get this one in and we'll see.

priya/haul.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.016.spoken: Fire's struggling in the rain. Take the dry logs from the middle of the deck.

priya/haul.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.017.spoken: Watch the stump on your right. Ankle height, nasty.

priya/haul.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.018.spoken: Two-person carries are slow, but nobody's back gives out.

priya/haul.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.019.spoken: Fire pile's burned down a bit. Room for a few more.

priya/haul.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.020.spoken: Leave the rest on the deck. It'll keep till morning.

priya/haul.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.021.spoken: Same route, same log size, same sore shoulder.

priya/haul.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.022.spoken: Hardly anything left to haul from out here. Odd to see it so bare.

priya/haul.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.024.spoken: That's my deliveries done for now. Fire's got plenty.

priya/haul.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.026.spoken: Dry day. Bark's light and the road's firm. Good hauling.

priya/haul.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.any.027.spoken: Load the handcart and push. Beats carrying them one at a time.

priya/haul.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/haul.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.001.spoken: Shorter path through the stumps on the left. Eleven paces saved.

priya/haul.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.002.spoken: Deck three is two logs from full. The fire pile can take four.

priya/haul.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.003.spoken: Report, boss: I've delivered steadily today. The fire is burning slower than we're stacking.

priya/haul.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.004.spoken: The cradle is full, boss, and the decks too. Until the fire catches up, carrying more just moves the queue.

priya/haul.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.005.spoken: We matched step on that team carry. Did you notice? It's much easier in rhythm.

priya/haul.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.006.spoken: Wet logs weigh more. Not much, but you feel it by the tenth.

priya/haul.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.007.spoken: This log's still green. Should it go on the fire now, or season on the deck?

priya/haul.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.008.spoken: The wind's carrying sparks east. Nothing downwind but stumps and bare ground.

priya/haul.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.009.spoken: Stacking the decks, boss. Largest at the bottom, so nothing rolls.

priya/haul.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.010.spoken: Fresh tracks across the haul road. Small, four toes, claws showing. A fox, I think.

priya/haul.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.011.spoken: There's a crown lying across the route by the big stump. Is anyone assigned to clear it?

priya/haul.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.012.spoken: The fire pile settles about a hand's width every hour. I measured it yesterday.

priya/haul.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.013.spoken: The sun's on the ridge. About twenty minutes of usable light. Shall we make this the last?

priya/haul.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.014.spoken: Dale carried two of the long ones in the time I carried one. Noted.

priya/haul.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.015.spoken: Cradle's clear. I'll move the top of the deck to the fire so there's room.

priya/haul.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.016.spoken: With this much cleared, we could take a straighter line to the yard. Should we ask the boss?

priya/haul.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.017.spoken: Have you noticed the logs from the north slope are heavier, boss? Denser wood, I think.

priya/haul.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.018.spoken: Something called out in the trees when the fire cracked. Southwest, far off. A bird, I'd guess.

priya/haul.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.019.spoken: Second log today that's rolled off the cradle's edge. The left side sits lower.

priya/haul.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/haul.priya.020.spoken: Just you. And me. Our muscles are tired. The logs weigh what they weighed this morning.

priya/pair.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.001.spoken: Your end's dipping. Lift a bit or we'll both be wearing it.

priya/pair.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.002.spoken: My end's fine. It's your end telling stories.

priya/pair.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.004.spoken: Small place. You'd drive through and never notice. That's the charm of it.

priya/pair.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.006.spoken: Same as yesterday. Keep walking and we'll be in with the others soon enough.

priya/pair.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.008.spoken: Not a chance. I'm not handing you the bragging rights.

priya/pair.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.009.spoken: Somebody's left a glove on that stump back there. Not mine.

priya/pair.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.010.spoken: Not mine either. Hang it on the fence post. Someone'll claim it.

priya/pair.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.012.spoken: Slow is good. Slow is my favourite speed.

priya/pair.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.any.014.spoken: Stories grow out here. There's not much else to do after dark.

priya/pair.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/pair.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.001.spoken: Back and a little left, toward the gap. The crown's heavier on the downhill side.

priya/pair.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.002.spoken: Marta, how are your stumps so flat? Mine look like a staircase.

priya/pair.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.003.spoken: I wrote down your three rules for a back cut. You broke all three today and it still landed perfectly.

priya/pair.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.004.spoken: Already did. I underlined it twice.

priya/pair.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.005.spoken: About a week ago. I didn't say anything. I wanted to be right a few more times first.

priya/pair.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.006.spoken: The lane past the rocks is shorter, but it drains badly. I'd take the long way while it's raining.

priya/pair.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.007.spoken: Then I'll count how many times you slip. Purely for the notebook.

priya/pair.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.008.spoken: Heavy end leads. Then the light end swings less behind you. You already knew that.

priya/pair.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.009.spoken: Dale, Biscuit has sat by your boots at every meal this week. I've been keeping a tally.

priya/pair.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.010.spoken: Seven dropped crusts at breakfast alone. That is data.

priya/pair.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.011.spoken: Whatever's on Joan's rota. That isn't intelligence, Dale. It's reading the fridge door.

priya/pair.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.012.spoken: I can't back you or argue. I wasn't there. Ask whoever was, and ask them which direction.

priya/pair.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.013.spoken: I'd like to, Dale. But I heard something myself once, and I wrote it down, and it wasn't a radio.

priya/pair.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.014.spoken: You carried that big trunk from the rocks without setting it down. I paced it out. It's farther than you think.

priya/pair.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.015.spoken: Two trunks rubbing, upslope, maybe thirty metres. Listen. It rises with every gust.

priya/pair.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.016.spoken: You took the soft patch in first and didn't spin a wheel. How did you know?

priya/pair.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.017.spoken: Not weird. Useful. It's going in the notebook with your name on it.

priya/pair.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.018.spoken: Clear sky, so it holds longer than on the cloudy days. I'll tell you the moment it starts to drop.

priya/pair.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.019.spoken: Did you finish the letter to Ana? You were on page three last night.

priya/pair.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.020.spoken: I don't know. I didn't see it. Ask whoever said it where they were standing, and when.

priya/pair.priya.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.021.spoken: I can't tell you what it was. I noticed something once myself and marked the spot. That's all I've got, Tomas.

priya/pair.priya.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.022.spoken: Breathe out, Tomas. Count the fence posts as we pass. It helps.

priya/pair.priya.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.023.spoken: Unverified. One teller, no time, no direction. I'd want a second witness before I wrote it down.

priya/pair.priya.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.024.spoken: Joan, you said the stew had six ingredients. I counted four and a mystery.

priya/pair.priya.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.025.spoken: I can. I just wrote 'love, unconfirmed.'

priya/pair.priya.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.026.spoken: Seven hours. I wrote one line about the wind and went straight back to sleep.

priya/pair.priya.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.027.spoken: I checked your arcade claims against the board. You're rounding up by two points, Joan.

priya/pair.priya.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.028.spoken: Then I'll round mine up too, and we can both be wrong together.

priya/pair.priya.029.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/pair.priya.029.spoken: The fire pile's leaning north. Keep stacking this side and it'll roll.

priya/sea.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.003.spoken: Take a look offshore while there's still a gap in the fog.

priya/sea.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.005.spoken: See the long dark line beyond the waves? That's a deck.

priya/sea.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.008.spoken: If you stand by me, you can see it over the yard fence.

priya/sea.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.012.spoken: Look where the water goes silver. It's just beyond that.

priya/sea.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.014.spoken: There's a square platform right at the back of it.

priya/sea.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.015.spoken: Wait for the next swell. The deck comes back into view.

priya/sea.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.016.spoken: I caught it in the corner of my eye while I was stacking.

priya/sea.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.018.spoken: Get a look before it goes behind the point.

priya/sea.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.019.spoken: That's a clean white wake for something moving that slowly.

priya/sea.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.020.spoken: I can see its windows flashing in the sun.

priya/sea.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.021.spoken: It was moving quicker a minute ago.

priya/sea.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.022.spoken: There's the ship again. It's taking its time past our stretch.

priya/sea.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.023.spoken: You've got time to see it. The wake's dropped right off.

priya/sea.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.027.spoken: If you missed it earlier, look now. It's barely moving.

priya/sea.any.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.032.spoken: No boat coming down from it that I can see.

priya/sea.any.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.033.spoken: It'll pass the opening in the trees in a second. Watch.

priya/sea.any.034.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.034.spoken: Look at the gap it's keeping from shore.

priya/sea.any.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.035.spoken: The bow's still pointed along the coast.

priya/sea.any.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.036.spoken: Might be waiting on something out there.

priya/sea.any.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.039.spoken: I didn't think I'd be able to hear it from this far out.

priya/sea.any.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.042.spoken: Hold up. There's a thump coming in over the trees.

priya/sea.any.045.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.045.spoken: Listen for the beat underneath the wind.

priya/sea.any.046.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.046.spoken: Sounds like a helicopter coming closer.

priya/sea.any.047.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.047.spoken: I heard it between cuts. It kept getting louder.

priya/sea.any.048.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.048.spoken: That noise is moving. Look up if you get a clear patch.

priya/sea.any.050.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.050.spoken: Hear it? There's a low beat behind the engine noise.

priya/sea.any.051.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.051.spoken: Whatever's overhead is drowning out the surf.

priya/sea.any.052.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.052.spoken: I can hear it through the cabin wall.

priya/sea.any.056.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.056.spoken: I lost the sound behind the ridge. Might come round again.

priya/sea.any.057.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.057.spoken: It's still there when the wind drops.

priya/sea.any.058.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.058.spoken: I've got a better listen here away from the pit.

priya/sea.any.060.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.060.spoken: It went quiet quick. Must be farther off now.

priya/sea.any.061.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.061.spoken: Up over the treeline. You've got a helicopter coming past.

priya/sea.any.062.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.062.spoken: There it goes over camp. Look up.

priya/sea.any.064.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.064.spoken: It's crossing the clearing. You've got a few seconds.

priya/sea.any.066.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.066.spoken: There it is, just above the ridge.

priya/sea.any.067.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.067.spoken: It turned after it passed the yard.

priya/sea.any.069.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.069.spoken: I saw it go over the far slope and turn back in.

priya/sea.any.072.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.072.spoken: It's holding out over the coast now.

priya/sea.any.073.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.073.spoken: You can see it between those two tops.

priya/sea.any.075.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.075.spoken: I saw the tail vanish behind the ridge. Keep watching that gap.

priya/sea.any.076.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.076.spoken: Looks like the next pass is taking it farther inland.

priya/sea.any.077.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.077.spoken: It went across the bay and curved back toward the island.

priya/sea.any.079.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.079.spoken: I saw it pass the dock. It kept right on going.

priya/sea.any.080.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.080.spoken: There it goes toward the water. You can see it against the haze.

priya/sea.any.082.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.082.spoken: Watch the back of the ship. The helicopter's coming down.

priya/sea.any.083.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.083.spoken: It went back to the same deck it came from.

priya/sea.any.085.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.085.spoken: It's over the ship now. Looks like they're bringing it in.

priya/sea.any.086.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.086.spoken: I could see the rotor clear as anything against the deck.

priya/sea.any.087.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.087.spoken: I watched the ship come round to the same stretch of water.

priya/sea.any.089.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.089.spoken: It made the whole round. I caught it on both sides of the island.

priya/sea.any.090.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.090.spoken: Same hull as the one I saw a few days ago.

priya/sea.any.091.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.091.spoken: Last time I watched it slow down at this same stretch.

priya/sea.any.092.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.092.spoken: The first time I only saw the ship. Today I saw what was on it.

priya/sea.any.094.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.094.spoken: I remember that big platform at the back. Saw it on the last pass too.

priya/sea.any.095.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.095.spoken: The ship's heading away now. Wake's pointing straight out.

priya/sea.any.096.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.096.spoken: I lost it after it turned seaward.

priya/sea.any.097.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.097.spoken: The rotor sound went with it after the helicopter came down.

priya/sea.any.098.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.098.spoken: Yesterday there was nothing on the horizon from this spot. I checked.

priya/sea.any.099.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.099.spoken: It's gone around the point again. I wonder how far out it goes after.

priya/sea.any.107.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.107.spoken: I went out to look after you called. I only caught the wake.

priya/sea.any.108.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.108.spoken: I've got nothing better than a guess about what they're doing.

priya/sea.any.109.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.109.spoken: The way you describe it, I'd have sworn they were coming in.

priya/sea.any.119.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.any.119.spoken: Next time, tell me before it gets behind the ridge.

priya/sea.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.011.spoken: I can make out the bridge. Can't see a name from here.

priya/sea.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.017.spoken: From here it looks like it's following the coast.

priya/sea.priya.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.024.spoken: I watched it ease down as it came level with us.

priya/sea.priya.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.026.spoken: It hasn't turned in. It's just creeping along outside the bay.

priya/sea.priya.031.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.031.spoken: I can see the back deck clearly now that it's slowed.

priya/sea.priya.055.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.055.spoken: Sounded like it came in off the water.

priya/sea.priya.059.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.059.spoken: That's got a rhythm to it. Been hearing it for half a minute.

priya/sea.priya.063.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.063.spoken: I can see it banking out over the water.

priya/sea.priya.065.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.065.spoken: I can see the underside from here. Can't read anything on it.

priya/sea.priya.071.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.071.spoken: I thought it was heading straight through. Then it banked.

priya/sea.priya.081.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.081.spoken: I saw it lift right off that square at the stern.

priya/sea.priya.084.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.084.spoken: The whole ship's moving and it's lining up with the pad.

priya/sea.priya.088.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.088.spoken: It came back on the bearing where we first saw it.

priya/sea.priya.093.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.093.spoken: That helicopter took a different line over the ridge this time.

priya/sea.priya.106.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/sea.priya.106.spoken: If it was a survey, somebody's putting in some long days.
