priya/surv.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/surv.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/surv.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.005.spoken: Wait. Let it move on first.

priya/surv.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.007.spoken: It went quiet near the decks just before. Quiet is when I start worrying.

priya/surv.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.012.spoken: The company left right on schedule. Shame it was only their schedule.

priya/surv.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.013.spoken: Is that the ship? That's the ship.

priya/surv.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.014.spoken: One at a time on the gangway. Hold the rail.

priya/surv.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.015.spoken: I won't say their name yet. On the boat.

priya/surv.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.016.spoken: One of us walked off before all this. I hope they're hiding well.

priya/surv.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.017.spoken: There's so few of us now. Stay where I can see you.

priya/surv.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.018.spoken: Your watch. Wake me if anything changes. Anything at all.

priya/surv.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.019.spoken: Not everyone's getting on. I know. Keep walking anyway.

priya/surv.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.020.spoken: Go on, Biscuit. Up you go. We're right behind you.

priya/surv.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.021.spoken: I'm not leaving cover, boss. Not for anything.

priya/surv.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.022.spoken: Last night of it. Hold on till the light.

priya/surv.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.any.024.spoken: Eat, rest, keep the door shut. Boring keeps us alive.

priya/surv.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.001.spoken: No boat today and nothing on the radio from them. The company isn't late, you. It's gone. I'd like to be angry about it later.

priya/surv.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.002.spoken: The beacon was acknowledged on the utility radio, boss. Dawn on day thirty-six. Everything we do now is about getting there.

priya/surv.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.003.spoken: Stay still. Sound carries further than you think.

priya/surv.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.004.spoken: Slow breaths. Count them. Four in, four out.

priya/surv.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.005.spoken: It stops when it listens, you. I've seen it do that twice now. So when it stops, we stop.

priya/surv.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.006.spoken: I've listed what food we have. It lasts to day thirty-six if we're disciplined. It doesn't last much past it.

priya/surv.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.007.spoken: Two-hour watches. I've written the order on the wall, so nobody has to remember anything at three in the morning.

priya/surv.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.008.spoken: Their name is in the notebook. I'll read it out on the ship. Not before.

priya/surv.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.009.spoken: Whoever quit is still on the island, boss. No boat took them. If you see them, they'll need somewhere to hide.

priya/surv.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.010.spoken: Day thirty-two. Four dawns to go. One crossed off.

priya/surv.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.011.spoken: The alcove's raised, roofed and out of sight, with water and a bed. He's better placed than any of us, honestly.

priya/surv.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.012.spoken: We're doing well, considering, you. That isn't comfort. It's a measurement. I'll take either.

priya/surv.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.013.spoken: Boarding's at the dock end and the window is short. Walk straight. Don't stop for anything you can replace.

priya/surv.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.014.spoken: I'll finish the notebook on the crossing. Some pages I'm leaving blank on purpose.

priya/surv.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.015.spoken: Don't look out. Looking makes noise.

priya/surv.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.016.spoken: It's quieter tonight than last night, you. I genuinely don't know whether that's good.

priya/surv.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.017.spoken: No, boss. The road is exactly where it's been walking. I'll do anything that doesn't involve the road.

priya/surv.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.018.spoken: Three rules. Nobody alone. Nobody in the open after dusk. If you have to hide, pick somewhere you can get out of.

priya/surv.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.019.spoken: Three hours, broken into pieces. Better than yesterday, by my count.

priya/surv.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/surv.priya.020.spoken: I've the names of everyone who isn't boarding, boss. Someone should be able to say them properly, later.

priya/tool.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/tool.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.002.spoken: Too loud to talk. Wave if you need me.

priya/tool.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.003.spoken: Big axe makes short work of it.

priya/tool.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.004.spoken: Small axe. Patience, and a lot more swings.

priya/tool.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.005.spoken: No tool left on the rack. Someone needs to order more.

priya/tool.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.006.spoken: Sharpening while there's light. A dull axe is a dangerous axe.

priya/tool.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.009.spoken: That chain's throwing dust, not chips. It needs sharpening.

priya/tool.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.010.spoken: Let the saw do the work. Don't lean on it.

priya/tool.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.015.spoken: Helmet on before you go under that crown.

priya/tool.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.016.spoken: Good tread on these boots. The mud's not winning today.

priya/tool.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.017.spoken: Sap's glued my gloves stiff. Still better than bare hands.

priya/tool.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.018.spoken: I need a tool, boss. The camper computer can order one from the supplier.

priya/tool.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.019.spoken: Getting the hang of this. Fewer swings than last week.

priya/tool.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.020.spoken: Parcel locker's full. New gear from the supplier, I hope.

priya/tool.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.021.spoken: Wet chain flinging bark everywhere. Keep your visor down.

priya/tool.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.022.spoken: Killing the saw. Dusk is coming and I want my ears back.

priya/tool.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.023.spoken: Ten days with the big axe. I'd never go back to the small one.

priya/tool.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.024.spoken: Dry wood bites clean. The edge is holding up today.

priya/tool.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.025.spoken: On the saw, boss. Can't hear you, but I can see you're there.

priya/tool.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.026.spoken: Wind's dropping twigs on my helmet. Glad I'm wearing it.

priya/tool.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.027.spoken: One axe on the rack has a cracked handle. I'm setting it aside.

priya/tool.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.any.028.spoken: Go on, then. You start, I'll keep the angle.

priya/tool.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.001.spoken: The large axe takes about forty percent fewer swings than the small one. I've been counting.

priya/tool.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.002.spoken: Too loud to hear anything. I watch the chips instead. They tell you plenty.

priya/tool.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.003.spoken: Report, boss: the saw chain will need replacing soon. The cuts are drifting to the left.

priya/tool.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.004.spoken: Helmets on, please. There's a hung branch two trees over.

priya/tool.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.005.spoken: Do the parts and the food come from the same supplier, boss? The parcel labels match.

priya/tool.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.006.spoken: My strikes are landing closer together. Less chopping, more cutting.

priya/tool.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.007.spoken: Kickback comes off the top of the bar tip. Keep it away from knots.

priya/tool.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.008.spoken: There's no tool for me on the rack, boss. Could we order one on the camper computer?

priya/tool.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.009.spoken: Oiled the axe heads. Two had rust at the eye, where the rain gets in.

priya/tool.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.010.spoken: Your strokes are much more even now. Did Marta show you that?

priya/tool.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.011.spoken: Wet gloves lose grip at the end of the swing. A second pair would be worth it.

priya/tool.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.012.spoken: These boots have a deeper tread than the old ones. Fewer slips on the slope.

priya/tool.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.013.spoken: The large axe tires the shoulders by dusk. My accuracy drops after about six hours.

priya/tool.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.014.spoken: Dale, the saw is louder than standing next to a running truck. Are your ears covered?

priya/tool.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.015.spoken: Dry wood makes finer sawdust. The air filter will need cleaning tonight.

priya/tool.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.016.spoken: Sawing, boss. Faster than the axe, but I can't hear anyone, so I keep looking up.

priya/tool.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.017.spoken: The parcel locker light is on. Something's arrived from the supplier.

priya/tool.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.018.spoken: Small axe. More swings, but I can place every one exactly.

priya/tool.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.019.spoken: My felling times are down by a third since the first week. I keep a record.

priya/tool.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/tool.priya.020.spoken: Oh. You're right. I'll hone it at lunch, if you'll show me the angle.

priya/wage.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.001.spoken: Pay came through clean. One less thing to think about out here.

priya/wage.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.002.spoken: Owed since nightfall. Keep swinging, keep counting.

priya/wage.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.008.spoken: Nobody's laughed at breakfast since the wages went late. Small thing. Still noticed it.

priya/wage.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.009.spoken: I'm owed, boss. I'm not panicking about it. I would like a date, though.

priya/wage.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.011.spoken: I'm telling you straight, boss. Another day unpaid and I'm leaving on the next boat.

priya/wage.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.012.spoken: Not many names left on the payroll. Every empty bunk is louder for it.

priya/wage.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.013.spoken: Their gloves are still on the rack. Somebody should use them. Feels odd to be the one.

priya/wage.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.014.spoken: Caught up at last. Thanks for sorting it, boss.

priya/wage.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/wage.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.019.spoken: Owed, this close to the end? That'll make for a tense boat ride, whichever way it goes.

priya/wage.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.022.spoken: Rain on payday doesn't count. Rain on payday is just weather.

priya/wage.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.any.023.spoken: People are sleeping in later since the back pay came through. Have you noticed that, you?

priya/wage.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.001.spoken: Paid in full. Written down. I like a page where the columns agree.

priya/wage.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.002.spoken: Mine is going toward finishing the survey course. Two modules left. It's odd to pay for forestry by removing a forest.

priya/wage.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.003.spoken: I worked it out, boss. Each of us costs three trees a day before you see any profit. I find that clarifying, honestly.

priya/wage.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.004.spoken: My notebook says I've been owed since the last nightfall settlement. Does yours agree, boss?

priya/wage.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.005.spoken: To be precise, boss: the grace is one day. If the arrears aren't cleared by tomorrow night, I'll be on the boat. I would rather not be.

priya/wage.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.006.spoken: Owed. Noted. Same pace regardless. Slowing down doesn't help anyone get paid.

priya/wage.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.007.spoken: you, has anyone actually been paid since nightfall? Or have we only been told we will be?

priya/wage.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.008.spoken: The arrears are cleared. Thank you, boss. I can stop checking the notebook every hour.

priya/wage.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.009.spoken: With this few of us, boss, the wage bill falls but so does the daily count. I'm not sure the count still reaches day thirty. Have you checked?

priya/wage.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.010.spoken: Since the departure, there's more ground than we can cover before dusk. I've redrawn the lanes in the notebook.

priya/wage.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.011.spoken: I took over the empty lane next to mine, you. It's thicker than it looked from the yard.

priya/wage.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.012.spoken: I keep redoing the sum in my head. It comes out the same every time. That's the problem.

priya/wage.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.013.spoken: Is the company late paying you, boss, or is this a cash-flow choice? Either answer is fine. Not knowing isn't.

priya/wage.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.014.spoken: Next time, boss, I'd like it in writing. Not because I think you'd lie. Because I've learned to ask.

priya/wage.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.015.spoken: After settlement the cabin goes quiet. Everyone off in a corner, doing sums.

priya/wage.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.016.spoken: Already on it. I've split the empty lane between us by tree count, not by area. It's fairer that way.

priya/wage.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.017.spoken: Same here. Owed since nightfall. I wrote down the time, in case it matters later.

priya/wage.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.018.spoken: Paid every night like clockwork. I didn't expect a logging camp to be the most punctual employer I've had.

priya/wage.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.019.spoken: This close to the end of the contract, boss, arrears make everyone nervous. Me included, a little.

priya/wage.priya.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wage.priya.020.spoken: Nothing owed, boss. Thank you for keeping it tidy. It makes the rest easier to think about.

priya/wx.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.001.spoken: Wet bark. Slow and steady on this one.

priya/wx.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.002.spoken: Gusts in the tops. Waiting for a lull.

priya/wx.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.003.spoken: Storm's too strong to fell in. Holding off.

priya/wx.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.004.spoken: Dry and bright. Good working weather.

priya/wx.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.005.spoken: Mud's sucking at my boots. Careful steps.

priya/wx.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

priya/wx.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.007.spoken: Not much forest left to clear. The island looks bigger without it.

priya/wx.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.008.spoken: Sun's low. Time to wrap up.

priya/wx.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.009.spoken: Roots everywhere under this growth. Watch your ankles.

priya/wx.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.010.spoken: Halfway cleared, everyone. The second half's never quicker, but at least we know the ground now.

priya/wx.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.011.spoken: Wind's shifted a few degrees. Checking the lean again before I commit.

priya/wx.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.012.spoken: Ground's drying faster where the canopy's gone. You can see the line between the two.

priya/wx.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.018.spoken: It's only weather. We wait it out, then we go again.

priya/wx.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.022.spoken: Storm's up, boss. I've stopped felling till it passes.

priya/wx.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.any.023.spoken: Calm water today. You can see a long way out.

priya/wx.priya.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.001.spoken: Wind's gusting in the crowns. I'll time the back cut for the gaps between.

priya/wx.priya.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.002.spoken: The wind's backed round since earlier. The tops are leaning the other way now.

priya/wx.priya.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.003.spoken: Rain's soaking the leaf litter. Any slope round here will be slick within the hour.

priya/wx.priya.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.004.spoken: Storm's building, boss. The gusts are moving whole crowns. I wouldn't fell in it.

priya/wx.priya.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.005.spoken: Dry bark today. Cleaner cuts, less sap. You can hear the difference in the blade.

priya/wx.priya.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.006.spoken: If it's leaning downhill, fell it with the lean, not against it. The slope always wins.

priya/wx.priya.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.007.spoken: Ground's softer under the ferns. There's water close to the surface somewhere here.

priya/wx.priya.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.008.spoken: The river's running brown. That's runoff from the bare slopes. Less root to hold the soil.

priya/wx.priya.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.009.spoken: The undergrowth's taller where the canopy opened. Light gets in, and everything grows.

priya/wx.priya.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.010.spoken: We're past a tenth. I've been shading in the cleared blocks on my map.

priya/wx.priya.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.011.spoken: Over a quarter cleared. The wind moves differently over open ground. You can feel it at the edges.

priya/wx.priya.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.012.spoken: Three quarters cleared. Much of what's left is on awkward ground. We took the easy ones first, naturally.

priya/wx.priya.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.013.spoken: Light's going flat. It's harder to judge a lean like this. I'd stop after this one.

priya/wx.priya.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.014.spoken: Fewer birds on this side. I've watched them going over to the stands we haven't reached.

priya/wx.priya.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.015.spoken: The older stumps are already greying in the sun. It happens faster than people think.

priya/wx.priya.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.016.spoken: You can see the sea from much more of the island now, boss. It makes finding your way easier.

priya/wx.priya.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.017.spoken: It's not shorter. It just feels that way when you can see where you're going.

priya/wx.priya.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.018.spoken: Your knee was wrong twice last week. I wrote it down.

priya/wx.priya.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
priya/wx.priya.019.spoken: Keep to the high side of the ruts. It's firmer where the roots are.

tomas/boss.any.003.spoken: Heading in, boss. The light's going.

tomas/boss.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.any.008.spoken: All paid, boss. No complaints from me.

tomas/boss.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/boss.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/boss.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.any.011.spoken: Not at dusk, boss. I'm heading in.

tomas/boss.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.any.013.spoken: Driving. The ruts are deep here, so I'm taking it slow.

tomas/boss.tomas.001.spoken: Hi, boss. Sorry. Did you need me?

tomas/boss.tomas.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.002.spoken: Morning, boss. The track's dried out a bit, if you need the truck.

tomas/boss.tomas.003.spoken: Boss. Hi. Sorry, is it nearly time to go in?

tomas/boss.tomas.004.spoken: Hi, boss. It's good to see you. Is everything okay?

tomas/boss.tomas.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.005.spoken: Driving, boss. Third on the flat, second on the hill. She likes that.

tomas/boss.tomas.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.006.spoken: Carrying this to the cradle. Sorry, I'm slower than Dale.

tomas/boss.tomas.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.007.spoken: Felling. The notch is in. I checked it twice. Sorry, three times.

tomas/boss.tomas.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.008.spoken: Cutting it into lengths. Is that okay? I think the lengths are right.

tomas/boss.tomas.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.009.spoken: Taking down the stump. I'm trying to get it flat like Marta's.

tomas/boss.tomas.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.010.spoken: Stacking the decks. It's nice work, boss. Close to camp.

tomas/boss.tomas.011.spoken: Sorry, boss, nothing at the moment. I could drive something somewhere, if that helps.

tomas/boss.tomas.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.012.spoken: Sorry, boss, the yard's full. There's nowhere to drop this. If someone fed the fire, or you put me on stacking, it'd clear.

tomas/boss.tomas.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.013.spoken: The way's blocked, boss. Someone's in it. Sorry, could you point me round another way?

tomas/boss.tomas.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.014.spoken: I don't have anything to do, boss. Sorry. Is there a tree you'd like me on?

tomas/boss.tomas.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.015.spoken: I haven't got an axe. Sorry. Could I take one off the rack, or could you get me one?

tomas/boss.tomas.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.016.spoken: I'm waiting for someone to take the other end. It's a two-person one. Sorry. Could you send somebody?

tomas/boss.tomas.017.spoken: I saw something, boss. At the edge of the trees. It was standing still, and then it wasn't there. Sorry. I keep seeing it when I close my eyes.

tomas/boss.tomas.018.spoken: I heard something right behind me. When I turned round, there was nothing. I'm sorry. I didn't stop running till the fence.

tomas/boss.tomas.019.spoken: Someone said they saw something out there. I didn't see it. I don't know if it's true. Do you?

tomas/boss.tomas.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.020.spoken: No, boss. Nothing. Sorry. Should I have?

tomas/boss.tomas.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.021.spoken: People keep saying things about the treeline. I haven't seen anything. But I've sort of stopped looking.

tomas/boss.tomas.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.022.spoken: Sorry to ask, boss, but I'm owed. Is it coming soon? It's okay if not. Well, it isn't, really.

tomas/boss.tomas.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.023.spoken: I'm still owed, boss. I promised Ana some of it for her course. Sorry.

tomas/boss.tomas.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.024.spoken: I'm paid up, boss. Thank you. Really.

tomas/boss.tomas.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.025.spoken: All paid. I've put half aside for Ana already. Is that silly?

tomas/boss.tomas.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.026.spoken: Really? Thank you, boss. That's, wow. Thanks.

tomas/boss.tomas.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.027.spoken: Thank you! I'm putting that in my letter to Ana. She won't believe it.

tomas/boss.tomas.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.028.spoken: Oh. Thank you. Sorry, I'm not used to that. Thank you.

tomas/boss.tomas.029.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.029.spoken: Thanks, boss. The truck did most of it. But thank you.

tomas/boss.tomas.030.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.030.spoken: I've got a whole stack of letters for Ana now. They're mostly about trucks. Sorry, Ana.

tomas/boss.tomas.031.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.031.spoken: I used to drive deliveries. Mud's harder than traffic. Quieter, though.

tomas/boss.tomas.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.032.spoken: What time is dusk tonight, roughly? Sorry. I just like to know.

tomas/boss.tomas.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.033.spoken: I'm getting used to it here. Mostly. The mornings are nice, when the mist sits on the water.

tomas/boss.tomas.034.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.034.spoken: Okay, boss. Yes. I'll do it.

tomas/boss.tomas.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.035.spoken: Right away. Sorry. I mean, yes. On it.

tomas/boss.tomas.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.036.spoken: I can do that. I'll take the truck, if that's okay.

tomas/boss.tomas.037.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.037.spoken: Okay. Is that close to camp? Sorry. Yes. I'll go.

tomas/boss.tomas.038.spoken: Sorry, boss. It's getting dark. Can I head in? Please?

tomas/boss.tomas.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.039.spoken: I can't, boss. I'm sorry. I just can't right now.

tomas/boss.tomas.040.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.040.spoken: Not out there. Not after dark. Not after what I saw. Sorry, boss. I really can't.

tomas/boss.tomas.041.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.041.spoken: I'm sorry. I don't think it's a good idea, and I don't think you'd go out there either.

tomas/boss.tomas.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.042.spoken: Boss, sorry, the yard's full. Should I start feeding the fire?

tomas/boss.tomas.043.spoken: I took a load to the cradle, boss. The truck's free, if anyone needs it.

tomas/boss.tomas.044.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.044.spoken: Boss, it's dusk. Sorry. I thought you'd want to know. I'm heading in.

tomas/boss.tomas.045.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/boss.tomas.045.spoken: Sorry, boss, I need an axe. Is there one I can have?

tomas/camp.any.019.spoken: Whoever's rustling that crisp packet, please be done with it.

tomas/camp.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/camp.any.020.spoken: Evening, boss. Dinner's on in the cabin.

tomas/camp.any.022.spoken: Another letter for the boat pile. It's getting thick.

tomas/camp.tomas.001.spoken: Writing to Ana again. That's a lot of messages waiting for the boat now. She'll get them all at once.

tomas/camp.tomas.002.spoken: Does anyone know exactly when the boat comes? For the messages, I mean.

tomas/camp.tomas.003.spoken: Biscuit's sitting on my foot. Is that okay? I don't want to move. It feels rude.

tomas/camp.tomas.004.spoken: I beat my own high score. Not Joan's. Just mine. That still counts, right?

tomas/camp.tomas.005.spoken: Joan's teaching me cards. I've lost every hand, but I'm getting very good at shuffling.

tomas/camp.tomas.006.spoken: Is it okay if I put the pillow over my head? It's not personal. It's just the snoring.

tomas/pair.tomas.028.spoken: Really? Okay. Third is fine on the flat, but this truck hates second on a hill. You can feel it sulk.
