tomas/sea.any.003.spoken: Take a look offshore while there's still a gap in the fog.

tomas/sea.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.008.spoken: If you stand by me, you can see it over the yard fence.

tomas/sea.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.012.spoken: Look where the water goes silver. It's just beyond that.

tomas/sea.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.015.spoken: Wait for the next swell. The deck comes back into view.

tomas/sea.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.016.spoken: I caught it in the corner of my eye while I was stacking.

tomas/sea.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.018.spoken: Get a look before it goes behind the point.

tomas/sea.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.020.spoken: I can see its windows flashing in the sun.

tomas/sea.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.021.spoken: It was moving quicker a minute ago.

tomas/sea.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.022.spoken: There's the ship again. It's taking its time past our stretch.

tomas/sea.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.023.spoken: You've got time to see it. The wake's dropped right off.

tomas/sea.any.027.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.027.spoken: If you missed it earlier, look now. It's barely moving.

tomas/sea.any.032.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.032.spoken: No boat coming down from it that I can see.

tomas/sea.any.033.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.033.spoken: It'll pass the opening in the trees in a second. Watch.

tomas/sea.any.035.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.035.spoken: The bow's still pointed along the coast.

tomas/sea.any.036.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.036.spoken: Might be waiting on something out there.

tomas/sea.any.039.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.039.spoken: I didn't think I'd be able to hear it from this far out.

tomas/sea.any.042.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.042.spoken: Hold up. There's a thump coming in over the trees.

tomas/sea.any.046.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.046.spoken: Sounds like a helicopter coming closer.

tomas/sea.any.047.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.047.spoken: I heard it between cuts. It kept getting louder.

tomas/sea.any.048.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.048.spoken: That noise is moving. Look up if you get a clear patch.

tomas/sea.any.050.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.050.spoken: Hear it? There's a low beat behind the engine noise.

tomas/sea.any.051.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.051.spoken: Whatever's overhead is drowning out the surf.

tomas/sea.any.052.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.052.spoken: I can hear it through the cabin wall.

tomas/sea.any.056.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.056.spoken: I lost the sound behind the ridge. Might come round again.

tomas/sea.any.057.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.057.spoken: It's still there when the wind drops.

tomas/sea.any.058.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.058.spoken: I've got a better listen here away from the pit.

tomas/sea.any.060.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.060.spoken: It went quiet quick. Must be farther off now.

tomas/sea.any.061.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.061.spoken: Up over the treeline. You've got a helicopter coming past.

tomas/sea.any.062.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.062.spoken: There it goes over camp. Look up.

tomas/sea.any.064.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.064.spoken: It's crossing the clearing. You've got a few seconds.

tomas/sea.any.066.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.066.spoken: There it is, just above the ridge.

tomas/sea.any.067.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.067.spoken: It turned after it passed the yard.

tomas/sea.any.069.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.069.spoken: I saw it go over the far slope and turn back in.

tomas/sea.any.072.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.072.spoken: It's holding out over the coast now.

tomas/sea.any.073.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.073.spoken: You can see it between those two tops.

tomas/sea.any.075.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.075.spoken: I saw the tail vanish behind the ridge. Keep watching that gap.

tomas/sea.any.076.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.076.spoken: Looks like the next pass is taking it farther inland.

tomas/sea.any.077.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.077.spoken: It went across the bay and curved back toward the island.

tomas/sea.any.079.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.079.spoken: I saw it pass the dock. It kept right on going.

tomas/sea.any.080.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.080.spoken: There it goes toward the water. You can see it against the haze.

tomas/sea.any.082.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.082.spoken: Watch the back of the ship. The helicopter's coming down.

tomas/sea.any.083.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.083.spoken: It went back to the same deck it came from.

tomas/sea.any.085.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.085.spoken: It's over the ship now. Looks like they're bringing it in.

tomas/sea.any.087.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.087.spoken: I watched the ship come round to the same stretch of water.

tomas/sea.any.089.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.089.spoken: It made the whole round. I caught it on both sides of the island.

tomas/sea.any.090.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.090.spoken: Same hull as the one I saw a few days ago.

tomas/sea.any.091.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.091.spoken: Last time I watched it slow down at this same stretch.

tomas/sea.any.092.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.092.spoken: The first time I only saw the ship. Today I saw what was on it.

tomas/sea.any.095.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.095.spoken: The ship's heading away now. Wake's pointing straight out.

tomas/sea.any.096.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.096.spoken: I lost it after it turned seaward.

tomas/sea.any.097.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.097.spoken: The rotor sound went with it after the helicopter came down.

tomas/sea.any.098.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.098.spoken: Yesterday there was nothing on the horizon from this spot. I checked.

tomas/sea.any.099.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.099.spoken: It's gone around the point again. I wonder how far out it goes after.

tomas/sea.any.107.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.107.spoken: I went out to look after you called. I only caught the wake.

tomas/sea.any.108.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.108.spoken: I've got nothing better than a guess about what they're doing.

tomas/sea.any.109.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.109.spoken: The way you describe it, I'd have sworn they were coming in.

tomas/sea.any.119.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.any.119.spoken: Next time, tell me before it gets behind the ridge.

tomas/sea.tomas.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.002.spoken: Something just came out of the haze beyond camp.

tomas/sea.tomas.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.010.spoken: Hang on a second. There's a whole ship behind that swell.

tomas/sea.tomas.043.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/sea.tomas.044.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/sea.tomas.054.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.054.spoken: That rumble's getting closer. I can't see what's making it.

tomas/sea.tomas.074.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.074.spoken: That's low enough to get a decent look at camp.

tomas/sea.tomas.078.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.078.spoken: I'd have missed it if the shadow hadn't moved.

tomas/sea.tomas.103.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.103.spoken: Someone said there was a ship. All I got was the noise overhead.

tomas/sea.tomas.110.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.110.spoken: Did it make one pass over the yard or did I hear the same pass twice?

tomas/sea.tomas.111.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.111.spoken: I wish I'd looked up when you called. The saw was going.

tomas/sea.tomas.113.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.113.spoken: If they saw me from up there, they saw me dropping the same log twice.

tomas/sea.tomas.118.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/sea.tomas.118.spoken: I'd rather it passed in daylight again.

tomas/surv.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/surv.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/surv.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/surv.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/surv.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.010.spoken: Truck's fuelled and the keys are in my pocket, boss. Last resort only.

tomas/surv.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.012.spoken: The company left right on schedule. Shame it was only their schedule.

tomas/surv.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.013.spoken: Is that the ship? That's the ship.

tomas/surv.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.014.spoken: One at a time on the gangway. Hold the rail.

tomas/surv.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.015.spoken: I won't say their name yet. On the boat.

tomas/surv.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.016.spoken: One of us walked off before all this. I hope they're hiding well.

tomas/surv.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.017.spoken: There's so few of us now. Stay where I can see you.

tomas/surv.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.018.spoken: Your watch. Wake me if anything changes. Anything at all.

tomas/surv.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.019.spoken: Not everyone's getting on. I know. Keep walking anyway.

tomas/surv.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.020.spoken: Go on, Biscuit. Up you go. We're right behind you.

tomas/surv.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.021.spoken: I'm not leaving cover, boss. Not for anything.

tomas/surv.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.022.spoken: Last night of it. Hold on till the light.

tomas/surv.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.any.023.spoken: Can we stay inside today? Please? Whatever's been walking the road, I don't want to meet it.

tomas/surv.tomas.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.001.spoken: They're not coming? Sorry, I mean, they're really not coming? Not even the boat?

tomas/surv.tomas.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.002.spoken: Sorry. Sorry. I'm quiet. I'm being quiet.

tomas/surv.tomas.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.003.spoken: Please go away. Please, please go away.

tomas/surv.tomas.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.004.spoken: I wrote Ana a letter I hope she never has to read. Sorry. That's grim. I needed it written down.

tomas/surv.tomas.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.005.spoken: The truck still starts first time, boss. Engines are loud, though. Maybe only if we really have to. Is that useful?

tomas/surv.tomas.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.006.spoken: I'll take a watch. I'm not sleeping anyway. Sorry, I mean I'm happy to.

tomas/surv.tomas.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.007.spoken: The ship's tomorrow, boss? At dawn? Sorry. I just need to hear someone else say it.

tomas/surv.tomas.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.008.spoken: Is Biscuit all right in the alcove, you? Sorry. I keep thinking about him down there by himself.

tomas/surv.tomas.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.009.spoken: I keep expecting to see them at the truck. Then I remember.

tomas/surv.tomas.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.010.spoken: Do you think they're hiding somewhere, you? The one who quit? I hope they found somewhere good.

tomas/surv.tomas.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.011.spoken: I'm okay. I'm okay. I just need one minute where nothing moves.

tomas/surv.tomas.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.012.spoken: I'm still here. Scared every second, but still here. That counts, doesn't it?

tomas/surv.tomas.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.013.spoken: It's real. It's actually there. Sorry, I'm crying. Ana gets the other letter after all. The good one.

tomas/surv.tomas.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.014.spoken: Should I go first? Sorry. No, you go. I'll go. Somebody go!

tomas/surv.tomas.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.015.spoken: I saw it cross the road. Just the once. Sorry, I don't want to say any more than that.

tomas/surv.tomas.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.016.spoken: I can't, boss. I'm so sorry. Please don't make me go out there.

tomas/surv.tomas.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.017.spoken: I can eat less. I'm smaller than everyone. Sorry, that's just maths.

tomas/surv.tomas.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.018.spoken: I did every run they asked for. Every single one. They didn't even send a message.

tomas/surv.tomas.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.019.spoken: Is it gone? Don't answer. Sorry.

tomas/surv.tomas.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.020.spoken: Okay. Okay. Tell me what to do and I'll do it. Just, please, not alone.

tomas/surv.tomas.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/surv.tomas.021.spoken: Not really. Sorry. I kept listening to the roof.

tomas/tool.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/tool.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.002.spoken: Too loud to talk. Wave if you need me.

tomas/tool.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.003.spoken: Big axe makes short work of it.

tomas/tool.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.004.spoken: Small axe. Patience, and a lot more swings.

tomas/tool.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.005.spoken: No tool left on the rack. Someone needs to order more.

tomas/tool.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.006.spoken: Sharpening while there's light. A dull axe is a dangerous axe.

tomas/tool.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.011.spoken: The saw makes me jump every time it starts. Sorry.

tomas/tool.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.014.spoken: Tools strapped down in the truck bed. Nothing rattling loose.

tomas/tool.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.015.spoken: Helmet on before you go under that crown.

tomas/tool.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.016.spoken: Good tread on these boots. The mud's not winning today.

tomas/tool.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.017.spoken: Sap's glued my gloves stiff. Still better than bare hands.

tomas/tool.any.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.018.spoken: I need a tool, boss. The camper computer can order one from the supplier.

tomas/tool.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.019.spoken: Getting the hang of this. Fewer swings than last week.

tomas/tool.any.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.020.spoken: Parcel locker's full. New gear from the supplier, I hope.

tomas/tool.any.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.021.spoken: Wet chain flinging bark everywhere. Keep your visor down.

tomas/tool.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.022.spoken: Killing the saw. Dusk is coming and I want my ears back.

tomas/tool.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.023.spoken: Ten days with the big axe. I'd never go back to the small one.

tomas/tool.any.024.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.024.spoken: Dry wood bites clean. The edge is holding up today.

tomas/tool.any.025.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.025.spoken: On the saw, boss. Can't hear you, but I can see you're there.

tomas/tool.any.026.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.026.spoken: Wind's dropping twigs on my helmet. Glad I'm wearing it.

tomas/tool.any.028.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.any.028.spoken: Go on, then. You start, I'll keep the angle.

tomas/tool.tomas.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.001.spoken: The saw's so loud. I'll just nod at everyone.

tomas/tool.tomas.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.002.spoken: Marta, could you show me how to start the saw? Sorry. It keeps flooding.

tomas/tool.tomas.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.003.spoken: The big axe is heavy. But it feels a bit like driving a truck instead of a van.

tomas/tool.tomas.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.004.spoken: Small axe, boss. It's fine. It's actually fine. I'm used to it.

tomas/tool.tomas.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.005.spoken: Sorry, boss, there's nothing on the rack for me. Is that okay? I can carry instead.

tomas/tool.tomas.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.006.spoken: Helmet on. Ana made me promise. I promised.

tomas/tool.tomas.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.007.spoken: Something in the parcel locker. I hope it's mine. Nothing's ever mine, actually. Never mind.

tomas/tool.tomas.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.008.spoken: I can split a section in four swings now. It used to be seven.

tomas/tool.tomas.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.009.spoken: These boots grip like good tyres. I could go anywhere in these.

tomas/tool.tomas.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.010.spoken: The truck is my favourite tool. Is a truck a tool? I'm saying it's a tool.

tomas/tool.tomas.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.011.spoken: Report, boss: I think I've improved with the axe. Fewer swings per section. Sorry, is that a report?

tomas/tool.tomas.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.012.spoken: Turning the saw off now. I want to hear what's around us before dark.

tomas/tool.tomas.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.013.spoken: Are your gloves stiff too? Mine are crunchy from all the sap.

tomas/tool.tomas.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.014.spoken: Wet handle. Sorry, axe. I'll hold you properly.

tomas/tool.tomas.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.015.spoken: I put all the tools back on the rack. Sorted by size. Is that okay?

tomas/tool.tomas.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.016.spoken: Does the camper computer list trucks, boss? Just looking. Not asking. Mostly not asking.

tomas/tool.tomas.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.017.spoken: Big axe on a section, and it just goes. That's nice.

tomas/tool.tomas.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.018.spoken: Saw off for a second. Sorry. Just checking the top isn't swaying.

tomas/tool.tomas.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.019.spoken: Twenty days with this small axe. I've given it a name. Don't tell Dale.

tomas/tool.tomas.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/tool.tomas.020.spoken: Oh. Oh no. Sorry. That explains a lot, actually.

tomas/wage.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.001.spoken: Pay came through clean. One less thing to think about out here.

tomas/wage.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.002.spoken: Owed since nightfall. Keep swinging, keep counting.

tomas/wage.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.005.spoken: Sorry, I hate to ask. Are the wages coming soon?

tomas/wage.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.010.spoken: Paid and fuelled. The truck runs on diesel. I run on payday.

tomas/wage.any.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.011.spoken: I'm telling you straight, boss. Another day unpaid and I'm leaving on the next boat.

tomas/wage.any.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.012.spoken: Not many names left on the payroll. Every empty bunk is louder for it.

tomas/wage.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.013.spoken: Their gloves are still on the rack. Somebody should use them. Feels odd to be the one.

tomas/wage.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.014.spoken: Caught up at last. Thanks for sorting it, boss.

tomas/wage.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project

tomas/wage.any.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.017.spoken: Someone left. Now I keep wondering if I ought to.

tomas/wage.any.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.019.spoken: Owed, this close to the end? That'll make for a tense boat ride, whichever way it goes.

tomas/wage.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.any.022.spoken: Rain on payday doesn't count. Rain on payday is just weather.

tomas/wage.tomas.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.001.spoken: Paid! Sorry. I've just never been paid this regularly before. Is it okay to be excited about that?

tomas/wage.tomas.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.002.spoken: Ana wants a car. I'm helping with the deposit. I've already written to tell her, but she can't read it until the boat.

tomas/wage.tomas.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.003.spoken: Saving for my own truck. Nothing fancy. Manual box, good tyres, a seat that doesn't squeak like this one.

tomas/wage.tomas.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.004.spoken: Sorry, boss, I don't want to be rude. I think I'm owed? Since last night? Is that right?

tomas/wage.tomas.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.005.spoken: I'm really sorry, boss. If it's still unpaid tomorrow night, I have to take the boat home. Ana's counting on that money.

tomas/wage.tomas.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.006.spoken: Owed wages and a full tank. Well. One of those is fine.

tomas/wage.tomas.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.007.spoken: I told Ana in my letter that the money's all fine. I'll fix that page tomorrow. Maybe.

tomas/wage.tomas.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.008.spoken: Oh, it came through! Thank you, boss. And sorry I asked about it twice.

tomas/wage.tomas.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.009.spoken: There's so few of us now. I keep waiting at the truck for people who aren't coming.

tomas/wage.tomas.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.010.spoken: I'm doing the extra runs since someone left. I don't mind. I like driving. The cab's just quiet without them.

tomas/wage.tomas.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.011.spoken: Do you think they got home all right? The one who left? Sorry, you. I keep wondering.

tomas/wage.tomas.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.012.spoken: My last job paid by the parcel, and the van broke down twice a week. A day rate feels like a holiday, honestly.

tomas/wage.tomas.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.013.spoken: Not me either. I thought I'd done something wrong. Sorry, I'm glad it isn't just me. That came out badly.

tomas/wage.tomas.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.014.spoken: Caught up at last. Same road, same mud, and somehow it's a nicer drive.

tomas/wage.tomas.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.015.spoken: I know you'll sort it, boss. I just get nervous about money. Sorry. It's not you.

tomas/wage.tomas.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.016.spoken: Rent, Ana's car, Mum's dentist. I list it all in my head and then it's all spent. In my head, anyway.

tomas/wage.tomas.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.017.spoken: I'm trying not to count the days I'm owed. I keep counting them anyway.

tomas/wage.tomas.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.018.spoken: All paid up, boss. Thank you. Really. I checked, sorry, but it's all there.

tomas/wage.tomas.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.019.spoken: Boss, with so few of us, I'm hauling more than I'm driving now. I don't mind. I just thought you should know.

tomas/wage.tomas.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.020.spoken: I can help! I can make toast. Sorry, toast is the whole list.

tomas/wage.tomas.021.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wage.tomas.021.spoken: Better, thanks. For once I didn't wake up doing sums. Is that silly?

tomas/wx.any.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.001.spoken: Wet bark. Slow and steady on this one.

tomas/wx.any.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.002.spoken: Gusts in the tops. Waiting for a lull.

tomas/wx.any.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.003.spoken: Storm's too strong to fell in. Holding off.

tomas/wx.any.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.004.spoken: Dry and bright. Good working weather.

tomas/wx.any.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.005.spoken: Mud's sucking at my boots. Careful steps.

tomas/wx.any.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.006.spoken: More sky than canopy out here now.

tomas/wx.any.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.007.spoken: Not much forest left to clear. The island looks bigger without it.

tomas/wx.any.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.008.spoken: Sun's low. Time to wrap up.

tomas/wx.any.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.009.spoken: Roots everywhere under this growth. Watch your ankles.

tomas/wx.any.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.010.spoken: Halfway cleared, everyone. The second half's never quicker, but at least we know the ground now.

tomas/wx.any.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.013.spoken: Getting dark. Can we start heading back? Just to be early.

tomas/wx.any.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.014.spoken: I don't like how loud the storm gets in the trees. Can we go in?

tomas/wx.any.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.015.spoken: Low gear, steady throttle. The route holds if you don't rush it.

tomas/wx.any.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.016.spoken: Route's opened right up. Hardly a blind corner left.

tomas/wx.any.022.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.022.spoken: Storm's up, boss. I've stopped felling till it passes.

tomas/wx.any.023.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.any.023.spoken: Calm water today. You can see a long way out.

tomas/wx.tomas.001.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.001.spoken: Rain's on. Second gear, no sudden steering. The truck's happiest slow in this.

tomas/wx.tomas.002.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.002.spoken: The lane's going to be all ruts after this rain. I might need a push later. Sorry in advance.

tomas/wx.tomas.003.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.003.spoken: Is it okay if we head in? The storm's getting louder. Sorry. I just think we should.

tomas/wx.tomas.004.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.004.spoken: The trees are really moving. Is that normal? Sorry. It's probably normal.

tomas/wx.tomas.005.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.005.spoken: Dry lane today. The truck almost feels like it's on a real road.

tomas/wx.tomas.006.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.006.spoken: Mud's deep at the low bits. I'll take it wide and keep the wheels turning.

tomas/wx.tomas.007.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.007.spoken: Low gear on the downhill. Nobody touch anything. Please.

tomas/wx.tomas.008.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.008.spoken: Is it dusk? It looks like dusk. Sorry, I just like to know.

tomas/wx.tomas.009.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.009.spoken: The route's easier with fewer trees about. I can see round the corners now.

tomas/wx.tomas.010.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.010.spoken: Half the island! I'm telling Ana. She'll ask what it looks like. Mostly stumps, I'll say.

tomas/wx.tomas.011.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.011.spoken: You can see the water the boat will come in on. Well, the water. No boat yet.

tomas/wx.tomas.012.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.012.spoken: There were loads of birds in these trees when we got here. They've moved. Because of us, I think. The saws are loud.

tomas/wx.tomas.013.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.013.spoken: Something grabbed my whole arm. Oh. Brambles. Sorry. It's just brambles.

tomas/wx.tomas.014.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.014.spoken: Steering round stumps now. It's like a cone course. I used to be good at those.

tomas/wx.tomas.015.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.015.spoken: The truck lane's going to be soup. Is it okay if I take it slow today?

tomas/wx.tomas.016.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.016.spoken: Can you see the dock from here? Sorry. I just like knowing where it is.

tomas/wx.tomas.017.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.017.spoken: Cabin roof's just there. Nearly in. Is everyone behind me?

tomas/wx.tomas.018.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.018.spoken: The rain's good for one thing, boss. The truck gets washed for free.

tomas/wx.tomas.019.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.019.spoken: The river's louder than it was. Is that rain from further up? Preeya would know.

tomas/wx.tomas.020.provenance: original synthetic voice (CMU Flite clustergen voice, modified per profile); no recorded or cloned person for this project
tomas/wx.tomas.020.spoken: It is nice. It makes the boat feel closer. Is that silly?
